role: Automation Engineering Apprentice - West Midlands (48-month fixed term contract)
description: Ever wondered what it's like to orchestrate a symphony of robots? Picture yourself at the controls of one of the world's most sophisticated automated networks - where thousands of robots work in perfect harmony, artificial intelligence makes split-second decisions, and breakthrough technology comes to life. This isn't science fiction. This is Amazon, and it could be your everyday workspace as an Automation Apprentice. Our fulfilment centres are like living, breathing cities of automation: hundreds of autonomous robots collaborating to fulfil customer orders, AI and machine-learning systems making real-time decisions, conveyor systems spanning miles, robotic arms handling packages with incredible precision, and automated storage and retrieval systems redefining what efficiency looks like. As an Automation Apprentice within our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team, you'll be hands-on with technology most people only read about, working alongside industry pioneers. This isn't just maintenance - it's being part of a team that innovates, improves, and reimagines automation technology every single day, with the chance to see your own ideas come to life in real-world applications. Are you the person who took things apart to see how they worked? Maybe you built a PC, fixed everyone's tech, loved robotics club or Lego Technic, tinkered with a car or bike, or found physics, electronics or design and technology just clicked. Or maybe you've spent a few years in a hands-on role and want to step up into cutting-edge automation. You don't need to be an engineer already - what matters is curiosity about how things work, a logical, problem-solving mind, and the patience to figure out why something's gone wrong and put it right. If that sounds like you, this could be the start of something extraordinary. A day in the life can involve: - Supporting maintenance and fault-finding on automated systems and robotics - Using diagnostic tools to keep conveyors and sortation equipment running smoothly - Planning preventative maintenance and safety checks - Collaborating with engineers to develop new process improvements and energy-efficient solutions Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll gain both theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience across: - Advanced robotics systems, controls, and industrial automation programming - Smart sensor technology and IoT integration - Predictive maintenance and performance optimisation through data analytics - Safety systems for human-robot collaboration - Machine learning applications and wider Industry 4.0 technologies Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision. Within this 48-month programme, you'll work towards the Level 6 Control Technical Support Apprenticeship, combining practical, on-the-job experience with industry-recognised study. Your first 12 months will be a full-time residential programme, based either at one of our external training provider facilities or at our own world-class Amazon training centres - reflecting our significant investment in developing state-of-the-art facilities for the next generation of engineers. If you live outside a commutable distance, accommodation will be provided during term time for these first 12 months, and travel expenses will be supported. In later years, your on-the-job training will work towards a BSc in Controls and Automation Engineering and an HNC/D in Electrical/Controls Engineering. This role supports our 24/7 operation, so you'll work shifts covering days, nights and weekends - patterns that reflect the real-world schedules of the engineers who keep Amazon operating around the clock. You'll join a diverse and passionate team of engineers dedicated to driving results and pushing creative boundaries. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups - including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a well-rounded professional. The robots are waiting - are you ready to take control? Turn your passion for technology into an extraordinary career at the forefront of engineering innovation. Apply now and be part of the team writing the future of automation.

We build AI agents that operate across the full revenue lifecycle, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our customers use Nooks to build agents that research accounts, run outreach, and work deals across the whole revenue lifecycle. They trust us to deliver the infrastructure across text, voice, computer use, and data to power their inbound, outbound, and deal execution. Every day, thousands of users rely on Nooks to do the work that used to take entire teams of people. Because every company in the world has a revenue function, we're still incredibly early in our product lifecycle, which means engineers have an outsized impact. You'll ship production code on your first day, own projects from idea to production, talk directly with our customers, and help define what building and maintaining AI-native enterprise software looks like. You'll likely be a great fit if you: - Are completing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. - Have built software and agents through internships, research, open source, startups, or personal projects. - Have gotten stuck on something hard and found a way to push through. - Care whether what you build matters to the people using it. - Love learning new technologies and figuring out how to use them to solve problems for people. Are you ready to take your engineering skills from textbook to takeoff? We're looking for three highly motivated engineering students to join the **nTop Aircraft Design Fellowship** for a transformative 12-week summer immersion at our New York City headquarters. This is an **accelerated, hands-on design sprint** where you and your team will be responsible for the end-to-end development of a cutting-edge **Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS**), from mission requirements to first flight. Forget working on someone else's project. You will design, analyze, and optimize a functional aircraft **from** **scratch** using the powerful capabilities of nTop, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in advanced aircraft design. ## What You'll Do - Design & Optimize: Utilize nTop to develop a novel UAS configuration, airframe, and component structure tailored to specific mission goals. - Build & Fly: Bring your digital design into the physical world, leading the construction, assembly, and flight testing of your prototype. - Be a Thought Leader: Document your entire process to create a comprehensive nTop learning course, generate compelling marketing content, and co-author a publishable research paper. - Impact the Industry: Your work will directly influence how aerospace companies approach design and manufacturing, showcasing the full potential of nTop. ## Fellowship Details - Duration: 12 Weeks (Summer 2027 - specific dates flexible) - Location: nTop Headquarters, New York City - Pay: $20 per hour for 40 hours per week - Outcomes: A built and flown UAS prototype, a co-authored research publication, a comprehensive learning course, and valuable professional marketing content. ## Desired Experience by Role We’re building a small, high-performing, cross-functional team of three exceptional students: a Configurator/Analysis Lead, an Avionics/Controls Lead, and a Design/Manufacturing Lead. Each role is critical to getting this aircraft off the ground and requires deep expertise in a specific engineering discipline. Take a look at the roles below, and when you apply, let us know which position matches your expertise. If you’re ready for an unparalleled opportunity to lead a full-stack aerospace project and leave your mark on the future of design technology, apply now! ### **1. Configurator / Analysis Lead** This role is for the student with a deep theoretical and practical understanding of aircraft performance and flight dynamics. You will define the aircraft's outer mold line (OML) and ensure it meets all performance, stability, and control requirements. **Required Experience & Skills** - Currently pursuing a degree in Aerospace Engineering (or equivalent). - Deep understanding of aircraft configuration design, including trade studies and sizing methodologies. - Proven ability to conduct aircraft performance analysis (e.g., range, endurance, takeoff, landing). - Strong theoretical background in aerodynamics and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) principles. - Experience with stability and control analysis for fixed-wing or rotary-wing aircraft. - Familiarity with air vehicle mass properties and balance calculation. - Proficiency with relevant analysis software (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, XFLR5, or other industry tools). - Experience translating mission requirements into a viable preliminary aircraft design. ### ### **2. Avionics / Controls Lead** This role is for the student who thrives at the intersection of mechanical and electrical systems. You will be responsible for specifying, integrating, and programming all electronic components and flight control systems. **Required Experience & Skills** - Currently pursuing a degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (or equivalent). - Demonstrated experience building and integrating mechatronic systems (e.g., robotics, autonomous vehicles, or UAS). - Experience with component specification for UAS, including motors, servos, batteries, and flight controllers. - Proficiency in programming microcontrollers and/or flight management systems (e.g., ArduPilot, PX4, or similar open-source platforms). - Strong understanding of control systems theory and implementation (e.g., PID loop tuning). - Hands-on experience with soldering, wiring harnesses, and electrical layout for compact systems. - Familiarity with common communication protocols (e.g., I2C, SPI, CAN). ### ### **3. Design / Manufacturing Lead** This role is for the student with exceptional hands-on design and manufacturing experience. You will translate the OML into a detailed, manufacturable airframe, focusing on structural integrity and leveraging nTop's advanced design for additive manufacturing (DfAM) capabilities. **Required Experience & Skills** - Currently pursuing a degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering (or equivalent). - Extensive, proven experience in Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM), including topology optimization, lattice generation, and part consolidation. - Proficiency in detailed mechanical design and creating engineering drawings. - Strong understanding of material properties (especially polymers and composites) relevant to airframe construction. - Hands-on experience with Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing) processes (e.g., FDM, SLS, SLA) and post-processing techniques. - Experience with structural analysis and designing components to meet specific load cases. - Familiarity with traditional manufacturing methods (e.g., composite layup, machining) is a plus.

role: Ground Software Engineering Internship (Spring or Summer 2027)
description: Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge. For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles. Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more. We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. # About the Role We are seeking talented engineers to work closely with the broader engineering team for an exciting internship opportunity. This person is passionate about engineering, ready to take ownership over complex challenges, and a strong desire to learn about all things satellites. During the 12-week internship program at Apex, you'll gain hands-on experience and professional growth opportunities. You’ll be assigned a project to give you the opportunity to have real impact. Throughout the project you'll have a dedicated mentor to guide you, while participating in learning sessions to elevate your knowledge of aerospace. Plus, you'll connect with peers and industry professionals during our community events, making this a well-rounded experience to launch your career! **Ground Software:** Interns will work alongside our engineers as a fully integrated member of the team, contributing to the design, development, and deployment of the software that operates our satellites. Work can include owning a scoped project as well as taking on meaningful tickets across our ground software stack. **Requirements:** - Graduating in the Fall of 2027 or in the Spring of 2028 - Currently pursuing a BS or MS degree in related field - Strong understanding of software architecture - Experience with Rust, C/C++ for backend, Vue or React for frontend is preferred. *Note: Spring interns should be available to pause or adjust academic commitments (such as taking a semester off or enrolling part-time) for the duration of the program* # **Why Join Apex?** Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one. ## **What We Offer For Full-time Employees:** - **Shared upside:** Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create - **Best-in-class healthcare:** 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost - **Comprehensive PTO package:** Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays - **Competitive 401(k) plan:** Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2% - **8 weeks paid parental leave:** Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel - **Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks:** To keep you fueled throughout the day - **Vibrant community:** Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family - **Your dream desk setup:** All the tools you need to be your most productive self - **World-class Playa Vista office:** With the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life - **Real impact opportunity:** Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference # Additional Information: Compensation ranges are set by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. A candidate's specific level and base pay are determined case by case and may vary with job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities, and internal equity. Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan. # **ITAR Requirements** Apex's work is governed by U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To be eligible for this role, applicants must either (1) qualify as a U.S. Person, meaning a U.S. citizen or national, a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), a refugee admitted under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or an individual granted asylum under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or (2) be able to obtain the required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Department of Commerce, or another applicable U.S. government agency. description: ### **About Stripe** Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million [businesses](https://stripe.com/customers) build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make [upgrades to our products](https://stripe.com/roadmap) every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most [reliable APIs](https://status.stripe.com/) on the internet. We build entirely new [pieces](https://tempo.xyz/) of [financial](https://mpp.dev/) [infrastructure](https://joinopenstandard.com/) to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in [risk and fraud](https://stripe.com/radar) infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works. ### **About the Team** Our internship program is structured to provide interns with the opportunity to work on real projects that our customers urgently need. In this role you will be part of the Product Design team, which is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about. ### **What You'll Do** As a Product Design Intern, you will focus on designing and building experiences that will be shipped to our users in production. You will contribute design iterations to ongoing project workstreams, tackling important projects to increase global commerce, and help shape brand new experiences. Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. Key responsibilities include: - Work on a product design project with a product team, translating business ideas into real experience. - Help craft thoughtful experiences that enable startups and large businesses to establish and manage their businesses. - Apply problem-solving skills and human-centered approaches to address complex and ambiguous business and user problems. - Develop and refine design solutions by partnering closely with other designers. - Craft and prototype visually polished experiences to get user feedback. - Partner closely with engineering to implement a feature/product from design to implementation, and get it in the hands of our users. - Engage in group design critiques and collaborative design sessions to improve and receive feedback on your work. - Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, data scientists, and researchers, proactively seeking and incorporating feedback. - Understand and advocate for our users, participating in the design process from early concepts to final delivery. ### **Who You Are** - Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Ben je een gedreven ingenieur (WO) die mee wil werken aan innovatief onderzoek in de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart? Wil je daarvoor gebruik maken state-of-the-art ontwerp, simulatie en optimalisatie methoden? Lees dan verder! Wat ga je doen? Als R&D Engineer ga je het Computational Mechanics team binnen de afdeling versterken. Je doet onderzoek naar nieuwe structurele ontwerpen via analyses en optimalisaties van metaal (3D-geprint), composiet en hybride constructies. Hierbij maak je gebruik van bestaande CAD en FEM software. Je ontwikkelt ontwerpmethodologieën of geavanceerde rekenmodellen voor duurzame lichtgewicht én economisch haalbare concepten voor toepassing in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Dit kan gaan om detail berekeningen voor componenten tot globale structurele modellen van vliegtuigen. Verder werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe proces simulaties van nieuwe innovatieve fabricage concepten en ondersteun je experimentele testen met simulaties. Dit doe je binnen projecten die we uitvoeren voor klanten in Nederland en het buitenland. Daarvoor werk je nauw samen met je collega’s en onze fabricage- en testafdelingen. Je werkt in teamverband aan projecten en het werk biedt volop mogelijkheden voor je verdere inhoudelijke en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wat breng je mee? • Academische opleiding afgerond op Master niveau in de Lucht- en Ruimtevaart of Werktuigbouwkunde met specialisatie Computational Mechanics; • Ervaring met Finite Element Modelling en CAD software; • Oog voor nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen het vakgebied én daarbuiten; • Teamgeest, resultaatgerichtheid, initiatief en zelfstandigheid; • Een deskundige en open houding richting klanten en collega’s; • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels. Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast dit alles bieden wij jou: De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken; Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans; Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving De afdeling Metal Additive Manufacturing & Computational Mechanics (25 medewerkers) richt zich op het ontwikkelen van kennis, vaardigheden en processen (ontwerp, analyse en fabricage- en reparatietechnologie) op het gebied van metaal additive manufacturing en op het accuraat kunnen voorspellen, optimaliseren en simuleren van het gedrag van (multi)materialen en multifunctionele constructies tijdens het ontwerp- en maakproces (via virtual manufacturing) en het testen (via virtual testen). Daarnaast doen we experimenteel materiaal- en schadeonderzoek. We werken nauw samen binnen de afdeling en met experts van andere afdelingen binnen NLR. Zo voeren wij ook simulaties uit van fabricage processen en ontwikkelen wij digitale representaties van fabricagetechnieken (digital twins). Onze projectteams zijn multidisciplinair samengesteld en werken in (inter-)nationale samenwerkingsverbanden. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Wil jij meer weten? Mail dan met onze recruiter Danielle Kuijf . Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal . Solliciteren? Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button. Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD. Voor deze functie zijn een integriteitstest en het verkrijgen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) voorwaarden voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie over de VOG lees je op de website van Justis. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

**About the Company** General Matter is enriching uranium in America. Our goal is to design, build, and operate the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services in the United States. Our mission is to restore America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel—fuel that will power AI, advanced manufacturing, critical industries, and the next generation of nuclear reactors. Ultimately, our work will help power national ambitions and enable a high-energy society. We were incubated by Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by top-tier investors. Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production. We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency. Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable. **About This Role** As a Summer Field Engineer Intern at General Matter, you'll be on the ground in Paducah during active construction of our flagship uranium enrichment facility. It's a first-of-a-kind plant being built on the site of the former Paducah Gaseous Diffusion Plant, which helped fuel America for sixty years. You'll be the link between design and the field, helping turn drawings and specifications into installed work, catch problems before they cost the schedule, and build the record that shows the plant was built right. Most construction interns are one of dozens on a job at a large contractor, with little ownership of real work. Here you'll sit on the owner's team for one project of national importance. You'll take on meaningful scopes of work and work directly alongside the superintendents, engineers, and quality team delivering it. You'll see how a nuclear facility comes together, and you'll help build it. If you seek high impact and are excited by fast-paced, intense, Skunkworks-style projects, we encourage you to apply to join our team. **Responsibilities** *Field Engineering & Constructability* - Help interpret drawings, specifications, and shop drawings for craft and subcontractor crews, and flag constructability issues to engineering before they reach the field - Assist in drafting and tracking RFIs and submittals for assigned work packages from the first question through the engineering response and closure - Perform quantity takeoffs, track installed quantities and percent complete, and support field progress reporting to project controls and the master schedule - Help verify survey, layout, and as-built data for foundations, embeds, underground utilities, and structural steel - Support coordination of material deliveries, laydown, and equipment needs with superintendents and subcontractors to keep work fronts moving *Quality & Documentation* - Support coordination of inspection and test plan hold points with Quality Control, and help verify that installed work meets drawings, specifications, and nuclear quality requirements - Maintain daily reports, progress photos, and field records that become part of the facility's permanent quality and turnover record - Support punch-list walks, as-built markups, and turnover package preparation for completed systems *Safety & Field Coordination* - Help prepare Job Hazard Analyses and take part in daily safety meetings, toolbox talks, and field safety walks - Serve as a day-to-day field contact for subcontractor foremen on assigned tasks, raising issues early and closing them out quickly - Own a defined intern project over the summer, such as tracking a site utility system or a building's foundation work, and present your results to the project team **Basic Qualifications** - Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Civil, Construction, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or Construction Management, with an expected graduation date after summer 2027 - Evidence of exceptional ability (construction internships or co-ops, engineering competition teams, hands-on projects, completed builds, etc.) - Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications - Ability to work outdoors on an active construction site in all weather conditions, including walking uneven terrain, climbing ladders and stairs, and wearing required PPE - Valid driver's license - Ability to obtain and maintain required security clearance and access authorization - Available for the full 12-week summer 2027 internship in Paducah, Kentucky **Preferred Skills and Experience** - Prior construction internship or co-op experience, especially on industrial, power generation, data center, semiconductor, or other mission-critical projects - EIT certification or a passing score on the FE exam - OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification - Familiarity with Procore, Bluebeam, AutoCAD/Civil 3D, or Primavera P6 - Exposure to nuclear, DOE, or NQA-1 quality programs - Leadership on an engineering competition team (ASCE Concrete Canoe, Steel Bridge, Solar Decathlon, etc.) or in a student organization - Military service, trades experience, or other hands-on leadership experience - Bias toward action and comfort making decisions with incomplete information in a fast-paced, resource-constrained environment - Interest in building a long-term career on a single flagship project rather than moving from job to job **Additional Requirements** - Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary. **Equal Opportunity Employer** General Matter is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with General Matter is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. **Compensation and Benefits** The hourly pay range for this internship is $30–$40 per hour, depending on the candidate's current standing in school (i.e. sophomore, senior). Interns will receive a monthly housing stipend, and are eligible for overtime pay. Please note that the stated hourly range is an estimate and may be adjusted based on market conditions, business needs, or other factors.

role: Business Analyst RH Digital & IA STAGE (H/F)
description: Chez Mondial Relay by InPost, nous accélérons la transformation digitale de nos pratiques RH. Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire curieux(se), créatif(ve) et passionné(e) par l’ IA, l’automatisation et les outils digitaux pour imaginer et déployer les solutions qui simplifieront le quotidien de nos équipes. Au sein de l’équipe RH, vous participerez à des projets concrets à fort impact, de l’identification des besoins jusqu’à la mise en œuvre des solutions. Vos missions : Analyser les besoins des équipes RH, identifier les points de friction et proposer des solutions innovantes pour améliorer les processus. Participer à la simplification et à l’optimisation des pratiques RH grâce aux outils digitaux et à l’automatisation. Identifier et expérimenter des cas d’usage d’IA générative appliqués aux ressources humaines. Concevoir et tester des assistants IA, prompts, agents conversationnels et solutions d’automatisation. Développer des flux automatisés avec Power Automate et l’environnement Microsoft 365. Participer à l’évolution des outils et applications RH, notamment dans le cadre des projets SIRH. Réaliser des tests fonctionnels, accompagner les utilisateurs et rédiger la documentation associée. Contribuer à la qualité, à la fiabilité et à la cohérence des données RH. Ce que nous recherchons : Vous préparez un Bac+5 en Systèmes d’Information, Transformation Digitale, Management des SI, Ressources Humaines avec une spécialisation digitale, Business Analysis ou Innovation Numérique. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils collaboratifs Microsoft 365 et Excel. Vous avez un fort intérêt pour l’ IA générative , l’automatisation et les nouvelles technologies. Vous faites preuve de curiosité, d’autonomie, de rigueur et d’un véritable esprit d’innovation. Vous aimez comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et transformer les idées en solutions concrètes. Vos petits + : Une connaissance de Power Automate , Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude ou d’autres outils d’IA générative. Une première expérience avec un SIRH (SAP SuccessFactors ou équivalent). Des notions de gestion de projet, d’API ou de cartographie des processus. Une capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques auprès d’interlocuteurs non spécialistes. Une forte orientation service et une excellente aisance relationnelle. Pourquoi rejoindre Mondial Relay by InPost ? • Vous aurez l’opportunité d’évoluer dans un environnement inclusif, stimulant et international, en collaboration quotidienne avec nos experts métier • Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'une équipe de direction engagée, ce qui vous permettra d'enrichir votre expérience dans les domaines passionnants de la logistique et du e-commerce • Vous rejoindrez le groupe InPost, un acteur en pleine croissance qui offre à ses collaborateurs un potentiel d'évolution sur plusieurs sites à travers l'Europe • Vous bénéficierez d’une carrière épanouissante, avec la possibilité de se développer grâce à notre offre de formation • Vous serez intégré à la communauté Mondial Relay by InPost, qui contribue chaque jour au développement durable et à l'économie circulaire Nos valeurs Chez Mondial Relay by InPost, nos valeurs guident toutes nos actions : START WITH THE CUSTOMER Tout commence par le client : il est la boussole de chacune de nos actions et décisions. Notre ambition ne se limite pas à répondre à ses attentes mais à les dépasser. THIS IS YOUR COMPANY – ACT LIKE IT Nous prenons des initiatives et assumons pleinement la responsabilité de nos actions. Nous agissons de manière proactive dès que nous identifions quelque chose qui ne va pas. CREATE, TEST, GROW Nous cultivons l’esprit entrepreneurial, l’ambition et un état d’esprit audacieux. Innover, c’est oser essayer, échouer, apprendre, s’améliorer et réussir ensemble. ADAPT, LEARN, MOVE ON Nous évoluons avec aisance dans un environnement en constante évolution. Nous avançons vite, mais pas à l’aveugle. Nous réfléchissons, apprenons et nous nous adaptons en permanence. La vitesse compte - mais c’est une vitesse intelligente et coordonnée qui fait la différence. OUR TEAMS WIN, TOGETHER Au final, tout est une question de personnes. Unis par une mentalité de gagnant et une passion commune pour notre mission, nous générons des résultats extraordinaires grâce à la collaboration, la reconnaissance et la célébration des réussites, grandes comme petites. Diversité & inclusion Dans le cadre de notre politique Diversité & Inclusion, nous garantissons le respect des règles de non-discrimination à l'embauche et nous nous engageons en faveur des publics éloignés de l'emploi. Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap. Signataire d'une Convention de Développement de l'Emploi avec l'Agefiph jusqu'en 2029, nous renforçons nos actions pour favoriser l'inclusion, l'intégration et le maintien dans l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement pour votre entretien ou votre prise de poste, n'hésitez pas à nous le faire savoir. Entreprise du groupe InPost, Mondial Relay by InPost est un leader européen de la livraison hors domicile. Chaque année, nos 2 500 collaborateurs mettent le paquet pour assurer la livraison de +250 millions de colis au travers un réseau de 21 000 Lockers et Points Relais®. Nous partageons une vision claire : faire de Mondial Relay by InPost la référence de la livraison de colis en France, Belgique et Luxembourg, en alliant innovation continue, expérience client remarquable et engagement durable pour la planète​. Au sein d'un collectif porté par l'humain, nos Relayeuses & Relayeurs évoluent dans un environnement challengeant où ils cultivent leur esprit entrepreneurial et leurs capacités d'apprentissage au quotidien. Venez écrire le futur de la livraison à nos côtés. Postulez, innovez, cartonnez ! À propos d’InPost InPost est leader dans le domaine des solutions logistiques pour le secteur du e-commerce en Europe. Fondée par Rafał Brzoska, InPost est aujourd’hui une plateforme de livraison de premier plan qui a révolutionné le marché des colis en Pologne. Le premier Locker a fait son apparition à Cracovie en 2009 et est rapidement devenu un élément incontournable des achats en ligne, garantissant rapidité et praticité. Aujourd’hui, le réseau InPost est le système automatisé de retrait et de livraison de colis le plus vaste et le plus pratique d’Europe, avec 100 000 points de retrait hors domicile, dont plus de 70 000 Lockers (ou APM) et 30 000 points de retrait (ou PUDO), répartis dans 9 pays (Royaume-Uni, France, Pologne, Italie, Espagne, Portugal, Belgique, Luxembourg et Pays-Bas). InPost fournit des services de gestion logistique complète aux vendeurs en ligne, en collaboration avec environ 100 000 e-commerçants. En 2025, l’entreprise a traité près de 1,4 milliard de colis, enregistrant une croissance de 25 % par rapport à l’année précédente.

Arcadis is dé wereldwijde partner die vooraan staat bij de meest impactvolle projecten van onze tijd. We helpen onze klanten duurzame keuzes te maken via de combinatie van digitale innovatie, expertise en toekomstgerichte vaardigheden in onder meer milieu, energie, water, gebouwen, transport en infrastructuur. Wij zetten die extra stap om onze klanten op maat gemaakte oplossingen te bieden voor ontwerp, engineering en advies. Door data-gedreven inzichten in te zetten geven we de natuurlijke en gebouwde omgeving samen vorm. Met meer dan 34.000 mensen bundelen we wereldwijde expertise en pakken we samen uitdagingen als klimaat, betaalbare energie en leefbare steden aan. We verbeteren de levenskwaliteit door onze aanwezigheid in meer dan 30 landen. **Rolbeschrijving:** Als Junior Rail Designer werk je in een gezellig en divers team mee aan het verbeteren van de bereikbaarheid van het openbaar vervoer en de inpassing in de openbare ruimte. Samen met je team maak je spoorontwerpen voor projecten in Nederland en daarbuiten. Jouw uitdaging is het ontwerpen van spooralignementen en baanontwerpen voor opdrachtgevers zoals ProRail, NS, RET, GVB of internationale klanten. Je zorgt ervoor dat het spoorontwerp aansluit bij de klantwensen en werkt samen met een Lead Engineer om het ontwerp af te stemmen en in te passen op de overige Rail-disciplines, zoals bovenleiding, kabels en leidingen, stations, installaties en railbeveiliging. Het resultaat is een integraal spoorontwerp dat perfect past in de beschikbare ruimte. Dit proces kent meerdere iteraties en kan een complexe, maar uitdagende puzzel zijn. Mooie voorbeelden van projecten waarin deze disciplines samenkomen zijn de Uithoflijn, [Bereikbare Regio – OVAH](https://ovamsterdamhaarlemmermeer.nl/bereikbare-regio/), de [Wunderline Groningen–Bremen](https://www.prorail.nl/projecten/wunderline-spoorlijn-groningen-bremen), [Driebergen-Zeist](https://www.prorail.nl/projecten/driebergen-zeist), de [Nedersaksenlijn](https://www.denedersaksenlijn.nl/) en de [spooromgeving Geldermalsen](https://www.prorail.nl/projecten/aanpassingen-spoor-station-geldermalsen). Naast ontwerpen kunnen je werkzaamheden bestaan uit: - Het opstellen van contractdocumenten; - Het doen van opnames langs de spoorbaan; - Het uitvoeren van inspecties langs de spoorbaan; - Het meeontwikkelen in onze digitale ambitie; Je gaat werken aan Nederlandse en buitenlandse projecten binnen de sector Transportation. Je werkdagen kunnen zeer divers zijn. Zo kan het zijn dat je de ene dag met nederlandse collega’s aan een nederlands project werkt en de andere dag met buitenlandse collega’s aan een buitenlands project. **Service Area Civil and Rail** Je gaat aan de slag binnen de Service Area Civil and Rail, een afdeling die bestaat uit Wegen en Rail teams. Jij wordt specifiek onderdeel van het team Rail Design. Onze vesitiging in Amersfoort is de standplaats van het team. De Service Area Civil and Rail valt binnen de Service Design and Engineering Europa / UK en Ierland. **Kwalificaties & Ervaring:** Je hebt een passie voor infrastructurele projecten en kunt je daar volledig in vastbijten. Je brengt innovatieve ideeën in en houdt ervan om structuur aan te brengen in je werk. Een belangrijke eigenschap is dat je altijd blijft denken aan de integraliteit van het project: jij bent immers een essentieel onderdeel van het grotere geheel van het integrale spoorontwerp. Daarnaast beschik je over de volgende kwalificaties: - Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in civiele techniek of een andere technische richting met ontwerpkennis; - Bij voorkeur enige ervaring binnen railontwerp; - Het vermogen om zowel op hoog niveau (vogelvluchtperspectief) als op detailniveau te werken; - Innovatieve ideeën en de ambitie om mee te denken over nieuwe ontwikkelingen in het ontwerpproces; - Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; - Kennis van ontwerpsoftware zoals AutoCAD en/of Civil 3D; - Sterke competenties om goed samen te werken in een team; - Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden; - Een gedreven instelling om projecten tot een kwalitatief hoogstaand resultaat te brengen. **Waarom Arcadis?** We bereiken onze doelen door iedereen in staat te stellen het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Wij geloven dat ieders bijdrage ertoe doet. Daarom pionieren we met een aanpak gebaseerd op jouw vaardigheden en bouwen we aan een ‘Skills Powered Organisation’. Met jouw unieke ervaring en expertise stippel je zo je eigen carrièrepad uit. Samen maximaliseren we de impact! Jouw werk maakt het verschil. Welke rol je ook speelt, je helpt duurzame oplossingen te bieden voor een gezondere planeet. Druk jouw stempel op je carrière, je collega's, klanten, je leven en de wereld om je heen. Op onze website kun je de blogs van Arcadianen lezen om erachter te komen hoe wij dit doen. Arcadis biedt jou een functie met veel vrijheid om je werk zelfstandig in te vullen in een ambitieus en gedreven team. Naast een fijne werkcultuur hebben we ook prima arbeidsvoorwaarden opgenomen, waaronder: - 30 verlofdagen bij fulltime dienstverband met mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen of te verkopen. - Medewerkers mogen privé gratis gebruik maken van de NS businesskaart. - Aanvullende regelingen ten aanzien van geboorteverlof voor de partner en betaald ouderschapsverlof. - Mogelijkheid tot hybride werken, gefaciliteerd door passende thuiswerkvergoeding en een professioneel ingerichte werkplek thuis. - Goede pensioenregeling bij het Nederlandse Pensioenfonds (HNPF) waarbij Arcadis het grootste deel van de premie betaalt. - Mogelijkheden voor het volgen van cursussen en opleidingen, toegang tot ons uitgebreide Arcadis Learning Experience Platform (LXP). **Join Arcadis. role: Student Business Analyst til A&A Technology
description: Vi leder efter en ambitiøs studerende med interesse for både forretning og teknologi. Du bliver en del af teamet på lige fod med alle andre og får reelt ansvar fra starten. Dine opgaver vil især ligge inden for teknisk support, kvalitetssikring og dokumentation, men der er også mulighed for at prøve kræfter med udvikling og automatisering. Du behøver ikke kunne det hele på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, struktureret og lærer hurtigt. Produkt- og brugersupport: Sammen med vores produktteams hjælper du brugerne, når noget driller eller kræver ekstra support. Nogle gange er du detektiv og hjælper med at løse et konkret problem, men lige så ofte arbejder du proaktivt med dokumentation, kommunikation og beredskab, så problemer enten undgås eller kan løses hurtigt. Kvalitet og dokumentation: God tech skal ikke bare virke, den skal også være sikker, veldokumenteret og compliant. Du hjælper med kvalitetssikring, dokumentation og vores Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) og sørger for, at vi har styr på kontroller og evidens omkring vores løsninger. Mindre udviklingsopgaver: Har du lyst til selv at bygge, vil der også være mulighed for det i ny og næ. Det kan være små scripts og automatiseringer, der fjerner manuelle trin i vores egne processer, dataudtræk og rapportering på tværs af systemer, eller mindre ændringer i vores løsninger sammen med en af udviklerne. Du får sparring og code review undervejs, så du lærer af det. Det er en mulighed, ikke et krav. Du er i gang med en relevant uddannelse inden for IT, business eller begge dele og er formentlig 1-2 år inde i dit studieforløb. Du har orden i penalhuset og synes selv, det er det fedeste med en clean kalender. Du er teknisk anlagt og elsker, når tech spiller, men drømmer ikke nødvendigvis om at blive full-blown udvikler. Du synes, det er oddly satisfying at strukturere komplekse data og gøre processer smartere. Du er servicemindet og har en naturlig can-do-attitude. Du tager selv fat og driver dine opgaver fremad, men opsøger samtidig feedback for at blive bedre Du er flydende i dansk og engelsk, da vi bruger begge sprog dagligt. Selv om du ikke kan sætte flueben ved alle punkter endnu, hører vi gerne fra dig, hvis du har den rette indstilling og mod på at lære hurtigt i et professionelt miljø. Hos Deloitte værdsætter vi forskellige kompetencer, perspektiver og erfaringer, fordi det gør os i stand til effektivt at løse komplekse udfordringer for vores klienter. Vi opfordrer dig derfor til at søge, hvis du mener, at dine kompetencer kan bidrage positivt til vores teams succes. Vil du være en del af vores team? Klik på knappen ”jeg er interesseret” ovenfor, hvis du er klar til at blive en del af vores team. Send din ansøgning, CV og karakterudskrift inden ansøgningsfristen d. 05.12.2026. Vi behandler ansøgninger og afholder samtaler løbende, så vi anbefaler dig at søge hurtigst muligt. Forventet startdato: 01.01.2027 eller 01.02.2027. Tøv ikke med at kontakte Mikkel Hvidtfeldt Andersen, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Vi opfordrer alle kandidater til at søge stillingen, uanset alder, køn (kønsidentitet eller kønsudtryk), seksuel orientering, religion, etnicitet, nationalitet eller handicap. Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig! In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference. Med mere end 8.000 medarbejdere er Deloitte en af de største rådgivnings- og revisionshuse i Norden. Vi hjælper vores kunder med at navigere komplekse teknologiske og forretningsmæssige transformationer ved at kombinere dyb faglig viden med førende kompetencer inden for revision, skat, rådgivning og konsulentydelser. Om teamet I Nordic A&A Technology nytænker og bygger vi IT til Deloittes Audit & Assurance-forretning, i Danmark, i Norden og globalt. Vi arbejder med stort set alle hjørner af tech, fra den første løse idé til løsninger, der bruges i arbejdet med nogle af verdens største virksomheder. Fokus på dig Som Business Analyst prøver du kræfter med mange forskellige typer opgaver, og vi tilpasser løbende rollen efter dine interesser og det, du bliver god til. Du arbejder tæt sammen med vores CTO, product managers og tech leads og bliver en slags højre hånd på tværs af teamet. Det giver dig et stærkt indblik i, hvordan man bygger, lancerer, driver og skalerer IT i en stor, global organisation.

HOW CAN YOU HELP US? Are you eager to contribute to IT projects and strengthen your business analysis, project management and digital skills within an international and dynamic environment? We are looking for interns to join our IT teams based in cities across Europe, including Brussels, Nantes, Barcelona, Hamburg, and in Bangalore, India . Our IT teams design, implement and continuously improve digital solutions that connect clients, laboratories and field operations across the Eurofins network. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to support business analysis, process improvement and digital transformation initiatives while collaborating with stakeholders from different countries and Eurofins companies. Depending on business needs and your interests, you may contribute to one of the following IT solutions: The Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) aims to standardise full laboratory processes, from sample registration and laboratory production to quality control, results reporting and invoicing. It provides a scalable global platform that improves efficiency while allowing laboratories to adapt the solution to local requirements. The B2B Integration Programme focuses on automating the exchange of information between clients' IT systems and the Eurofins laboratory network systems. Through digital connectivity solutions and client-facing platforms, the programme enables the seamless transmission of testing requests, sample information and analytical results, improving efficiency and data quality for both clients and laboratories. The Outside Service Management (OSM) Programme supports the digitalisation of field services and sample management activities. It ensures that client requests are integrated into the Eurofins network IT systems, facilitates the management of sampling operations, and enables the digital transmission of field data and sample information to laboratories for analysis. Potential projects may involve assessing new solutions, analysing current functionalities and migration options, and working with other IT stakeholders to develop prototypes or proofs of concept. Other opportunities could include automating reporting processes, developing an AI-powered copilot for issue investigation, etc. WHAT CAN WE DO FOR YOU? This is a unique opportunity to develop your skills alongside experienced IT professionals and play an active role in the digital transformation of a global network of laboratories. Languages: Professional proficiency in English is required. Any additional languages are a plus. Technical Knowledge: Exposure to data analytics, automation, AI technologies and system integrations, using tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, Power Automate or the Microsoft Power Platform, is a plus. Founded in 1983, Davidson Kempner is headquartered in New York and has offices in Philadelphia, London, Dublin, Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Mumbai, and Abu Dhabi. Our mandate is to conduct analysis and deliver data-driven, actionable insights in support of DK's investments and broader strategic priorities. Our work combines programming, statistical analysis, quantitative modeling, and an understanding of businesses and financial markets to address a broad range of investment research questions. The role focuses on applying quantitative research and analytical methods to support DK’s discretionary investment process, rather than developing systematic investment or algorithmic trading strategies. The intern will work alongside experienced quantitative research analysts on live projects, gaining hands-on experience in data sourcing, analysis, modeling, and the development of analytical tools. comfort with Excel. - Experience working with complex datasets and applying analytical or statistical methods to practical problems. - Exceptional attention to detail, with a strong commitment to accuracy, analytical rigor, and quality of work. - Genuine interest in financial markets, the broader economy, and applying quantitative analysis to a wide range of investment research questions - Familiarity with Databricks, visualization platforms, machine learning, or AI-assisted analytical tools is a plus, but not required. **Candidate Profile** - Intellectually curious, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and an interest in applying quantitative methods to real investment questions. - Self-motivated, organized, and capable of taking ownership of projects while managing multiple priorities. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly to investment professionals. - Collaborative, adaptable, and eager to learn in a fast-paced investment research environment. **What We're Looking For** Beyond academic achievement and technical ability, we're looking for individuals who demonstrate the qualities and potential to build successful careers at DK. Our EDGE framework sets out the behaviors that we value across the Firm, and for interns, we place particular emphasis on: - Intellectual curiosity and a learning mindset**:** A genuine desire to understand how businesses, markets and investment strategies work, with the curiosity to ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and learn from others. - Sound judgment and maturity**:** The ability to think independently, consider different perspectives, recognize when to seek guidance, and approach decisions with an appropriate awareness of risk. - Ownership and initiative**:** A willingness to take responsibility, follow through on commitments and look for ways to contribute beyond what is explicitly asked. - Commercial curiosity**:** An interest in understanding not just the analysis behind a decision, but why it matters to the Firm, its investors and its broader business. - Adaptability and openness to feedback**:** The confidence to step outside one's comfort zone, embrace unfamiliar challenges, and use feedback to improve. - A genuine one-firm mindset:Someone who values different perspectives, takes an interest in the success of others and is motivated by contributing to DK as a whole, rather than only to an individual team. **Compensation & Logistics** The internship is hours a week, in-person, based at Davidson Kempner’s New York headquarters. role: Apprentice Civil & Structural Engineer /Level 3 - Nuclear- Warrington- start August 27 onwards
description: Due to the continued growth and expansion of our Nuclear Team in our Warrington office we are looking to increase our technical workforce and are seeking to recruit a Civil & Structural Engineering Apprentice to work in our Warrington office from August 27 onwards on a permanent basis with the intention of enrolling them on the following course Civil Engineering Technician Apprenticeship About our Team At AECOM, our Nuclear Structures team provide multi-disciplinary consultancy to the nuclear industry in both the nuclear new build and decommissioning sectors. In the new build sector, we are providing engineering support to the Developers of the UK’s fleet of new nuclear power stations. In the Decommissioning Sector, which requires considerable new build to enable decommissioning, AECOM provides support to the entire Nuclear Estate, including multidisciplinary design support at Sellafield; early stage development of the Deep Geological Repository; design and development of waste storage and disposal facilities; and multidisciplinary design support to defence projects. An example project is Sellafield Pile 1 Diffuser Demolition where we were part of the consortium with other companies providing the CE&I, Mechanical and Process Design. The project scope was to demolish the Diffuser, a 1450 tonne Reinforced Concrete box section, at the top of the 110m high ventilation stack, located in the heart of a congested nuclear facility. AECOM played a significant role as the Lead Designer responsible for developing a safe demolition strategy for this contaminated structure, demonstrating stability at all stages and designing the associated civil and structural works, working with mechanical, electrical and process engineers, including delivery of the seismic and extreme wind load design for the foundations and structural supports to a 150m high tower crane, the tallest ever on the Sellafield site. The project challenged the Nuclear Industry’s traditional approach for labour intensive, low risk means of demolition, making use of the tower crane to cut and lift large blocks, arguing that the short-term increase in risk would lead to a quicker permanent decrease. This unique demolition is currently on-going and will be a very visible demonstration of the work being done to make Sellafield a safer place. Here's what you'll do: When an apprentice starts with AECOM, we pair them with a senior member of the team who will guide and mentor them through their initial period working on live projects and business development proposals. Their initial role will be involved in a selection of activities potentially including: Supporting the delivery of consultancy services on nuclear energy engineering projects. Developing an understanding of highly regulated industries Developing an understanding of Safety Cases and the supporting documentation Working with the project team, in particular with technicians that translate working designs into construction drawings Occasional site visits to construction sites would be a feature of this role. Attending college on average 1 day per week for 2 years to gain a Level 3 Civil Engineering Technician qualification Completing the End Point Assessment with the relevant governing body with potential to achieve Engineering Technician (EngTech) status upon the completion of the college course Enjoy the Perks At AECOM, you'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well-being, customised to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days. Here is what you will get from us! On the job support and learning. When an apprentice starts at AECOM, we pair them with a senior member of the team who will guide and mentor them through their initial period working on live projects and business development tasks, to support with any technical queries. We also offer our apprentices the flexibility of working on a range of projects in the various service offerings and technical specialisms that our Practice delivers. This helps establish their areas of interest, and develops a firm sustainability grounding, that will allow our apprentice to choose the direction of their career. Apprentice Development Programme In addition to your identified external training provision here our Apprentice ADVANCE programme is designed to help you build your career in AECOM. You will attend several instructor-led training sessions where you will meet and hear from people across the business and take part in a series of interactive activities to equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed in your role. We will provide you with all the support and tools you need to achieve your professional development ambitions, including Chartership with the relevant international professional institution. ### About Us Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems. **About Dash 2 Dynamics (D2)** D2 is building a new class of advanced communications systems powered by the integration of plasma physics, radio-frequency engineering, and novel antenna architectures. Our work is aimed at overcoming fundamental limits in conventional antennas and enabling communications capabilities that are smaller, more wideband, and more resilient in demanding environments. We are taking breakthrough technology from the laboratory through rapid prototyping, rigorous modeling and test, product qualification, and operational deployment. This is an opportunity to join a hands-on, multidisciplinary team working at the edge of electromagnetics, materials, electronics, plasma science, and mission-focused product development. The systems we are developing will reshape how defense, aerospace, and commercial users communicate across contested and congested RF environments. **About the Role** Dash 2 Dynamics (D2) is seeking a part-time Modeling & Simulation Engineer or advanced engineering intern to accelerate the design of plasma-enabled antennas and next-generation communications hardware. You will build electromagnetic and multiphysics models, run disciplined trade studies, and connect simulation results to laboratory measurements so the team can make faster, better design decisions. # What You Will Do ## Electromagnetic & Multiphysics Modeling - **Model physics that conventional antenna tools were never built for.** Build coupled electromagnetic–plasma models of plasma chambers, antennas, matching networks, and enclosures, capturing how plasma density, collision frequency, and discharge conditions reshape impedance, bandwidth, efficiency, and radiation patterns. - **Help push electrically small antennas beyond conventional limits.** Run frequency-domain, time-domain, and coupled-physics analyses to map fields, losses, and scaling behavior, with the boundary conditions, meshing discipline, and convergence checks needed to trust results in territory few have modeled before. ## Design Trades & Optimization - **Map the design space of an entirely new antenna class.** Plan parameter sweeps and trade studies across geometry, materials, plasma properties, control schemes, and packaging constraints to reveal which variables truly drive performance and where the next breakthrough lies. - **Turn simulation into decisions.** Screen concepts, quantify uncertainty, and build reusable, scriptable workflows that let the team iterate rapidly across product configurations and frequency bands, then translate results into clear recommendations on what to build and test next. ## Model-to-Test Correlation - **Close the loop between simulation and real hardware.** Partner with RF, electrical, mechanical, and test engineers to design experiments, then compare predictions against bench measurements of S-parameters, radiation patterns, and plasma behavior to sharpen the models with every test. - **Solve the mystery when hardware surprises us.** Dig into post-test analysis and root-cause investigations when measurements diverge from predictions, establishing uncertainty bounds and traceable model records that turn unexpected results into new insight. ## Technical Communication & Team Contribution - **Shape decisions on a first-of-its-kind technology.** Deliver technical notes, figures, and design-review material that directly inform architecture and prototype choices. Your analysis will drive what gets built, not sit in a drawer. - **Own meaningful work from day one.** Take ownership of well-bounded analysis tasks on a small multidisciplinary team, keeping models, scripts, inputs, and results reproducible and communicating confidence, limitations, and next steps with clarity. # Qualifications ## Required - Currently pursuing, or recently completed, an advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science, or a related field. - Coursework or project experience in electromagnetics, antennas, RF engineering, numerical methods, plasma physics, or related physics-based modeling. - Significant hands-on experience with at least one Finite Element Modeling simulation environment. - Ability to meet requirements associated with work on U.S. government and national-security programs. ## Preferred - Experience with COMSOL Multiphysics Plasma Module - Experience modeling antennas, RF structures, plasmas, resonators, high-voltage fields, or coupled multiphysics systems. - Strong fundamental knowledge of low-temperature RF glow discharge physics. - Familiarity with S-parameters, impedance matching, radiation patterns, meshing, solver convergence, uncertainty, and model validation. - Ability to assess model quality through convergence, sensitivity, validation, and careful documentation of assumptions. - Ability to translate analysis into concise findings and actionable design recommendations. - Strong initiative, intellectual honesty, and comfort working on open-ended technical problems. - Laboratory experience with RF test equipment, such as a vector network analyzer, spectrum analyzer, oscilloscope, RF source, or automated data acquisition. - Active U.S. security clearance or eligibility to obtain one. **Hourly Rate:** $70.00 - $80.00. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors. **Our Red Cell Partners Benefits (may differ for each incubation):** For full-time roles - Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows - 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family. - Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay. - Unlimited PTO, with management approval. - Opportunities for professional development and continued learning. - Optional 401K, FSA, and equity incentives available. - Mental health benefits are available through [Tara Mind](https://www.taramind.com/). - Cost effective GLP-1 solutions available through [Crux](https://soon.getcrux.com/). role: Apprentice Civil & Structural Engineer/Level 6 - Nuclear- Warrington- start August 27 onwards
description: Due to the continued growth and expansion of our Nuclear Team in our Warrington office we are looking to increase our technical workforce and are seeking to recruit a Civil & Structural Engineering Apprentice to work in our Warrington office from August 27 onwards on a permanent basis with the intention of enrolling them on the following course Civil Engineering BEng (Hons) | Liverpool | 2027 entry | Liverpool John Moores University About our Team At AECOM, our Nuclear Structures team provide multi-disciplinary consultancy to the nuclear industry in both the nuclear new build and decommissioning sectors. In the new build sector, we are providing engineering support to the Developers of the UK’s fleet of new nuclear power stations. In the Decommissioning Sector, which requires considerable new build to enable decommissioning, AECOM provides support to the entire Nuclear Estate, including multidisciplinary design support at Sellafield; early stage development of the Deep Geological Repository; design and development of waste storage and disposal facilities; and multidisciplinary design support to defence projects. An example project is Sellafield Pile 1 Diffuser Demolition where we were part of the consortium with other companies providing the CE&I, Mechanical and Process Design. The project scope was to demolish the Diffuser, a 1450 tonne Reinforced Concrete box section, at the top of the 110m high ventilation stack, located in the heart of a congested nuclear facility. AECOM played a significant role as the Lead Designer responsible for developing a safe demolition strategy for this contaminated structure, demonstrating stability at all stages and designing the associated civil and structural works, working with mechanical, electrical and process engineers, including delivery of the seismic and extreme wind load design for the foundations and structural supports to a 150m high tower crane, the tallest ever on the Sellafield site. The project challenged the Nuclear Industry’s traditional approach for labour intensive, low risk means of demolition, making use of the tower crane to cut and lift large blocks, arguing that the short-term increase in risk would lead to a quicker permanent decrease. This unique demolition is currently on-going and will be a very visible demonstration of the work being done to make Sellafield a safer place. Here's what you'll do: When an apprentice starts with AECOM, we pair them with a senior member of the team who will guide and mentor them through their initial period working on live projects and business development proposals. Their initial role will be involved in a selection of activities potentially including: Supporting the delivery of consultancy services on nuclear energy engineering projects. Supporting the preparation and analysis of structural element designs in a variety of materials, mainly steel and concrete Assist in preparation of design documentation such as basis of design, design method statements, specifications/technical reports Developing an understanding and ability to apply the key technical theories and practices associated with civil and structural engineering Developing an understanding of highly regulated industries Developing an understanding of Safety Cases and the supporting documentation Developing an understanding of risk and the preparation of designer’s risk assessments Working with the project team, in particular with technicians that translate working designs into construction drawings Assisting in providing support into the input of feasibility level studies for nuclear energy projects in conjunction with the wider AECOM teams. Assisting in securing work with nuclear energy developers and their supply chain Occasional site visits to construction sites would be a feature of this role. Attending University on average 1 day per week for 5 years to gain a Beng (Hons) Civil Engineering. Completing the End Point Assessment with the Institution of Civil Engineers with potential to achieve Incorporated Engineer (IEng) status upon the completion of the degree course Working towards full chartership status with one of the governing civil and structural institutions (Institution of Civil Engineers) Enjoy the Perks At AECOM, you'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well-being, customised to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days. Here is what you will get from us! On the job support and learning. When an apprentice starts at AECOM, we pair them with a senior member of the team who will guide and mentor them through their initial period working on live projects and business development tasks, to support with any technical queries. We also offer our apprentices the flexibility of working on a range of projects in the various service offerings and technical specialisms that our Practice delivers. This helps establish their areas of interest, and develops a firm sustainability grounding, that will allow our apprentice to choose the direction of their career. You will attend several instructor-led training sessions where you will meet and hear from people across the business and take part in a series of interactive activities to equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed in your role. We will provide you with all the support and tools you need to achieve your professional development ambitions, including Chartership with the relevant international professional institution. role: UK Summer Internship 2027 - Solutions AI LAB
description: ### About Baringa Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding. The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation. Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors. Certified as a *Great Place to Work* around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the *Financial Times* in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by *Forbes* for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms. ### Baringa is looking for talented 2027 Summer Interns to join our Solutions & AI Lab team. ### Our Internship Our eight week Summer Internship Programme is designed to give you hands-on experience, meaningful responsibility, and a true insight into life at Baringa. Over the course of the programme, you’ll work alongside experienced consultants and specialists on real projects, develop valuable skills through tailored learning opportunities, and build connections across the business. Whether you’re exploring your career options or looking to kick-start your professional journey, our internship offers a supportive environment where you can learn, grow, and make an impact. ### What's in it for you? Well, it’s up to you. Baringa is what you make it. Our Summer Internship Programme is designed to help you build your skills, expand your network, and gain first-hand experience of consulting. As well as making a meaningful contribution from day one, you'll have the chance to explore future career opportunities at Baringa, including the opportunity to be considered for a permanent Analyst role after graduation. Our Summer Internship opportunities are available across a range of our Capability business units. Explore the summaries below to learn more about each team and discover where your skills and interests could make an impact. You can also find additional information about each team on our website. ### About our Solutions & AI Lab Team: Our Solutions & AI Labs (SAIL) practice focuses on helping clients control their data, turn them into actionable insights and better leverage them through the use of Machine Learning solutions directly embedded into business processes. We support clients across a number of industries and offer deep expertise in AI, ML, Cloud and Managed Solutions. We are seeking passionate and dynamic ML engineers who are excited by building production Machine Learning solutions. *Desirable skills & degrees: A degree in a STEM related field is required, but degrees in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics and Engineering are preferred.* ### Requirements - Applicants should be graduating in 2028 and be in the penultimate year of their bachelor’s or master’s Degree studies. - Applicants must have the permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future. All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre. Please note *we’re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.* Any questions surrounding this please contact us at [earlycareers@baringa.com](mailto:earlycareers@baringa.com) ### Key dates Assessment centres: January 2027 Internship start: Monday 5th July 2027 Internship end: Friday 27th August 2027 *This is a paid full-time internship.* For further information, please read our [Summer Internship 2027 pack](https://www.baringa.com/globalassets/careers/graduate/pdfs-and-downloads/global-summer-internship-pack-2026.pdf) ### What a career at Baringa will give you ### Putting People First. ### Diversity and Inclusion We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. ### An award-winning workplace You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. [Click here](https://www.baringa.com/en/impact/awards/) to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. ### Using business as a force for good. We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act.
