Het resultaat is een integraal spoorontwerp dat perfect past in de beschikbare ruimte. Dit proces kent meerdere iteraties en kan een complexe, maar uitdagende puzzel zijn. Mooie voorbeelden van projecten waarin deze disciplines samenkomen zijn de Uithoflijn, Bereikbare Regio – OVAH , de Wunderline Groningen–Bremen , Driebergen-Zeist , de Nedersaksenlijn en de spooromgeving Geldermalsen . Naast ontwerpen kunnen je werkzaamheden bestaan uit: Het opstellen van contractdocumenten; Het doen van opnames langs de spoorbaan; Het uitvoeren van inspecties langs de spoorbaan; Het meeontwikkelen in onze digitale ambitie; Je gaat werken aan Nederlandse en buitenlandse projecten binnen de sector Transportation. Je werkdagen kunnen zeer divers zijn. Zo kan het zijn dat je de ene dag met nederlandse collega’s aan een nederlands project werkt en de andere dag met buitenlandse collega’s aan een buitenlands project. Service Area Civil and Rail Je gaat aan de slag binnen de Service Area Civil and Rail, een afdeling die bestaat uit Wegen en Rail teams. Jij wordt specifiek onderdeel van het team Rail Design. Onze vesitiging in Amersfoort is de standplaats van het team. De Service Area Civil and Rail valt binnen de Service Design and Engineering Europa / UK en Ierland. Kwalificaties & Ervaring: Je hebt een passie voor infrastructurele projecten en kunt je daar volledig in vastbijten. Je brengt innovatieve ideeën in en houdt ervan om structuur aan te brengen in je werk. Een belangrijke eigenschap is dat je altijd blijft denken aan de integraliteit van het project: jij bent immers een essentieel onderdeel van het grotere geheel van het integrale spoorontwerp. Daarnaast beschik je over de volgende kwalificaties: Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in civiele techniek of een andere technische richting met ontwerpkennis; Bij voorkeur enige ervaring binnen railontwerp; Het vermogen om zowel op hoog niveau (vogelvluchtperspectief) als op detailniveau te werken; Innovatieve ideeën en de ambitie om mee te denken over nieuwe ontwikkelingen in het ontwerpproces; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; Kennis van ontwerpsoftware zoals AutoCAD en/of Civil 3D; Sterke competenties om goed samen te werken in een team; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden; Een gedreven instelling om projecten tot een kwalitatief hoogstaand resultaat te brengen. Waarom Arcadis? We bereiken onze doelen door iedereen in staat te stellen het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Wij geloven dat ieders bijdrage ertoe doet. Daarom pionieren we met een aanpak gebaseerd op jouw vaardigheden en bouwen we aan een ‘Skills Powered Organisation’. Met jouw unieke ervaring en expertise stippel je zo je eigen carrièrepad uit. Samen maximaliseren we de impact! Jouw werk maakt het verschil. Welke rol je ook speelt, je helpt duurzame oplossingen te bieden voor een gezondere planeet. Mogelijkheid tot hybride werken, gefaciliteerd door passende thuiswerkvergoeding en een professioneel ingerichte werkplek thuis. Goede pensioenregeling bij het Nederlandse Pensioenfonds (HNPF) waarbij Arcadis het grootste deel van de premie betaalt. role: Internship / Master Thesis: AI Enhanced Crisis Management
description: Start date: February 2027 · Duration: 6 months Please include your latest academic transcripts with your application. Applications submitted without transcripts will not be considered. How hard can it be to rebuild an entire website from its source code, with a new brand identity and the latest web frameworks, while keeping all its features? Today, AI coding agents can accelerate individual tasks, but a reliable, fully autonomous rewrite remains a challenge. In this 6-month internship or master thesis starting in February 2027, within ELCA's Digital Agency, you will prototype a specification-driven AI framework for complete website rewrites. The team of agents will analyse the source code, document the existing behaviour, plan a new architecture and build a new codebase in the chosen language and stack, with the same features and new branding. You will also explore how to verify that the rebuilt site preserves every feature, how agents detect regressions and improve through iterations, and how to define working rules, monitor progress and optimize token usage. Your tasks Review agent frameworks and specification-driven approaches; define the target stack and rebranding brief Generate specifications and acceptance tests from the source website to capture the behaviour that must be preserved Prototype a team of agents that plans and builds a new codebase in the target language, with shared context and autonomous task coordination Explore and prototype approaches to iterative self-verification, assessing how well agents detect and correct functional and branding gaps Define guardrails and quality gates; track agent actions, progress and test results through monitoring What we offer A dynamic, collaborative workplace with a highly motivated, multicultural team working across international sites The chance to make a difference in people's lives by building innovative solutions Internal coding events such as Hackathons and Brownbag sessions, plus our technical blog Monthly After-Works organized at each location About your profile Web development knowledge and interest in software architecture and language migration Interest in LLMs, coding agents, prompt design and specification-driven development Familiarity with automated testing, Git and continuous integration; browser testing is a plus Ability to analyse existing code, document behaviour and design automated validation Attention to user experience, design consistency, accessibility and software quality

role: Human-Centered AI Research Intern, Human Language Models
description: At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences. This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role. [Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns!](https://www.tri.global/tri-internship-program) **The Team** This internship opportunity falls within the Adaptive Behavior Systems team of Human-Centered AI Division (HCAI). We are an integrated team of researchers with backgrounds in machine learning, the behavioral sciences, and human-computer interaction. At the core of our work, we aim to create technologies that prioritize human-centered outcomes and enable purposeful human futures. **The Internship** We are seeking a PhD research intern to join our Adaptive Behavior Systems team to push the boundaries of LLM-based human modeling and simulation. The intern will collaborate with our interdisciplinary team to study how language-based generative machine learning models represent human intentions and behavior and develop methods for evaluating how well these models capture individual differences and diverse human perspectives. The project will be focused on a specific sub-area of the overall research program. The intern will further engage in strategy discussions about how the research connects to business impact at Toyota. This is a Summer 2027 paid 12-week internship opportunity. Please note that this internship will be a hybrid in-office role. ### Responsibilities In collaboration with your mentor and the other researchers in the department, you will: - Scope a research project to align with our core research efforts - Be the primary driver of the technical plan (e.g., problem formulation, model development, evaluation design) with regular feedback from your mentor and teammates - Execute the project using TRI resources - Present the project’s approach and findings in research meetings to the Adaptive Behavior Systems Department, the HCAI Division, and TRI, as well as for stakeholders from Toyota business groups Our goal is that you end the internship with work that informs internal strategy and may be publishable in an academic journal or conference. ### Qualifications - Ph.D. Student in related fields - AI/ML, computer science, computational social science, or related field - Research experience with LLMs and a publication record in relevant topics. Relevant areas include: LLM evaluation and benchmarking, personalization and user modeling, LLM post-training and alignment, and computational human modeling. - Experience with Python programming and DL frameworks like PyTorch. - Interest in human-centered research (e.g. behavioral science, computational social science). - Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences. This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role. [Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns!](https://www.tri.global/tri-internship-program) **The Team/Project** TRI's Robotics Division develops technologies that enable robots to operate effectively in complex, real-world environments. The project explores how foundation-model agents can understand manipulation tasks, reason about physical environments, and orchestrate reusable robotic capabilities to accomplish diverse objectives. Our research combines vision-language models, robotic perception, motion planning, manipulation, and robot learning. We investigate these questions through hands-on experimentation on physical robotic platforms. **The Challenge** Recent advances in foundation models have significantly improved AI systems' ability to understand visual scenes, reason about tasks, and plan sequences of actions. However, translating these capabilities into reliable physical robot behavior remains challenging. Robots must reason about three-dimensional geometry, physical constraints, contact interactions, and failures during execution. An important research question is how far foundation-model agents can go by leveraging existing robotic capabilities, and when specialized learned policies become necessary. **The Opportunity** We are seeking a Robotics Research Intern to investigate agentic approaches to robotic manipulation. You will work closely with researchers and engineers to develop systems that connect foundation-model reasoning with physical robot capabilities. Depending on your background and research interests, your project may focus on spatial reasoning, robotic skill orchestration, execution monitoring, failure recovery, or systematic evaluation of agentic manipulation systems. This internship offers an opportunity to tackle open research questions while gaining practical experience with cutting-edge AI models and real robotic systems. Your work will contribute to understanding how foundation-model agents can enable more generalizable and reliable robot autonomy. ### Responsibilities - Develop and evaluate agentic approaches that use vision-language models to reason about and execute robotic manipulation tasks. - Integrate foundation-model agents with reusable robotic capabilities, including perception, motion planning, grasping, and manipulation. - Investigate challenges in three-dimensional spatial reasoning, robot action feasibility, execution monitoring, and failure recovery. - Design and conduct experiments on physical robotic platforms or in simulation. - Analyze system performance, characterize failure modes, and evaluate generalization across tasks and environments. - Communicate research findings through technical presentations, demonstrations, reports, and potential publications. ### Qualifications - Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. - Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python and experience developing, testing, or debugging technical software. - Solid understanding of robotics fundamentals, including one or more of robot kinematics, dynamics, motion planning, perception, or control. - Experience with robotics-related projects through research, coursework, or personal projects, using physical hardware and/or simulation. - Ability to formulate technical problems, design experiments, and systematically analyze results. - Interest in robotic manipulation, autonomous systems, and connecting high-level reasoning with physical robot capabilities. ### Bonus Qualifications - Hands-on experience with robotic manipulators, motion planning frameworks, or robot simulation environments. - Familiarity with 3D geometry, computer vision, grasp planning, or contact-rich manipulation. - Experience with ROS/ROS 2, or robotics software frameworks. - Experience with vision-language models, LLM agents, or autonomous planning systems. - Familiarity with robot learning methods such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or vision-language-action models. - Research experience demonstrated through publications, open-source contributions, or substantial technical projects.

role: Automated Driving Advanced Development Intern, Machine Learning Research
description: At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences. This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role. [Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns!](https://www.tri.global/tri-internship-program) At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences. This is a Summer 2027 paid 12-week internship opportunity. Please note that this internship will be a hybrid in-office role. **The Team** The Automated Driving Advanced Development division at TRI will focus on enabling innovation and transformation at Toyota by building a bridge between TRI research and Toyota products, services, and needs. We achieve this through partnership, collaboration, and shared commitment. This new division is leading a new cross-organizational project between TRI and Woven by Toyota to conduct research and develop a fully end-to-end learned driving stack. This cross-org collaborative project is harmonious with TRI’s robotics divisions' efforts in Diffusion Policy and Large Behavior Models. **The Internship** We are looking for Machine Learning Research Interns to join our autonomy team and help bring end-to-end ML models ( pixels to trajectories ) into robust, testable, and deployable systems. This role is ideal for those who thrive at the intersection of machine learning, systems engineering, and real-world deployment. This internship opportunity is a paid 12-week internship for Summer 2027. Please note that this internship will be a hybrid in-office role. You’ll contribute to the implementation, evaluation, and integration of ML-based components for perception, planning, and control; with simulation-based testing. You’ll work closely with researchers, data engineers, and autonomy engineers to ensure models scale from prototype to production. This work is part of Toyota’s global AI efforts to build a more coordinated global approach across Toyota entities. ### Responsibilities - Conduct ambitious research to advance the state-of-the-art in using new capabilities in generative modelling for end-to-end planning from vision in automated driving. - Implement scalable end-to-end architectures that process raw sensor data to generate vehicle trajectories, addressing the challenges of long-tail driving scenarios with low data coverage. - Prototype, validate, and iterate on model architectures using imitation learning, and large-scale data, ensuring robust performance across diverse scenarios. - Perform closed-loop evaluations in sensor simulations and real-world testing environments. - Explore multi-modal and language-conditioned models to broaden the applicability of end-to-end policies, leveraging external data sources and transfer learning to enhance generalization. ### Qualifications - Currently pursuing a Ph.D. or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, or a related field. - Proficiency in Python for implementing and evaluating research ideas. - Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch. - Understanding of version control, testing, and software engineering fundamentals. - Passion for collaborative engineering and building reliable ML systems that support real-world autonomy. ### Bonus Qualifications - Experience in ML engineering workflows: data sampling and curation, pre-processing, model training, ablation studies, evaluation, deployment, inference optimization. - Understanding of debugging and profiling on NVIDIA CUDA stack. - Hands-on experience with metrics dashboards, experiment tracking, and ML ops tooling (e.g., Weights & Biases, MLflow, Metaflow). - Hands-on experience working with robotics or real-world sensor data (e.g., video, lidar, IMU, or radar). - Experience in state-of-the-art architectures for object detection and 3D perception. - Familiarity with foundation models, pre-training and efficient fine-tuning, multimodal Transformer architectures, large-scale distributed training. - Experience working with ROS, simulation frameworks (e.g., CARLA, Nvidia DriveSim), or vehicle interfaces. - Experience with robot motion planning techniques like trajectory optimization, sampling-based planning, or model predictive control, or experience with automated driving domains (e.g., perception, prediction, mapping, localization, planning, simulation).

role: Apprenticeship Networks, Applicant Outreach and Event Coordination Internship (Start Date: December 2026/ January 2027)
description: Note to applicants: Interns in the Apprenticeship Networks department of our organization will work out of the GACC Midwest office in Chicago. Assist in outreach events and presentations with partners (virtual and in-person) to inform potential applicants about the program and generate interest Strategic Relationship Management Through Event Coordination & Marketing Activities Support event coordination, including marketing aspects, for webinars, study trips, and graduations. Rejoignez un cabinet qui réinvente les métiers du conseil grâce à l’IA et investit durablement dans votre épanouissement professionnel. Développez les expertises d’avenir et donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière chez Sia. role: 2027 Spring Health Policy, Research, and Advocacy Internship (Globally Remote, Unpaid)
description: About the role Global Health Action is looking for a Policy, Research, and Advocacy Intern. The Intern will provide programmatic, research, and analytical support to the Health Systems Advisor at Global Health Action. S/he will gain valuable knowledge and experience about the complex system and factors affecting health policy at international and national levels and how to influence them. This internship requires 20hrs/week (mandatory: Thursdays 10am-2pm EST; Five Orientation days 10am-2pm EST). This is a part-time, unpaid internship opportunity. Internship timeframe: A minimum of 10 weeks (February 1 - April 9, 2027) for 20 hrs per week. The position is remote from anywhere in the world, with the option to be hybrid. The intern will have the opportunity to become exposed to pressing ethical issues in global health, become familiar with working with coalitions and collaborative concepts, and work with a supervisor who is interested in mentoring. A maximum of 2 openings are available for this role. Click here to listen to what our prior interns have to say . What you'll do Conduct health policy research and analysis on topics relevant to global health and development and draft summary/position papers/policy briefs Monitor and track policy developments and team activities Analyze state and federal legislation related to global health, development, health workers, and other health issues of concern to communities in low-resourced settings Attend meetings and events, take detailed notes, and report back Research, draft, edit, and format public-facing content and materials, such as talking points, briefs, and reports Other duties and tasks as assigned Learning Outcomes: Will learn about core elements of the U.S. and Global policymaking process, the roles of various parties and key stakeholders in crafting policy, and GHA’s issue areas Will gain experience conducting research and analysis for policy and advocacy aims Will learn about administrative and legislative advocacy strategies Will have the opportunity to observe, interact, and network with INGO partners and coalitions Will learn about the process of coordinating advocacy across an international NGO Qualifications , Graduate student preferred Excellent written, oral, multitasking and interpersonal communications skills (writing sample required) Knowledge of, or interest in, global health or foreign policy Knowledge of internet research sources, including media search engines Familiarity with the federal legislative process Proficient in Microsoft Word (including creating graphs, charts, and tables), Excel, and PowerPoint Ability to multitask , and prioritize various tasks in a fast-paced work environment Facility with social media. Ability to work productively in a team environment as well as under minimal supervision, taking the initiative to ask questions as needed Academic and/or legal research and analysis skills are a plus Graphic design skills and experience creating visual materials are a plus Please be prepared to upload a cover letter, resume, and writing sample when applying. Please include your available days and times. The resume should be no longer than three pages . A research paper is preferred. Applications submitted without a cover letter, resume, and writing sample will not be considered . We recommend submitting your complete application promptly, as positions will close w hen we have received about 10 applicants per opening. GHA is a private, nonprofit organization with a proven history of designing and conducting leadership and management training, community-based health promotion programs, and developing local and regional community health networks worldwide. GHA’s mission is to engage with communities around the world to drive transformational change for the health and well-being of all by focusing on women, children, and adolescents. GHA has trained more than 10,000 health professionals and community leaders from 97 countries around the globe. These efforts have stimulated the creation of thousands of sustainable health and development programs addressing the world’s most pressing health problems. GHA continues to incorporate into all core programs participatory health training and collaboration with global and community-based non-governmental organizations, government agencies on all levels, faith-based organizations, universities, and other communities.

About Marex Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world’s major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 2,300 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas. For more information visit Department Description Marex’s Algo and Flow department, formerly WEBB Traders, brings together expertise in proprietary trading, electronic market making, and quantitative research. The department provides liquidity across global cash equity and derivatives markets, using proprietary capital, advanced technology, and automated trading strategies. This role sits within the WEBB team, whose roots date back to 2009. Based in Amsterdam, with a significant presence in Paris, the team combines its entrepreneurial approach and specialist trading expertise with Marex’s global reach, market access, and broader financial services capabilities. Market makers, quantitative researchers, software engineers, and business professionals work closely together to develop trading strategies, improve technology, and solve complex market challenges. Joining the team offers the opportunity to take ownership, contribute directly to the business, and grow within the wider Marex Group. Role Summary Join our systematic equity options market making desk as it expands across US and European markets. Working alongside traders, quants, and developers, you'll help improve the models and tools behind our automated quoting, from volatility surface fitting to quoting performance, and get hands-on exposure to monitoring a live trading system. It's a chance to see how a market making business runs end to end, and to make contributions with a measurable impact on trading. This internship is intended for students currently pursuing a Master's degree in a quantitative discipline, or recent Bachelor's graduates undertaking a gap year prior to further study. The minimum internship duration is 6 months. Responsibilities Analyse the quality of our volatility surface fits across underlyings, identify and implement improvements Study quoting performance (spreads, fill rates, adverse selection, capture) and propose data-driven changes to make our markets tighter and more competitive Support production monitoring of the automated trading system, helping to flag anomalies, investigate issues, and improve alerting and dashboards Build analysis tools and scripts in our research environment to make this work repeatable Present findings and recommendations to the desk Competencies: Analytical rigour: you question results, check your assumptions, and let data drive conclusions Curiosity about markets and a genuine interest in how options are priced and traded Ownership and reliability, especially when working near a live production system Clear communication, so you can explain technical findings to traders and developers Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to work independently once pointed in a direction Skills and Experience: Currently pursuing a Master degree in a quantitative field (mathematics, financial engineering, or similar) Solid programming skills in Python, including pandas and NumPy Strong foundations in probability, statistics, and numerical methods Good understanding of options theory: pricing models, greeks, implied volatility dynamics and volatility surface construction Prior trading, research, or quant internship experience is a plus Conduct Rules You must: Act with integrity Act with due skill, care and diligence Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly Observe proper standard of market conduct Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers Company Values Be collaborative - by working together across the organisation, we foster teamwork, can better respond to challenges and successfully deliver for our clients Act with integrity - we pride ourselves on our honesty and high ethical standards. We apply these values when working with all our clients, colleagues and other stakeholders Be adaptable and entrepreneurial - we embrace change as markets evolve to constantly increase our efficiency and create innovative solutions for our clients. We are interested in the world around us and inquisitive about understanding the challenges and opportunities our clients face. Be respectful – how we treat each other, and our clients says everything about who we are. We always act respectfully and treat people fairly in everything we do. Nurture talent – we aim to grow our own talent and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking and talented people choose to build their career. This means giving and taking stretch opportunities, taking risks, and committing to career development and support – for ourselves, and our teams. Marex is fully committed to being an inclusive employer and providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will provide reasonable adjustments to remove any disadvantage to you being considered for this role. We value the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company. We welcome applications from candidates returning to the workforce. Also, Marex is committed to avoiding circumstances in which the appearance or possibility of conflicts of interest may exist within the hiring process. If you would like to receive any information in a different way or would like us to do anything differently to help you, please include it in your application.

In a nutshell: 4 to 6-month internship in our RevOps team at our Munich headquarters (hybrid), starting between February and April 2027, with the opportunity to move into a full-time role straight afterwards. ### ## About this role at Luminovo Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we have recently expanded into North America and the rest of Europe. GTM engineering at Luminovo is part of Revenue Operations, the department that sits between marketing, sales and customer success and makes sure our revenue organisation runs smoothly. Our go-to-market engineering function builds the systems that find the right companies and the right people for our sales team: target lists, data enrichment, hyper-personalised outbound campaigns that signal our sellers whom to call next. We work closely with Account Executives, the BDR team and marketing and directly contribute to pipeline generation. As our GTM engineering intern, you will run outbound campaigns end to end and help build the next layer: signal-based lead generation. You will also help us improve account scoring and build AI automations that take manual work off our sales reps. There is no textbook for this role. You will learn it the way we did: by building, shipping and seeing what works. By the end of your internship, you will have shipped revenue systems that our sales & marketing teams rely on every day, and gained hands-on experience in go-to-market engineering, one of the hottest roles on the market right now! You will also see first-hand how a modern B2B start-up operates day to day, with AI built into its workflows. ## This role is for you - You combine technical thinking with commercial curiosity: perhaps you studied engineering and want to understand how companies sell, or you have discovered a passion for the commercial side of start-ups. - You are keen to work in a fast-paced environment and to grow alongside a high-growth start-up. - You bring the drive to learn quickly, a sharp analytical mind and the ambition to take on real responsibility from your first weeks. You collaborate well, ask questions without hesitation and are happy to get your hands dirty. - You use AI as more than a better search engine. You have built your own automations, workflows or tools, and can explain what you shipped and what came of it. - You are fluent in both German and English. Much of our outbound targets buyers in the DACH region, while the company operates in English. - You stand out if you have built something entrepreneurial during your studies, be it a side project, a student society or a small business. - You have first experience in GTM engineering, sales operations or automation (this is a big advantage but not a requirement!) ## Your performance objectives ### 🧬 Run outbound campaigns - **Deliver multichannel campaigns end to end.** Build target lists, source and enrich the right contacts, and write the messaging in German and English. - **Go where coverage is thin.** Your campaigns will go wherever our sellers need the most support or wherever there is an opportunity worth pursuing, starting with DACH and extending to the rest of Europe and North America. Take on event campaigns, new regions and opportunistic plays, and turn them around to contribute to our pipeline. ### 🌀 Build signals and tooling - **Ship signals.** Build plugins or scrapers that generate high-intent leads for our sellers. - **Process scaling.** Transform website engagement into automated outbound triggers and create repeatable playbooks. ### ⚙️ Build automations - **Remove manual work.** Automate the repetitive manual tasks our revenue teams deal with day to day. - **Challenge what exists.** Get to know the systems we have built, then tell us where they fall short and help improve them. ### 💶 Unblock the sales team - **Understand what sales reps need.** Work closely with our AEs and BDRs, get to know their accounts and processes, and remove the friction that slows them down. - **Close the loop.** Feed what you learn from replies and campaign results back to sales and marketing. ### 🗂 Own the data - **Own enrichment and imports.** Take responsibility for account enrichment and every data import into HubSpot on contact, company and lead level. - **Keep data accuracy high.** You will be responsible for maintaining our enrichment so that data stays clean and workflows keep firing. ## Your Toolkit You will learn to work with the most modern sales automation tools on the market, such as Clay, n8n, Twain, Lusha, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and many more. ## Work location Our **Munich** headquarters. For your first two months you will be in the office most days, so you get to know the product, the team, our ICP and the basics of our market. After that, the role is **hybrid**, with the flexibility to work from home. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered). ## Whom you will be working with - [**Max Hungenbach**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maxhungenbach/), Revenue Operations Team Lead and your line manager - [**Danny Bodnar**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danny-bodnar/), GTM Engineer, your mentor and day-to-day coach - [**Clifton Lobo**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cliftonlobo/), VP Global Sales. You will work directly with him on GTM strategy. - [**Dasha Vyazemskaya**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dasha-vyazemskaya/), Head of BDR and your partner on handing campaigns over to the BDR team - [**George Knight**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/george-k-16704a95/), Demand Generation Manager in Marketing and your partner on campaigns run alongside marketing - **Our Account Executives and BDRs** across Europe and North America, for whom your campaigns run ## Skills, knowledge, and expertise Just so you know, we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV. If you’re interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles, see [here](https://medium.com/startup-grind/why-we-banned-requirements-from-our-job-descriptions-33a774e1a1c2). ### # # **⚡️ About Luminovo** Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the [trillion-dollar electronics industry](https://luminovo.com/resources/blog/a-short-primer-on-the-electronics-industry?utm_campaign=employer_branding&utm_source=candidate-traffic). We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress. ***We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.*** To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have [raised more than €20 million](https://luminovo.com/resources/blog/luminovo-raises-eu11-million-in-seed-funding-to-fix-the-broken-electronics-value-chain-with-transformative-software-suite). **Our core principles: putting people first & building great things** As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍 Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things. We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at. See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on [kununu](https://www.kununu.com/de/luminovo) and [Glassdoor](https://www.glassdoor.de/Bewertungen/luminovo-ai-Bewertungen-E2039308.htm).

description: **About Us** SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. **Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja**, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world. **AI at SharkNinja** At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in. **Job Name:** Spring 2027: CMF Industrial Design Co-op (January through June) **Work Period:** January through June **Location & Schedule:** This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position with 5 days per week onsite in Needham, MA. **There is no relocation or housing assistance for this position.** **Compensation Range:** Ranges from$28/hr - $34/hr. Specific compensation is set according to a standardized scale aligned with your educational level at the time of hire. **Join the SharkNinja Early Edge Experience:** Built for early talent. Geared toward impact. Driven by speed. Whether you're in a co-op or internship, our early talent program is designed to provide valuable exposure to the industry and a fast-paced professional environment. You’ll dive into meaningful projects and tasks that sharpen your skills and deepen your knowledge. role: Juniora Analysts till Deloitte Digital (Stockholm) - Jan 2027
description: Inom Deloitte Digital stödjer du Deloittes kunder med strategi, rådgivning och systemimplementation för att utveckla deras e-handels-, försäljning-, kundservice- och marknadsföringsfunktioner. En stor del av ditt arbete inkluderar implementation av system så som Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Adobe som Commercetools. Förutom systemutveckling bygger Deloitte Digital skräddarsydda lösningar i tech stacks som React, Next.js, Swift, Kotlin. I vårt team finner du utvecklare (frontend / backend), applikationsspecialister, kravanalytiker och verksamhetsutvecklare. Hos oss kommer du kunna stärka din tekniska kompetens och jobba med bland annat utveckling, teknisk arkitektur, data och systemintegration. Du kommer att arbeta nära klient för att stärka deras kundupplevelse genom strategiska och taktiska initiativ samtidigt som du utvecklar djup branschkunskap och verksamhetsförståelse. Vi söker dig som: Är nyexaminerad med en masterexamen inom systemvetenskap eller ingenjörsvetenskap, med inriktning mot data. Har relevant arbetserfarenhet eller stort intresse för data, kodning och systemutveckling samt businessförståelse och bransch-kompetens. Meriterande: Goda studieresultat, internationell erfarenhet och relevant engagemang vid sidan av studierna Goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift Erfarenhet av att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans i ett team, med målmedvetenhet, engagemang och driv Intresse för hur digitalisering / AI och ny teknik kan utveckla verksamheter och branscher Om du är osäker på om du uppfyller ovan kvalifikationer uppmuntrar vi dig att skicka in en ansökan ändå. Vi erbjuder Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor som är experter inom sina områden. Du får arbeta med spännande, komplexa uppdrag, både på global och nordisk nivå, i team som alltid värderar ditt perspektiv. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att erbjuda dig möjligheter att driva din personliga utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig praktisk erfarenhet, en personlig coach som långsiktigt stöttar dig i din karriär och kontinuerlig feedback och support från mer erfarna kollegor. Du får möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag som hjälper andra aktörer i deras resa mot en mer hållbar organisation, samtidigt som vi arbetar målmedvetet med våra egna ambitioner inom både klimat, miljö och socialt ansvar. Vi ser ett värde i att våra medarbetare har olika erfarenheter vilket främjar nytänkande och bidrar till fler perspektiv. Ansökan Du ansöker online. Din ansökan ska bestå av: CV Betygskopior från högskola/universitet - De betyg som du laddar upp bör inte vara utdragna senare än 2 månader tillbaka i tiden. I det första steget laddar du upp ditt CV. I nästa steg laddar du upp dina universitetsbetyg (över hittills avklarade kurser) samt svarar på frågor som är kopplade till rollen, inklusive en motivering till varför du sökt denna roll. Observera att både CV samt fullständiga betyg behöver laddas upp för att din ansökan ska ses som fullständig. Vi tillämpar löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid inskickad ansökan ska du få ett bekräftelsemejl från oss. Får du inte detta mejl råder vi dig att skicka in din ansökan på nytt. Om du söker flera tjänster hos oss ber vi dig att i dina ansökningar tydliggöra vilken roll du är mest intresserad av. Som ett kvalitativt led i Deloittes rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll, detta för att öka kännedomen om våra framtida medarbetare, trygga arbetsmiljön för våra medarbetare och möta regelkrav. Processen för bakgrundskontroller genomförs i samarbete med ToFindOut. . För de tjänster som Deloitte efterfrågar universitetsbetyg genomförs en verifiering som en del i rekryteringsprocessen. För frågor hänvisar vi till ansvarig rekryterare i processen. Frågor Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare William Lim, Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! What impact will you make? På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential. Deloitte är en globalt ledande leverantör av Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal och Consultative Services. Med mer än 470 000 medarbetare i över 150 länder hjälper vi våra klienter och vår omvärld att lösa komplexa problem och nå ambitiösa mål genom områdes- och branschexpertis, global räckvidd och allianser med de största tech-leverantörerna. Det som definierar Deloitte är vår strävan efter att göra en meningsfull skillnad. För oss innebär det långsiktig utveckling och resultat för våra klienter och deras företag, idéer och handlingar som också bidrar till en positiv samhällsutveckling. Det handlar även om att stärka våra medarbetare och främja deras utveckling.

## About Lendable Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people - Among the **fastest-growing tech** companies in the UK - Profitable since **2017** - Backed by top investors including **Balderton Capital** and **Goldman Sachs** - **Loved by customers** with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on [Trustpilot](https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: **loans, credit cards and car finance**. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks **with dated systems and painful processes.** ## Join us if you want to 1. **Take ownership:** you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 2. **Work in small teams of exceptional people:** Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions 3. **Build the best technology in-house**: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting We’re looking for an analytical, commercially-minded **Junior Strategy Analyst** to help us **grow and scale the product exponentially**. This is a dynamic role where you’ll tackle high impact business problems across a number of disciplines including pricing, growth, credit risk, new product development and product analytics. You’ll help us solve our most complex multi-dimensional challenges, working cross-functionally to deliver insight-driven strategies that optimise performance, drive responsible growth, and put the customer at the heart of decision-making. You’ll operate in a fast-paced environment where ideas matter more than hierarchy, and execution beats bureaucracy. Your work will directly influence who we serve, how we grow, and how we deliver sustainable value. **Key Responsibilities** **Drive pricing & promotions optimisation:** - Support the development and optimisation of pricing and promotional strategies across our channels and products through data-driven analysis, balancing customer engagement, growth, price elasticity and profitability, while continuously refining approaches based on product performance and scenario modelling - Analyse performance at channel, product and customer segment level to identify opportunities to improve pricing, product and conversion efficiency - Build insight into conversion funnel performance and highlight where cost or conversion can be improved - Stay abreast of industry trends and market activity to ensure our products remain competitive and fit for purpose **Pricing experimentation & impact assessment:** - Design, set up and run pricing tests and product A/B and multivariate experiments, working with Product, Data Science and Engineering to ensure they are implemented correctly - Track experiment performance against pre-agreed success metrics and guardrails, and deliver clear readouts with recommendations on whether to roll out, iterate or stop - Measure the realised impact of commercial initiatives after launch, and compare outcomes against the original business case - Build and maintain monitoring of key commercial metrics so the team can track the impact of changes over time - Build a growing evidence base on price elasticity from these tests to inform future pricing decisions - Validate that implemented pricing and strategy changes are working as intended once deployed in production, flagging and investigating any unexpected behaviour. **Evaluate expansion opportunities:** - Support the evaluation of new product, channel and segment opportunities by extracting and analysing data and contributing to commercial models - Help maintain assessment frameworks and tooling so that evaluations are consistent and repeatable **Collaboration & communication:** - Collaborate with stakeholders across Credit Risk, Data Science, Product and Growth to bring your strategies to life. - Present analysis and recommendations clearly and concisely, backed by data, to the team and wider stakeholders. - Document analyses, queries and experiment results so they are reusable by the wider team. **Your experience** **Essential:** - 1+ years of experience in an analytical role (e.g. Product Analytics, Growth, Pricing). - Proficiency in SQL; working knowledge of Python. - Understanding of experimentation fundamentals; hands-on exposure to A/B testing is a strong plus. - A structured approach to problem solving, strong attention to detail and comfort working through ambiguity. **Desirable:** - Experience in an FCA-regulated financial services firm. - Exposure to pricing or conversion funnel analysis. ## Life at Lendable - **Winning team:** the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies - **Flexible working:** flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites - **Socials & connection:** opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls - **Health coverage:** support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover - **Retirement & savings:** long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans - **Employee referral programme:** earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members - **Office meals & snacks:** enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations - **Sustainable commuting:** cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations ***Please note:** The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.* Check out our [blog](https://blog.lendable.co.uk/)!

## **Health can’t wait**. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the **new standard in prevention insurance.** Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a **global leading company, with a** [**unique culture**](https://alan.com/en/careers). We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐ **SECURITY ASSOCIATE INTERNSHIP** ⭐ Six-month end-of-studies internship in Paris. Looking for an end-of-studies internship where you do real cybersecurity work, not a side project nobody uses? Alan protects the health data of more than 1M members, and keeping it safe is part of everyday work here. You join the Security team as a full member for six months. Topics span from compliance and certifications to vulnerabilities, detection and incident response, and you have room to pick the ones where you can have the most impact. A dedicated coach guides you and supervises your thesis. Possible topics span from governance and compliance to hands-on technical work. You won't do all of them: with your coach, you choose the ones that matter most for Alan and for you. - **Governance, risk and compliance:** ISO 27001 and HDS (French health data hosting) certifications, statutory IT audit, customer security reviews, risk management - **Vulnerability management:** triage reports and scanner findings, drive fixes with engineering teams, improve our tooling - **Detection and response:** write detection rules, investigate alerts, support the team on incidents - **Build:** technical projects you own from framing to adoption. Past projects: an internal pentest for an audit, code scanning and remediation, an HDS internal audit, tooling proofs of concept - **Automate what repeats**, so the team spends its time where the risk is ⭐ **KEY OUTCOMES** ⭐ By the end of the internship, you will have: - Owned a recurring security campaign end to end and left it cheaper for the next round - Shipped one technical project to real users - Written your end-of-studies thesis on a real security subject - Worked with engineers and senior people across the company ⭐ **PROFILE & COMPETENCIES** ⭐ - **End of studies:** engineering or security track, looking for a six-month internship - **Security foundations:** solid basics in security and IT, and you can apply them to a concrete case - **You code:** Python at least, and you automate the repetitive part - **Curiosity:** you dig into topics you don't master yet, and you are curious about compliance, not only offensive security - **Risk sense:** you know not every risk is equal, and some trade-offs are worth taking - **Collaboration:** you work with engineers, not against them, and look for solutions that work for both sides - **Clear communication:** structured and written, in English (French is a plus) - **Bonus:** CTFs, personal security projects, a previous security internship, cloud or SaaS experience ## 🙌 [Perks & Benefits](https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks) At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: - **Flexible Office**. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest. - **All the tools you need**. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. - **Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours**. Organize your time as you wish. - **Transport**. Country-specific commuter benefits. - **Learning & Training opportunities**. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. - **Personal growth through coaching**: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.[**Learn more about our coaching culture**](https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching)**.** # **Important note: we hire people, not roles.** If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, **we'd love to hear from you.** Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. **If you identify yourself as a woman**: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? **Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.** We'll be thrilled to receive your application! 🔖 Check out our [About Alan](https://alan.com/about) and [Career](https://alan.com/careers) pages, as well as our [Medium](https://medium.com/alan), [blog](https://blog.alan.com/) and [Glassdoor page](https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm) for more info.

role: Stage - Data Engineer - Services Financiers - Nantes
location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France
description: Description du poste Contexte du stage : En tant que stagiaire nous vous proposons de rejoindre notre practice Data Factory localisée à Nantes. Vos missions sur la période : Complètement intégré(e) à l'équipe projet, et suivi par un tuteur et des experts, Vous serez amené(e) à : Concevoir, développer, tester vos propres composants data. Vous former sur les bonnes pratiques et au suivi des guide lines data du marché Être force de proposition sur des améliorations, initiatives, prototype (idéation collective) Participer aux instances de projet et instances de la practice Data4Finance Vous former sur les solutions Data partenaire de type low code/no code, sur les outils de CI/CD, sur les Cloud provider en lien avec votre contexte de stage. Acquérir des certifications data. Apports de la mission : - Découvrir le domaine des services Financiers (banque et bancassurance) - Appréhender les grands enjeux actuels de data plateformisation de nos clients - Approfondir vos compétences technologiques en DATA, accompagné(e) par une équipe d’ingénieurs confirmés - Disposer d’une solide expérience dans un contexte professionnel reconnu Technos et outils utilisés : Au cours de la mission, vous serez amenés à utiliser toute ou partie des technologies et solutions data ci-dessous: ETL/ELT : Datastage, Talend, Informatica, Semarchy, DBT Data Plateform Solution : Databricks, Snowflake, Cloudera Langages : Spark, Scala, Python, Shell, SQL LLM : Gemini, ChatGpt, Mistral, … Profil recherché : Vous êtes curieux(se), vous avez le sens du service, un bon relationnel et vous aimez travailler en équipe. Vous avez de bonnes capacités d'adaptation et vous êtes force de proposition. Actuellement en dernière année d’école d'Ingénieurs, en Master 2 informatique ou formation équivalente, vous avez des aptitudes à résoudre des problèmes complexes et vous avez une bonne compréhension des bases de données relationnelles. Un accord télétravail pour télétravailler jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine selon vos missions. Un package avantages intéressant : une mutuelle, un CSE, des titres restaurants, un accord d’intéressement, des primes vacances et cooptation. As an Engineering Intern, you’ll be assigned a scoped project with one of our engineering teams, working on real Roku products and platforms. We’ll match you to the team that best fits your skills and interests, so you may work on anything from user interfaces and embedded or platform software to automation, developer tooling and AI-powered workflows. Our teams work across a variety of languages and technologies and embrace GenAI-assisted development to boost productivity and quality. **What you’ll be doing** - Own a well-defined project that contributes to the success of your team. - Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code using modern languages, tools and engineering practices. - Debug, test and profile your work, and document it so others can build on it. - Collaborate with engineers and mentors, take part in code reviews, and share your progress and learnings. **Apply if** - You are a penultimate-year student, or a final-year student planning to go on to a one-year master’s course. - You hold a permanent right to work in the UK. GFT is seeking an Entry Level Geotechnical Engineer to join our Geotechnical, Dams & Hydraulics team in our Audubon, PA office. Our team excels in power delivery, transit, rail, highway and structural projects. With a focus on integrating technology, sustainability, and compliance, we consider each project a chance to innovate and evolve to protect public health and enhance quality of life. What you’ll be challenged to do: The Entry Level Geotechnical Engineer will assist in planning and overseeing subsurface explorations and performing analyses for power delivery, transportation, facilities, water resources and other types of projects. In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following: Perform geotechnical calculations and designs for various projects and facilities, including, but not limited to shallow and deep foundations, retaining structures, settlement, tieback anchors, soil nails, slope stability and seepage studies. Assist in the preparation of written reports and documentation, geotechnical correspondence, design and construction drawings and specifications. Assist in the planning of subsurface explorations and laboratory testing investigations. Execute subsurface investigations in support of geotechnical design and evaluation efforts, including test boring inspection, site reconnaissance, and other data collection activities as required. Provide specialty geo-construction observation during the construction phase of various projects. This position requires travel on an as-needed basis to other GFT offices, client offices, or project work sites and will include overnight/out-of-town travel. What you will bring to our firm: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET-accredited program. 0-3 years of geotechnical experience with an emphasis in subsurface exploration and/or design and development of geotechnical deliverables including reports, drawings, and specifications. Demonstrated interest in geotechnical engineering through applied academic coursework, prior internships, or related work experience. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Strong analytical, organizational, and report writing skills. Ability to work independently and within a team environment. Excellent field observation and data collection/documentation skills. Must be able to physically work outdoors in all seasons including being capable of lifting 30 pounds and traversing steep slopes and rough terrain. Ability to travel on an as-needed basis to other GFT offices, client offices, or project work sites including overnight/out-of-town travel. Must have valid Driver’s License. Sponsorship is not being offered for this position. What we prefer you bring: Master’s Degree with a Geotechnical focus. Experience with MicroStation and/or AutoCAD. Engineer-In-Training (EIT) certification. Experience with common geotechnical software programs such as SLIDE, SLOPE/W, LPILE, APILE, GROUP, GRLWEAP, Settle3 and gINT is preferred. Compensation: The salary range for this position is $75,000 - $90,000. Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location. Featured Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance. Tax-deferred 401(k) savings plan. Competitive paid-time-off (PTO) accrual. Tuition reimbursement for continued education. Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations Incentive compensation for eligible positions. role: Power Systems Undergraduate Intern - Cyber and Critical Infrastructure Summer Institute - Summer 2027
description: We have multiple openings for undergraduate students to join the Cyber and Critical Infrastructure Summer Institute (CSI) and to work on topics related to power systems resilience and security that align with LLNL’s national security missions. The 2027 CSI program will run during the summer with a range of start dates between May 17, 2027, and June 21, 2027, and flexible end dates through September 24, 2027. CSI is designed to provide selected candidates an opportunity to apply their skills to projects in areas of national importance such as energy infrastructure modernization and resilience, critical infrastructure security, and defense critical infrastructure. The program will include opportunities to participate in professional and technical development activities with lab Subject Matter Experts, network with fellow interns and lab employees, and learn about the breadth of LLNL’s support to US national security. This position requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work. You will Provide technical and/or research support to projects in the areas of power systems, critical infrastructure, cybersecurity, and other related fields working with scientists, engineers, and technical staff members. Participate in research under close supervision in one or more of the following areas, as assigned: power systems industrial control systems transmission or distribution system modeling or simulation oil and natural gas systems modeling or simulation distributed energy resources, inverter-based resources, or microgrids alternative energy systems grid planning or operations algorithms, optimization, or analytics Gather and analyze data and information in support of scientific research. Participate in research planning and evaluation discussions. Attend relevant seminars and training classes (at least one per week). Present work in at least one seminar or poster. Perform other duties as assigned. Must be a continuing college or university student in good standing at an accredited institution pursuing an undergraduate degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or other related fields. If you are graduating with your bachelor's degree in Spring 2027 and/or starting a graduate degree program in Fall 2027, you will need to apply for Power Systems Graduate Intern - Cyber and Critical Infrastructure Summer Institute position. Ability to apply basic principles of engineering to solve problems related to energy infrastructure. Demonstrated effective communication skills. Ability to present and communicate concepts and ideas. Ability to work in a team environment. Demonstrated exposure through coursework or relevant experience to one or more of the following topics: power systems; industrial control systems; transmission or distribution system modeling or simulation; oil and natural gas systems modeling or simulation; inverter-based resources; alternative energy systems; grid planning or operations algorithms, optimization, or analytics. Demonstrated exposure through coursework or relevant experience to one or more of the following or similar tools: Matlab/Simulink, PowerWorld, PSLF, GridLAB-D, OpenDSS, Python, C++. **About Taara:** Born at X, Google's Moonshot Factory, Taara is on a mission to connect billions of people lacking abundant and affordable internet today by pioneering the way we use light to deliver faster, cheaper, more reliable connectivity. We are bringing groundbreaking wireless optical communication and photonics chip technologies to the world to bridge the digital divide. Joining Taara allows you to work as part of a multidisciplinary team of experts in optics, software, and hardware, all collaborating to solve the hardest connectivity challenges on a global scale. If you want to tackle problems that matter and build tools with real-world impact, we would love to meet you. **About the Role:** At **Taara**, as a **Coherent Optical Systems Intern**, you will work on receiver synchronization for next-generation wireless optical communication (WOC) links. This is a larger-scope opportunity **(6 to 12+ months)** spanning both lab and simulation work, and could form the basis of a longer-term collaboration or thesis project. What such a receiver can achieve is bounded by real lasers, modulators, and analog electronics. You will evaluate components against system requirements, assemble the benchtop experiments that test them, and work toward stable closed-loop operation. In parallel you will extend the simulation that predicts this behavior, using each to check the other. There is real room to shape the direction: survey what is available, design the experiments that separate real limits from prototype artifacts, and follow the evidence to the strongest design. **How you will make 10X Impact:** - **Component Evaluation:** Screen commercially available lasers, modulators, and front-end electronics against system requirements, and measure the characteristics vendors do not publish (tuning response, wavelength stability and drift, linewidth, bandwidth, range, noise). - **Synchronization & Control Loop Design:** Design and analyze the feedback loops that track carrier phase and frequency, and validate them against control theory using transient, frequency-domain, and stability analysis. - **Physical-Layer Simulation:** Extend our end-to-end model of the link and its tracking loops, and reconcile it against measurement. **What you should have:** - Currently pursuing a Master's, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Optics, Communications, or a related field. - **Working knowledge of Analog / RF Electronics**, and a feel for how hardware limits (delay, bandwidth, noise, saturation) shape the loop and the signal processing around it. Strong foundation in **Digital Communications / Signal Processing** (modulation, detection, BER, spectral analysis). - **Hands-on lab experience**, including work with lasers and modulators, and comfort with high-speed scopes, spectrum analyzers, and power meters. - **Strong familiarity with Control theory on hardware** measuring an open-loop response, closing a feedback loop, and diagnosing why one oscillates, drifts, or loses lock. - Experience with **scientific Python** (NumPy/SciPy), and comfort writing clean, modular, tested code. - An **owner's mindset**, able to take an underspecified hardware problem and drive it forward independently in the lab. - A habit of **reaching a clear conclusion and documenting it**, including when the conclusion is that an approach does not work. - Ability to commit to a 6-12 months internship, with flexibility to fit your academic schedule. - Ability to work in the Sunnyvale office at least 3 days per week. **It'd be great if you also had one or more of these:** - **Laser Frequency Control:** Stabilizing or locking lasers, or hands-on work with narrow-linewidth sources, tunable lasers, and optical modulators. - **Synchronization:** Familiarity with phase-locked loops, carrier and timing recovery, or coherent detection. - **Hardware Depth:** Hands-on circuit design (analog, RF, or mixed-signal), or lab characterization of high-speed electronics. - **High-Performance Numerics:** Experience with accelerated array frameworks such as JAX, and functional, vectorized programming. - **Stochastic Methods:** Phase-noise modeling, rare-event Monte Carlo, or first-passage / cycle-slip statistics (Fokker-Planck, Kramers rate). - **Domain Knowledge:** Optical or RF communications, photonics, free-space optics, or atmospheric turbulence/fading channels. - **Judgment about real components**, knowing which datasheet specifications are guaranteed and which are typical, and a willingness to go measure the ones that matter. - **Control theory you have applied on hardware**, including measuring an open-loop response, closing a feedback loop, and diagnosing why one oscillates, drifts, or loses lock. **What we offer:** - Competitive salary: $7,000-$10,000/month depending on degree. - Flexible duration to fit your academic schedule. - Direct mentorship from industry-leading engineers in a "moonshot" environment. - Opportunity to work on technology that has the potential to change how billions of people access the internet.

role: Card, ATM & Payments Product Summer Intern
description: Shape the Future of Payments. Enhance ATM & Card Experiences. Drive Innovation in Everyday Banking. Card, ATM & Payments Product Summer Intern Have you ever wondered what happens behind the scenes when customers tap a card, make an online purchase, withdraw cash from an ATM, or send a digital payment? Are you interested in fintech, payments, product management, customer experience, and emerging banking technologies? As a Card, ATM & Payments Product Summer Intern , you'll gain hands-on experience supporting the products and services that consumers and businesses rely on every day. You'll work alongside experienced product, payments, and banking professionals to help enhance card, ATM, and payment solutions, analyze customer trends, support strategic initiatives, and contribute to the future of banking experiences at Rockland Trust. At Rockland Trust, our Card, ATM & Payments team plays a critical role in delivering secure, innovative, and customer-focused payment solutions. The team manages the Bank's debit card, ATM, and payments portfolio, helping ensure customers have reliable access to their accounts while delivering seamless payment experiences. As part of the team, you'll gain exposure to product management, payments strategy, ATM ownership, customer experience, data analysis, and financial technology while contributing to projects that directly impact customers and business growth. In addition to your individual responsibilities, interns will participate in collaborative summer projects with fellow interns , providing an opportunity to tackle real business challenges, gain exposure to different areas of the Bank, strengthen teamwork and leadership skills. Whether you're interested in product management, financial technology (FinTech), payments, banking, ATM channel management, customer experience, business analytics, or strategy, this internship will help you learn, grow, and build a strong foundation for your future career. What You'll Do Gain Exposure to Card, ATM & Payments Product Management As a Card, ATM & Payments Product Summer Intern, you'll support initiatives that help improve payment products, ATM services, and customer experiences. You'll work closely with product managers, operations teams, technology partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to better understand how financial products and self-service banking channels are developed, managed, and enhanced. Key Responsibilities You will: Assist with research and analysis related to card, ATM, and payment products, services, and industry trends. Support product management initiatives designed to improve customer experience and product performance. Analyze product, customer, transaction, and channel data to identify insights and opportunities. Assist with reporting, presentations, and business cases supporting product initiatives. Participate in product enhancement, testing, and implementation activities. Help gather and document business requirements for new product features and process improvements. Conduct competitive research and market analysis on payment trends, ATM technologies, digital banking, and emerging technologies. Support customer experience initiatives by analyzing feedback and identifying opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with business, technology, operations, compliance, and vendor partners on product-related projects. Assist with special projects and strategic initiatives related to cards, ATMs, payments, and digital banking solutions. Support initiatives involving the Bank's ATM portfolio, including performance monitoring, customer experience enhancements, vendor relationships, and service improvements. Help analyze ATM usage, transaction trends, servicing metrics, and customer feedback to identify opportunities for optimization. Gain exposure to ATM operations, channel strategy, compliance considerations, and self-service banking technologies. Participate in collaborative summer projects with fellow interns. What You'll Learn Throughout the summer, you'll gain practical experience in: Product management fundamentals. Debit card, ATM, and payments ecosystems. Digital banking and payment technologies. ATM product ownership and channel management. Customer access and self-service banking solutions. Customer experience and product optimization. Business analysis and requirements gathering. Financial technology (FinTech) trends. Product performance reporting and analytics. Vendor and stakeholder management. Project management and strategic planning. Professional communication and presentation skills. You'll leave with a stronger understanding of how financial institutions develop, manage, and enhance products and channels that customers use every day. What You'll Gain This internship is designed to provide meaningful experience, professional growth, and valuable career-building opportunities. By the end of the summer, you'll have: Hands-on experience supporting card, ATM, and payments initiatives. Exposure to one of the fastest-growing areas within financial services and financial technology. Experience supporting both payment products and self-service banking channels. Experience analyzing data and supporting strategic decision-making. Opportunities to network with professionals across Product, Retail Banking, Operations, Technology, and Strategy. Stronger analytical, business, and communication skills. Experience working on customer-focused solutions and product enhancements. Greater confidence working in a professional business environment. Valuable accomplishments that will strengthen your resume and future career opportunities. The Summer Intern Experience At Rockland Trust, interns aren't just observers. They're contributors. Throughout the summer, you'll: Collaborate with interns from across the Bank. Tackle real business opportunities. Strengthen teamwork, leadership, and presentation skills. Expand your professional network. Gain exposure to leaders across the organization. Develop career-ready skills through meaningful work and mentorship. Many of our interns have gone on to build successful long-term careers with Rockland Trust, and we're proud to provide an environment where emerging talent can thrive. Strong attention to detail and intellectual curiosity. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Eagerness to learn about financial products, technology, and innovation.
