Are you curious about how AI can be used to improve the way businesses work ? Do you enjoy exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities for improvement, and turning ideas into practical solutions? And would you like to apply those skills in an international professional services environment? We are looking for a Client & Market Development Intern with a strong interest in AI joining our Amsterdam office for six months. During your internship, at least 50% of your time will be focused on exploring and applying AI within the context of Business Development . You will work closely with our Client & Market Development team to identify opportunities where AI could help us work smarter, improve existing processes, and support the team in developing practical new ways of working. At the same time, you will become part of the team and gain hands-on experience in Business Development within an international law firm. Your role This internship combines AI, process improvement, and Business Development . A key part of your role will be to look critically at the way the Client & Market Development team works today. Together with the team, you will explore where AI can add value and help translate those opportunities into practical improvements. You do not need to arrive with all the answers. We are looking for someone who is genuinely interested in AI, understands its possibilities and limitations, and is excited to experiment, learn and apply technology in a real business environment. Your responsibilities may include: Exploring how AI can be applied to existing Business Development processes and workflows; Identifying opportunities to make processes smarter, more efficient or easier through AI; Testing and developing practical AI-supported ways of working for the team; Supporting the team in translating Business Development needs into technology-driven solutions; Sharing AI knowledge, ideas and developments with the wider team; Conducting market and competitive research to support strategic initiatives; Assisting with pitch documents, client presentations and other Business Development materials; Supporting targeted client and market initiatives; Collaborating with team members, lawyers and partners; Keeping up with relevant developments in AI, technology, the legal sector, and the wider business environment. The precise AI projects you work on may develop during your internship as you gain a better understanding of the team and its processes. We want you to actively contribute ideas and challenge us on where AI could help us work better. What we’re looking for We are not looking for one specific study background. What matters most is your affinity with AI and technology, combined with an interest in Business Development. You: Are currently enrolled in the final phase of a bachelor's degree or pursuing a master's degree; Have a strong interest in AI, technology and process improvement ; Are comfortable exploring new AI tools and thinking about how technology can be applied in practice; Have an interest in Business Development and commercial processes and are keen to understand the work of a Client & Market Development team; Have an analytical mindset and enjoy identifying opportunities for improvement; Are curious, proactive and comfortable taking initiative; Can communicate your ideas clearly to colleagues with different levels of technical knowledge; Are structured and able to work independently as well as collaboratively; Have an affinity with professional services; Have an interest in the legal sector or law firms, which is a plus but not a requirement . A technical, quantitative, or business-oriented academic background may be helpful, but we do not require a specific field of study. We are more interested in what you can bring to the role. What we offer At Clifford Chance Amsterdam, we value the contribution of our interns and offer: A gross monthly internship allowance of €750 based on full-time availability; A six-month internship , with a minimum availability of three days per week ; The opportunity to work on practical AI applications in a professional business environment; The freedom to contribute your own ideas on how AI can improve the way we work; Hands-on experience within an international Client & Market Development team; A professional and inspiring working environment; Reimbursement of commuting expenses; Free daily lunch in our on-site restaurant and barista-made coffee; Participation in social and sports activities at the firm. How to apply Interested in using AI to help shape the way our Business Development team works? We would love to hear from you. Please submit in PDF format: Your CV ; A motivation letter explaining your interest in AI and Business Development; Your preferred start date and availability; The number of days per week you are available, with a minimum of three days; Whether the internship is part of your academic programme or a voluntary internship. We look forward to receiving your application! For questions, please contact Clifford Chance is a leading international law firm with offices across the world. We provide legal and business advice to national and international corporations, financial institutions, and other organizations. Our Amsterdam office works across a broad range of practice areas and combines an international outlook with a collaborative working environment.

role: Examensarbete: AI-baserad Spektrumanalys och Adaptiv Radiokommunikation
description: Ämne: AI för spektrumanalys, störningsdetektion och adaptiv spektrumaccess Framtida kommunikationssystem förväntas kunna analysera radiomiljön, identifiera störningar och automatiskt anpassa sin kommunikation. Genom att kombinera artificiell intelligens med Software Defined Radio (SDR) kan intelligenta radiosystem utvecklas för att utnyttja radiospektrum mer effektivt och robust. Målet med examensarbetet är att undersöka hur AI- och maskininlärningsmetoder kan användas för att analysera spektrumdata, identifiera interferens och jamming samt stödja beslut kring frekvensval och kommunikationsstrategier. Om examensarbetet Hur bygger man satellitkommunikationssystem som fortsätter fungera när omgivningen förändras, spektrumet blir trängre och störningar ökar? Detta examensarbete genomförs inom vårt Dual-Use-program, där det aktuella projektet finansieras av Rymdstyrelsen och drivs av Space Tech Systems på AFRY i Uppsala. Här utforskar vi framtidens robusta satellitkommunikation genom att kombinera AI, signalbehandling, Software Defined Radio (SDR) och intelligenta beslutsstödsfunktioner. Visionen är att utveckla intelligenta kommunikationssystem som kan uppfatta sin omgivning, förstå radiospektrumet och anpassa sig till förändrade förutsättningar. Tekniken har potential att skapa robustare lösningar för både civila och försvarsrelaterade tillämpningar. Som examensarbetare blir du en del av ett team som arbetar i teknikens framkant. Arbetet kan innehålla: Litteraturstudie inom AI, signalbehandling och kognitiv radio. Datainsamling och bearbetning av spektrumdata. Utveckling av maskininlärningsmodeller för signal- och störningsklassificering. Analys av jamming- och interferensdetektion. Utvärdering av adaptiv spektrumaccess. Visualisering och beslutsstöd för intelligenta radiosystem. Du får arbeta tillsammans med erfarna ingenjörer och specialister och bidra till ett nationellt rymdinitiativ där forskning, innovation och praktisk ingenjörskonst möts. För dig som vill kombinera rymdteknik, AI och avancerade kommunikationssystem i ett examensarbete med verklig teknisk höjd finns nog få möjligheter som är mer spännande än detta. Tidplan Uppstart efter överenskommelse, men förslagsvis mitten av januari 2027 och genomförande under våren (motsvarande 30 hp). Exjobbet utförs till största del på vårt lokalkontor i Uppsala, med viss möjlighet att arbeta på distans. Lämplig bakgrund är civilingenjörsutbildning inom elektroteknik, teknisk fysik, datateknik, informationsteknik eller motsvarande. Arbetet passar särskilt dig som har intresse för artificiell intelligens, maskininlärning, digital signalbehandling, trådlösa kommunikationssystem eller dataanalys. Erfarenhet av Python, AI/ML-ramverk, GNU Radio eller arbete med spektrum- och signaldata är meriterande men inget krav. Du kommer ha handledare inom AFRY. Detta examensarbete kommer att genomföras som ett individuellt arbete samtidigt som det integreras i ett pågående utvecklingsprojekt inom sektionen Har du en egen idé om ett examensarbete diskuterar vi gärna det och ser om det kan vara passande för vår verksamhet och identifierade behov framåt. Exjobbet utgör en grund för en möjlig framtida anställning hos AFRY. Som anställd på AFRY erbjuder vi en modern arbetsplats i ett globalt sammanhang med framåtanda och trygghet i form av kollektivavtal och personalförmåner så som friskvårdsbidrag och en förmånsportal med en mängd rabatter. Vår personalklubb arrangerar sociala aktiviteter på och utanför kontoret. Allt från skidresor, sjunga i kör till att spela brädspel – det finns något för alla. Vårt arbete med mångfald är också ständigt pågående, en mix av personligheter och bakgrunder gör oss ännu starkare, mer kreativa och framgångsrika ute på marknaden. Dessutom finns det många sätt att vidareutveckla sig hos oss! Vi satsar på våra medarbetare och har individuella utvecklingsplaner där du får möjligheten att gå utvecklande kurser och certifieringar inom ramen för din tjänst och dina karriärmål. Vi vill att din ansökan består av ett personligt brev samt CV. Beskriv vem du är och vad som gör dig lämpad för detta exjobb hos AFRY! Sista ansökningsdag är 8 november 2026. Kontaktperson för frågor: Felix Kåhrström, Gruppchef Defence and Space Tech Systems, Uppsala. Vi kan ej ta emot ansökningar via e-post. Sök via länken. På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle. Vår Space Tech sektion inom Defense designar och utvecklar säkra och robusta kommunikationslösningar för både kommersiella verksamheter och samhällskritiska funktioner. Genom detta bidrar AFRY till Sveriges säkerhets- och försvarsförmåga. Robust kommunikation innebär kommunikation som kan motstå både avsiktliga och oavsiktliga störningar av olika slag. Det kan handla om motståndskraft mot tekniska fel, naturkatastrofer, signalstörningar eller cyberhot. Den önskade robustheten kan uppnås genom att bygga in redundans, skapa alternativa kommunikationsvägar, optimera prestanda, eliminera störningar eller använda intelligent beslutsstöd.

About the role WarriorBabe is seeking an Analytics Engineer who can own the reliability and performance of our Supabase/PostgreSQL database and turn business data into clear, actionable insights. You will maintain data integrations and refresh processes, develop reliable data models, and build useful Metabase dashboards. You will also work directly with leadership and business teams to investigate performance, explain what is driving results, identify opportunities, and recommend measurable actions. You will help evaluate and improve our data architecture as the business evolves. We welcome recommendations grounded in business needs, reliability, performance, maintainability, and cost. Success means keeping the data accurate, current, and well documented—and using it to help the business make better decisions. Key Responsibilites Database ownership and performance Manage and improve our Supabase/PostgreSQL reporting database, including tables, views, materialized views, indexes, and SQL queries. Diagnose slow queries, blocking, failed refreshes, and resource bottlenecks; use evidence to prioritize improvements. Maintain appropriate permissions, review schema changes, and support backup and recovery readiness. Plan and validate database changes with clear dependency checks, migration steps, and rollback procedures. Evaluate the existing architecture and recommend practical improvements while preserving reporting continuity. Data integrations and n8n Build, maintain, and troubleshoot production n8n workflows used for data ingestion, synchronization, and reporting. Maintain Fivetran connections and custom API integrations, with clear ownership of each source, writer, destination, and downstream dependency. Work with CRM, ERM, and other business systems as required. Handle authentication, pagination, rate limits, duplicate events, partial failures, retries, and safe backfills. Monitor actual data delivery and freshness, including failures that may be hidden behind a successful workflow or scheduler status. Data modeling and reporting reliability Develop reusable SQL models with clear record definitions, keys, relationships, and treatment of historical changes. Maintain agreed definitions for revenue, clients, conversion, refunds, renewals, retention, and other business metrics. Reconcile reporting with its underlying sources and distinguish missing data from a verified zero. Prevent duplicate counts and inconsistent totals across dashboards, including differences caused by dates, time zones, attribution, or counting rules. Document data lineage, metric definitions, refresh behavior, known limitations, and operating procedures. Metabase dashboards Build and maintain Metabase dashboards, saved questions, filters, and record-level drill-throughs. Translate stakeholder questions into reporting that supports a specific business decision. Verify saved configuration and the dashboard users actually see, including filters, totals, drill-throughs, and links to operational records. Maintain documentation alongside analytical dashboards and preserve dependent reports when making changes. Business analysis and insights Proactively analyze acquisition, sales conversion, revenue, refunds, renewals, retention, and coaching performance. Investigate performance changes by relevant cohorts, products, channels, teams, and time periods. Distinguish business changes from data-quality problems and clearly separate evidence, hypotheses, and remaining uncertainty. Present findings with their business impact, recommended action, and a practical way to measure the result. Partner with business owners to evaluate whether actions taken improved outcomes. AI-assisted development and analysis Use AI tools such as Claude or OpenAI to accelerate SQL development, data modeling, n8n workflow design, troubleshooting, documentation, and business analysis. Use AI to explore patterns, develop hypotheses, review queries and calculations, and identify potential errors or edge cases. Validate AI-generated code, calculations, and conclusions against source data and reproducible checks before deploying changes or presenting findings. Protect confidential information and protected health information (PHI) when using AI, following company policies and using approved tools. Qualifications Hands-on ownership of a production PostgreSQL or Supabase database, including troubleshooting and performance optimization. Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregation, query plans, and indexing. Practical experience building and troubleshooting production n8n workflows. Be prepared to explain a workflow you personally implemented and how it handled failures. Experience with API integrations, webhooks, authentication, pagination, rate limits, and reliable synchronization. Experience with Metabase or a comparable BI platform, with the ability to work hands-on in Metabase. Demonstrated ability to investigate business performance, quantify findings, and recommend actions. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or OpenAI to build, improve, analyze, and check work, with the ability to explain and independently verify the results. Ability to explain technical issues and business conclusions clearly to nontechnical stakeholders. Experience using Git and maintaining clear technical documentation and controlled production changes. Preferred Experience Working knowledge of HIPAA and the privacy and security considerations involved in handling protected health information (PHI) across databases, integrations, and reporting. CRM and ERM data structures, relationships, and integrations. Fivetran configuration and monitoring. Payment, subscription, refund, renewal, or customer-retention reporting. Python or JavaScript for scripting and automation. Experience with Metabase for understanding and reconciling existing reports. What Success Looks Like Business teams can understand what key metrics mean and trace results to supporting records. Data integrations and reporting refreshes operate within agreed freshness and completeness expectations, with actionable monitoring. Database and dashboard improvements have documented validation and preserve dependent reporting. Leadership receives useful explanations and recommendations, with follow-up on the actions taken. Architecture recommendations include their benefits, tradeoffs, costs, and a practical implementation path. Why Join Us Fully remote work with flexibility and Eastern Time overlap. role: Research Engineer Intern - Environments, Data and Post-Training

## Company Overview Lydian is developing the lowest cost sustainable fuels from waste CO2, water, and renewable electricity to decarbonize the aviation industry. Our breakthrough technology replaces oil and gas refining with fully electrified, modular, and flexible reactor systems that produce fuel with 95% lower emissions than traditional jet fuel. In particular, we look for tenacious people who are energized by solving the hardest, highest impact problems that come their way. ## Position Overview Lydian is looking for a 6-month Mechanical Engineering Co-op for Spring 2027 (January - June) to design, build, and test mechatronic equipment that helps automate catalyst loading in our proprietary fuel synthesis reactor. You will take on hands-on engineering challenges—from understanding a process and developing concepts to designing in SolidWorks, selecting components, and building and testing prototypes. Your initial projects will focus on developing tooling and machinery for catalyst loading in our pilot reactor, including automated indexing, injection, and inspection. You will work closely with Lydian’s engineers and scientists to turn practical needs into reliable equipment that supports our sustainable fuel reactor systems. This is an hourly, in-person position based in Boston, MA, with a minimum commitment of 6 months. ## Responsibilities - Understand catalyst-loading needs and translate them into equipment requirements, concepts, and practical test plans. - Develop and compare mechanical and mechatronic design concepts, then create SolidWorks models, assemblies, and drawings for selected designs. - Specify and select mechanical and electrical components, such as actuators, sensors, motors, and other system hardware. - Build, assemble, and iterate on prototypes, fixtures, and equipment; work hands-on to integrate components and resolve fit or function issues. - Test equipment, troubleshoot issues, analyze results, and use what you learn to improve designs and demonstrate reliable operation. - Contribute to the development of catalyst-loading equipment, progressing from pilot-scale tooling toward full-scale systems. - Document designs, component selections, build details, test procedures, and results so the work can be understood and improved by the team. - Collaborate with engineers and scientists across the team to incorporate project requirements and solve technical problems. ## Qualifications - Currently pursuing a B.S. or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering field. - Some hands-on experience with mechatronics design through coursework, projects, internships, or work—for example, robotics or automated manufacturing equipment. - Experience using SolidWorks or comparable 3D CAD software to develop parts and assemblies; ability to turn a design concept into a buildable model. - Able to understand an open-ended technical problem, develop and compare ideas, and make progress through hands-on design, building, and testing. - Interest or experience in specifying and selecting mechanical and electrical components for a system. - Comfortable working hands-on in a lab, shop, or prototyping environment, with attention to safety and detail. - Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting design choices and sharing test results. - Curiosity, eagerness to learn, and a proactive, collaborative approach to solving technical problems. - Desire to work in a fast-paced environment and solve interesting technical problems. - Experience with fabrication, machining, 3D printing, electrical wiring, or controls programming is a plus, but not required. ## **Company Culture and Benefits** - Paid engineering-focused internship with a collaborative in-person technical team - Challenging, meaningful work that can directly impact company success - Opportunities for networking/exposure within the climate tech community - Mentorship from a great team of engineers and scientists

description: **Please Note:** To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6-month period. **Advancing the World’s Technology Together** Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day--including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities. **What You’ll Learn** - Project Overview: Every new generation of AI accelerator pushes more power through stacked memory, and temperature is now one of the limits on how fast and how dense HBM can be. Our lab builds compact thermal models that turn workload-driven power maps of a 3D-stacked HBM into transient temperature maps in minutes rather than the hours a full CFD run takes, while staying close to CFD accuracy. As an intern you will own one piece of this platform end to end: from the physics and the CFD reference to a validated model that architecture, power, and package teams use to make design decisions. - Skills You’ll Learn: - Heat conduction in 3D-stacked die: TSV arrays, micro-bumps, underfill, and anisotropic effective properties - Compact and reduced-order thermal modeling - CFD modeling and validation with Simcenter Flotherm - Scientific computing at scale: sparse solvers, preconditioning, and fast Python/MATLAB code - Power-thermal co-simulation and thermal-aware design of AI memory systems **What You’ll Do** Samsung’s Power & Thermal Lab is seeking a thermal engineering intern to help build and calibrate models of HBM stacks and package. We are a **small, fast****‑****moving team** where **direct ownership** and **minimal busywork** empower every member to tackle the same real‑world problems. Working with authentic data, real partners, and production‑grade results, our contributions flow straight into platforms used across the company. As an intern, the models you build feed design discussions for future HBM products. You will work on **real projects with tangible results**, receive mentorship, and help shape the scope of work in a collaborative environment where hardware, software, and thermal experts work side‑by‑side on next‑generation AI memory technologies. **Location:** Daily onsite presence at our San Jose headquarters in alignment with our Flexible Work policy **Reports to:** SVP, R&D (Power & Thermal Lab) - Build and calibrate CFD models (Simcenter Flotherm) of HBM stacks and packages under realistic cooling conditions, and use them as the reference for fast models. - Extend our compact thermal model to new stack heights, die configurations, and base-die power, and quantify its accuracy against CFD in both steady state and transient. - Develop homogenization methods that replace fine features (TSV arrays, micro-bump layers, underfill) with effective properties, and establish where they hold and where they break. - Speed up thermal solvers by orders of magnitude through model-order reduction, sparse linear algebra and preconditioning, GPU acceleration, or machine-learning surrogates. - Run transient simulations driven by real AI workload traces, locate spatiotemporal hotspots, and explore thermal-aware policies such as throttling, refresh control, and power-map scheduling. - Evaluate advanced cooling and thermal-interface options (cold plates, two-phase cooling, TIMs, backside cooling) and translate them into boundary conditions and design guidance for HBM. - Couple the thermal model with the lab's trace-driven power simulation engine so that power maps and temperature maps evolve together in time. - Document methods and results clearly and present them to engineers and lab leadership. - Complete other responsibilities as assigned. **What You Bring** - Pursuing a PhD (preferred) or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field. - Must have at least 1 academic quarter/semester remaining - Strong foundation in heat transfer, especially transient conduction in multi-layer solids and thermal contact resistance. - Hands-on experience with numerical methods (finite-volume, finite-element, or finite-difference) and scientific programming in Python and/or MATLAB. - Ability to judge simulation results critically (mesh convergence, boundary conditions, energy balance) and to explain discrepancies between models. - Experience with Simcenter Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, or COMSOL, preferred - Experience with compact or reduced-order thermal models, model-order reduction, or ML surrogates for physical simulation, preferred - Background in electronics packaging, 3D-IC / chiplet thermal management, or advanced cooling, preferred - Familiarity with HPC, sparse linear solvers, or GPU programming, preferred - You’re inclusive, adapting your style to the situation and diverse global norms of our people. - An avid learner, you approach challenges with curiosity and resilience, seeking data to help build understanding. - Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency. Powered by **LOIS**, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country. **Department Statement:** The Information Security team is responsible to ensure the SOC efforts are effective and aligned with industry standards and best practices. Interns are treated as contributing members of the team and are paired with an experienced analyst for coaching, ticket review, and career guidance. **Job Summary** Filevine is looking for a Security Specialist – Intern to join our Information Security team. This is a paid, mentored internship for early-career candidates building toward a career in cybersecurity, whether through an academic program, a certification track, or self-directed, demonstrable hands-on experience, who want real-world experience defending a modern cloud-based software platform. Working alongside our Security Specialists, you will help monitor our environment, triage security alerts, investigate suspicious activity, and improve the documentation and automation that keep the SOC running. You will finish the internship with practical experience across the alert lifecycle, a completed capstone project, and a clear picture of what a career in security operations looks like. If you are curious, detail-oriented, and enjoy solving puzzles, we want to talk to you. ### Responsibilities - Monitor security alerts and events in the SIEM, endpoint detection and response (EDR), email security, and cloud security tools under the guidance of Security Specialists. - Perform initial (Tier 1) triage of alerts: gather context, determine whether an alert is a true positive, false positive, or benign, document findings, and escalate per SOC runbooks. - Work the SOC ticket queue: keep tickets accurate and up to date, track investigations to closure, and communicate status clearly to the team. - Investigate employee-reported phishing emails: analyze headers, links, and attachments in a sandbox, help block malicious indicators, and assist with user notifications. - Assist with vulnerability management by reviewing scan results, helping validate findings, and tracking remediation with system owners. - Help tune detections and reduce alert noise by identifying recurring false-positive patterns and proposing rule adjustments. - Review threat intelligence and vendor advisories, summarize what is relevant to Filevine, and help map observed activity to the MITRE ATT&CK framework. - Support incident response activities as directed, including evidence collection, timeline building, and note-taking during active incidents. - Create and improve SOC documentation: runbooks, playbooks, knowledge base articles, and onboarding guides. - Complete a capstone project (for example, building a new detection, automating a triage step with a script, or improving a playbook) and present the results to the Security team at the end of the internship. ### What You Will Learn - How an enterprise SOC operates day to day: the alert lifecycle, escalation paths, incident handling (aligned to NIST SP 800-61), and the metrics used to measure a SOC. - Hands-on use of production security tooling, including a SIEM, EDR, email security, identity and access management, and cloud security platforms. - Practical investigation skills: log analysis, phishing analysis, basic malware triage, and writing clear, defensible investigation notes. - How security operations supports compliance obligations (for example, SOC 2 and customer security requirements) in a legal technology company that handles sensitive client data. - Professional skills: working a queue, communicating with engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and receiving structured feedback from a dedicated mentor. ### Qualifications - Pursuing a career in cybersecurity or a related technical field through a degree program, certification track, bootcamp, or self-study. Formal enrollment is not required; demonstrable experience (a documented home lab, CTF results, open-source contributions, or prior IT, help desk, compliance or system administration work) is equally welcome. - Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, common ports and protocols), operating systems, and introductory security concepts, gained through coursework, certifications, or hands-on experience. - Foundational understanding of common attack techniques (phishing, malware, credential abuse, privilege escalation, lateral movement) and the defensive controls that counter them. - Hands-on exposure to security tools through coursework, labs, competitions, a home lab, or prior work, such as Wireshark, Nmap, a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, or similar), or Security Onion. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical findings clearly and concisely for both technical and non-technical readers. - Curiosity, attention to detail, sound judgment, and a willingness to ask questions and learn from feedback. - Demonstrated integrity and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion. - Able to commit to the stated weekly schedule for the duration of the internship. ### Preferred Qualifications - Progress toward a security or IT certification such as CompTIA Security+, Network+, CySA+, or GIAC GFACT / GSEC — started, in progress, or planned. - Any self-directed security learning: Capture the Flag (CTF) events, collegiate competitions (for example, CCDC or National Cyber League), a campus security club, a home lab, online labs such as TryHackMe or Hack The Box, or a security-focused course sequence. - Awareness of common security frameworks — MITRE ATT&CK, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or NIST SP 800-61 incident handling guidance. Classroom-level familiarity is enough; we will teach the rest. - Any exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or identity providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, or similar), including coursework, a free-tier account, or administering accounts in a prior job. - Comfort with ticketing, tracking, or documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, or a GRC/audit platform. - Background in compliance, audit, risk, privacy, or a similar control-oriented role — including SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA work — and an interest in moving toward the technical side of security. - Genuine enthusiasm for the field — following security news, podcasts, or write-ups, and able to talk about a breach or technique that caught your interest. ### Internship Perks - Paid internship with competitive hourly compensation - Dedicated mentor and structured learning plan for the duration of the internship - Real production experience and a capstone project to showcase in future interviews - Potential pathway to a full-time Jr. Security Specialist – Tier 1 role for high performers - Open office working atmosphere - Laptop provided for the duration of the internship

role: COOP Site Support Technician / ORT Analyst (Senior)
description: Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks a COOP Site Support Technician / Outage Response Team (ORT) Analyst to provide senior-level, on-site technical support at the USMEPCOM Continuity of Operations (COOP) site in Indianapolis, Indiana, supporting LAN administration, end-user devices, telecommunications, network equipment, backups, system recovery, outage response, and COOP readiness. The technician participates in a staggered schedule ensuring at least one qualified technician is on site from 0600 to 1800 Central Time, Monday through Friday, and in an activation roster requiring arrival at the COOP site within 60 minutes of activation. During quarterly COOP exercises and actual activations, the technician coordinates with engineering, field support, the Service Desk, the ORT, carriers, and Government stakeholders to validate systems, restore services, and document results. ### Key Tasks & Responsibilities - Provide dedicated on-site IT support at the USMEPCOM COOP facility within the staggered 0600–1800 CT weekday schedule, and remain available for 24/7/365 support during exercises, activations, or mission-critical incidents. - Participate in the activation roster; maintain call trees, contact information, escalation paths, and activation instructions; identify a qualified local backup technician; and periodically test roster readiness. - Provide LAN administration and configure, install, maintain, and troubleshoot switches, routers, circuits, firewalls, storage devices, and related network equipment. - Support laptops, desktops, thin/zero clients, peripherals, printing, connectivity, and authentication issues for COOP-site users. - Support landline, VoIP, mobile-device, and circuit services, coordinating telecommunications support with local service providers. - Monitor local systems and network services; receive, assess, and escalate outage notifications; and provide immediate response during COOP-site incidents. - Support Severity (SEV) 1 and SEV 2 response by maintaining technical timelines and status, coordinating restoration with technical teams, utilities, carriers, and vendors, implementing approved workarounds, and validating restoration. - Collect logs, test results, and other evidence for incident reporting and root-cause analysis. - Maintain and test COOP-site system and configuration backups, perform approved restorations, and document backup integrity results. - Participate in quarterly COOP exercises (one to three days), coordinate surge personnel, support power-cycle, failover, and recovery activities, and validate network, telecom, endpoint, and application-access capabilities. - Record exercise events and results, participate in planning and after-action reviews, track corrective actions to resolution, and help maintain a multi-year continuity test and exercise program. - Support COOP technology refreshes and transitions to centralized hosting, and perform Enhanced Trust Agent duties when trained, authorized, and assigned. - Maintain site inventories, configurations, network diagrams, rack layouts, circuit records, SOPs, and recovery checklists, and provide COOP readiness information for program reporting. ### Education & Experience **Required:** - Associate’s degree in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. - Minimum of seven (7) years of relevant experience in systems administration, network administration, infrastructure support, COOP/disaster recovery, outage response, or a related discipline. - Hands-on experience supporting and restoring enterprise networks, systems, end-user devices, and telecommunications, and supporting backups, restoration, or continuity exercises. - Ability to work on site in Indianapolis, IN, within the staggered 0600–1800 CT weekday schedule, and to report to the COOP site within 60 minutes when on the activation roster. - Ability to participate in quarterly one- to three-day COOP exercises and to support after-hours, weekend, holiday, surge, or 24/7 emergency coverage. - Strong written, verbal, customer-service, coordination, and technical problem-solving skills. **Preferred:** - Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. - Experience supporting federal or DoD COOP environments, including exercises, failover, failback, and backup restoration. - Experience with Windows or Linux administration, VMware or virtual desktops, and enterprise backup systems. - Experience working with an Outage Response Team, NOC, Service Desk, or major-incident team using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform. - Familiarity with DoD PKI or Enhanced Trust Agent responsibilities. ### Certifications - Required: None. - Preferred: CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), ITIL 4 Foundation, or relevant Microsoft, VMware, Linux, cloud, or continuity certification. ### Security Clearance - Active Secret clearance or higher is required. ### Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.) **Work Environment / Travel:** - On-site in Indianapolis, IN (no telework). - After-hours, weekend, holiday, surge, and emergency support may be required during exercises, outages, or COOP activation. **Administrative Notes:** **Period of Performance:** March 1, 2027 – February 28, 2033 **Contract Start Date:** March 1, 2027 Note: By applying to this position, the candidate acknowledges and consents to having their resume included in an active competitive Government contract bid.

**Work Arrangement** This is an onsite position with 75% OCONUS work and remaining work being in Baltimore, MD. **Job Overview** As a Junior Field Engineer, you will support the readiness, integration, and technical performance of GARC systems and associated platforms operating in fleet environments. This role involves hands-on engineering support, system troubleshooting, configuration validation, technical documentation, and field operations during sustained overseas deployments lasting 90–120 days, followed by approximately 30 days in CONUS before the next deployment cycle. You will operate in industrial, austere, maritime, and on-water environments—often OCONUS—supporting technical operations, system integration, RDTE (Research, Development, Test, & Evaluation) events, and fleet exercises. Troubleshooting & Diagnostics: Assist in identifying system anomalies, isolating root causes, and supporting corrective actions under engineering supervision. - Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs): Implement and verify approved ECPs, upgrades, and configuration changes while maintaining configuration control. - Perform other duties as required. **Standard Essential Functions** - Regular and reliable attendance on a full-time basis [or in accordance with posted schedule]. - Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company's policies and practices. - Familiarity with interpreting engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documentation. - Ability to support system testing, data collection, troubleshooting, and hardware/software diagnostics. - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in high-tempo, dynamic, and austere field environments. - Strong communication and teamwork skills for working alongside engineers, operators, and field teams. - Ability and willingness to deploy overseas for 90–120 days at a time, followed by approximately 30 days in CONUS. - Exposure to system integration labs (SILs), hardware-in-the-loop testing, or prototype development environments preferred. - Experience with unmanned systems, autonomous platforms, robotics, maritime systems, or embedded electronics preferred. - Experience working in industrial, maritime, or austere conditions, including naval facilities or test ranges. **Physical Requirements** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. role: (Senior/Junior AI Inference Reliability Engineer, Compute Infra
description: ### **About the Role** We're looking for a software engineer, reliability-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero-model and LoRA-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page. The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands-on production-reliability experience on large-scale distributed or GPU-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA and Kubernetes controller/CRD-based platforms, and think about GPU infrastructure, and the tools that keep it reliable, as software to be engineered. A product mindset applies: the on-call experience, the clarity of an alert, and the judgment built into an automated remediation are things you ship and iterate on. ### **Responsibilities** - Operate the provisioning state machine in production: own the health of the host lifecycle pipeline, discovery, inference bring-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA, triaging stuck or failed state transitions at fleet scale and feeding real failure patterns back into how the states and transitions are designed. - Triage and extend automated self-healing: when the node-scanning and remediation platform misses something, a new failure mode, an InfiniBand issue in disaggregated prefill/decode serving, a GPU Xid variant, a hero-model or LoRA-specific fault, diagnose it live, drive the fix to production, and turn it into a new detection/remediation plugin so it's automatic the next time. - Own end-to-end reliability of the pipeline: hold the SLOs and error budgets for provisioning and fleet health, lead incident response when idempotency, retry, rollback, or drift assumptions break down in practice, and drive the systemic fix, not just the hotfix. - Partner with the inference/ML platform team from the production side: be the one who knows how real cluster topologies, interconnects, and scheduling constraints actually fail in the field, and feed those failure modes back as first-class requirements into the platform's abstractions. - Work alongside machine learning researchers, engineers, and product managers to bring our latest technologies into production, enabling advanced research through awesome engineering. - Introduce new techniques, tools, and architecture that improve the performance, latency, throughput, and efficiency of our model inference stack. - Build tools to give us visibility into our bottlenecks and sources of instability, then design and implement solutions to address the highest-priority issues. - Lead reliability cross-functionally: build coalition across infra, ML platform, and product teams around shared reliability priorities, manage stakeholders through incidents and roadmap trade-offs, and represent the reliability point of view in planning so it shapes decisions before they ship, not after an outage. ### **Requirements** - Experience operating a provisioning or host-lifecycle pipeline in production, comfortable troubleshooting stuck or failed state transitions (discovery, bring-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA) at fleet scale, and translating real failure patterns back into improvements to the state machine’s design. - Deep experience owning production reliability for large-scale distributed systems; GPU/ML-serving infrastructure experience is a strong plus. - Hands-on experience troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA networking issues, ideally in a multi-node training or disaggregated-inference context — comfortable reading IB port counters and subnet manager logs, not just application metrics. - Familiarity with the operational realities of multi-tenant model serving (LoRA/adapter-based serving) and with running differentiated SLOs across model pools of different priority. - A demonstrated track record of eliminating operational toil through automation and tooling you built yourself, not just process or documentation. - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, reconciliation loops, and node-level health/remediation systems. - Comfort with event-driven architectures, backpressure/circuit-breaking design, and treating observability (metrics, logs, traces) as something built into a system, not added after an incident. - A software-engineering mindset first: you write and ship production code, and you think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered, not a fleet to be manually operated. ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $160,000 - $280,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. ### **Application Policy** Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. # **Panther: Better Health Is Skin Deep** Panther is unlocking the tremendous biological power of our skin, delivering efficacious, shelf-stable treatments directly to customers. Panther's precisely engineered smart microarray patches (SmartPatches) address a wide range of needs in Skin Health (cosmetics, medical aesthetics) and are designed to treat conditions in Systemic Health (infectious diseases, allergies, cancer, autoimmune diseases, metabolic disorders). Billions of people around the world lack access to effective treatment, and we will change this. SmartPatches enable effective, tech-enabled customer experiences, and our AI platform provides valuable insights for improved patient outcomes and the development of even better treatments. SmartPatches are affordable to manufacture and distribute, and easy to apply, resulting in greater access and market expansion. Panther is developing clinically validated products, the first of which launches in 2027. ## **The Opportunity** ## This is a 6-month co-op that begins in January 2027, with the option to extend through the summer. Panther is building the delivery platform that lets any partner place its treatment precisely into the skin, and algorithmic formulation is where every product starts. AI models built on Panther’s own data take a partner’s active ingredient, target release profile, SmartPatch™ geometry and regulatory requirements, and generate candidate formulations. They then screen those candidates in silico for solubility, molecular interactions, mechanical strength and shelf stability. Only the strongest move on to physical testing (drug release, toxicity, ex vivo human skin and in vivo models). The result is a clinical formula and a scalable manufacturing process, reached faster than with legacy trial-and-error. Partners get a faster path from molecule to product. Panther is looking for an AI and machine learning researcher with a strong chemistry foundation who wants to apply computational methods to real formulation and drug delivery problems. You will work directly with the R&D team to build models that help us understand and predict how our formulations, active ingredients and patches behave. This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will scope problems, choose tools, build models and present results to leadership. # **The Impact You’ll Make in Your Co-Op** AI formulation engineers accelerate Panther's formulation work from expert trial-and-error into a repeatable, data-driven pipeline. By the end of year one: a closed loop with measurable gains. By the end of the year at least one partner molecule will reach a clinical-ready formula with fewer lab iterations.The work produces invention disclosures that add to the IP library. # **What You Will Do** - Build machine learning models that predict formulation properties such as stability, solubility, dissolution and compatibility between actives and polymers. - Apply physical chemistry and molecular modeling, including molecular dynamics, to study the molecules we work with: small molecules, peptides, proteins and polymers. - Develop physics-based and generative models of transport, such as how formulations dissolve and diffuse through skin over time. - Work with small, high-quality experimental datasets, using synthetic data generation to augment and anchor real lab data. - Benchmark open-source foundation models and scientific AI tools, and recommend which ones Panther should adopt for R&D and formulation work. - Partner with our formulation and lab teams in Pittsburgh to turn experimental data into models, and models into experiments worth running. - Document your methods and results clearly, and present findings to the CTO and the wider team. # **Qualifications** - Advanced degree in chemical engineering, materials science, pharmaceutical sciences or computational chemistry, or a BS with 2+ years of equivalent industry experience. - Solid chemistry foundation: physical and organic chemistry, molecular structure and interactions, and how formulation chemistry affects stability and performance. This is a core requirement. - Hands-on machine learning experience, ideally with generative models and data-scarce problems, including synthetic data strategies. - Experience with molecular dynamics, cheminformatics or molecular modeling tools. - Strong foundation in physics and numerical simulation, such as fluid dynamics, transport or multi-scale modeling. - Proficiency in Python and the scientific computing stack. Familiarity with ML frameworks and open-source models. - Interest in life sciences, drug delivery or skincare. Biology background is a plus. # **Preferred Qualifications** - Experience with dissolvable microneedles, transdermal or intradermal delivery. - Using LLMs or generative models for materials or formulation discovery. - Publications, patents or invention disclosures in drug delivery or computational formulation. - Startup experience: building tools from scratch and switching between cosmetic, medical-device and partner projects. # **Who Thrives here** - Self-starters who are comfortable with ambiguity and can make progress without a large team or established infrastructure. - Pragmatic problem solvers who pick the right tool for the problem rather than the most complex one. - Clear communicators who can explain technical work to scientists, engineers and executives. # **Benefits and more** - People who want to see their work shape a real product. - Build something unique and high-impact with a world-class team of experts in technology, healthcare, and science. - Hands-on ownership of Panther’s algorithmic formulation work: you scope the problems, choose the tools and build models that shape real products. - Work directly with the CTO and close collaboration with our Formulation and lab teams in Pittsburgh, with exposure to Process Development and Device work. - Apply frontier AI, generative and molecular modeling to real drug delivery problems, with your work feeding invention disclosures and Panther’s IP library. - A small, collaborative team where your work is seen and your ideas are heard. - In-person company events - Fully stocked kitchen, plus in-office lunch twice a week **Equal Opportunity Employer** Panther Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, citizenship, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The Research Intern joins the X-ray, CT, and MRI machine learning group for a six-month end-of-studies research internship in France. The group pre-trains foundation models on large-scale radiology data using cloud and HPC infrastructure and builds vision-language models for medical images. The final research subject is agreed before the internship starts and may include open-vocabulary grounding for chest X-ray vision-language models or a cross-modality foundation model spanning X-ray and CT. This is a fixed-term internship (stage) under a French internship agreement (convention de stage) with the student's school. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Learn the clinical context for assigned modalities, including how images are acquired, how pathologies appear, and how radiologists read them. Review relevant literature and propose approaches to test for the agreed research subject. Train and evaluate models on large-scale medical imaging datasets using cloud and HPC infrastructure. Compare results against baselines and report what worked and what did not. Contribute tested code to the team's ML monorepo through code review. Report progress weekly to the tutor and present results to the team. Document the work so the team can build on it, and contribute to a publication where results allow. Apply disciplined experimentation, including clear hypotheses, controlled comparisons, and critical reading of results. Collaborate with researchers and engineers on the foundation-model and vision-language roadmap as assigned. Follow DeepHealth data privacy, security, and research-integrity expectations when working with clinical imaging data. PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience Final-year Master's or engineering school (grande ecole / ecole d'ingenieurs) student in machine learning, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related field, seeking a 6-month end-of-studies internship in France (required). Must be eligible for a French internship (stage) under a school internship agreement (convention de stage) for the full internship period (required). Strong machine learning fundamentals, including probability, linear algebra, and optimization (required). Solid knowledge of deep learning for computer vision (required). Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (required). Hands-on experience training and debugging deep neural networks (required). Readable, tested code that others can build on (required). Disciplined experimentation: clear hypotheses, controlled comparisons, and critical reading of results (required). Ability to work autonomously within a team and communicate clearly in English (required). Preferred: Familiarity with self-supervised learning, vision-language, or multimodal models. Preferred: Experience with medical imaging (DICOM, 3D volumes, large images). Preferred: Experience training on GPUs, from a single GPU to multi-GPU cluster jobs. Preferred: Familiarity with Linux and git. Preferred: Familiarity with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex. Quality Standards Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors. Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance. Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment. Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures. Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. Practices universal safety precautions. Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person. Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines. Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner. Travel No regular travel is expected. Occasional visits to other team sites may be possible. Working Environment Office / Hybrid. Paris, Ile-de-France, France. On-site presence is required during the first months of the internship. Fixed-term internship (stage) of approximately 6 months. Subject to a French convention de stage with the student's educational institution. Working time and internship stipend (gratification) follow applicable French internship rules and DeepHealth France internship practice. Not a permanent employment contract (CDI/CDD). Physical Demands The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. Compensation: 1,500.00-2,500.00 EURO per month

**About Nominal** Nominal is building the connected test and operations platform powering the world's most advanced hardware systems, from spacecraft and autonomous vehicles to next-generation defense programs. Our platform gives hardware engineering teams a single place to ingest data, analyze performance, automate test execution, and collaborate across every phase of development, so they can move faster without sacrificing safety or precision. We're a fast-moving team that owns problems end-to-end, works across disciplines, and thrives at the intersection of hardware and software. We serve top-tier commercial and defense customers, from autonomy leaders like Anduril and Shield AI to next-generation aerospace teams like Hermeus and REGENT, and performance engineering teams like Pratt Miller Motorsports, alongside mission partners within the U.S. Navy and U.S. Air Force on programs where failure isn’t an option. We’re backed by Sequoia, General Catalyst, Founders Fund, Lux Capital, and Lightspeed. Our team draws from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence. ### **The role** We're looking for students with solid engineering fundamentals on track to graduate in Summer 2027 or sooner. As an Instrumentation intern at Nominal, you'll work at the boundary between software and physical test hardware, helping integrate Nominal solutions in real test stands, hardware instrumentation stacks, and live control systems. You'll write code that talks directly to hardware in the field, whether that's a test stand, a clean room, or an industrial setup, and see your work show up in customer test campaigns within weeks. #### ### 🚀 **What you'll do** - Write reliable and performant Python and/or Rust-based software to interface with customer hardware using PyVISA, broad-base industrial protocols, and proprietary vendor SDKs (NI-DAQmx, LabJack, Dewesoft), etc. - Help automate data collection and control processes across hardware test environments - Contribute new drivers and instruments to our open-source instrumentation library (instro) - Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers on-site to get test setups running and troubleshoot hardware-software integrations live - Take ownership of a scoped hardware ↔ software integration project from start to finish, with mentorship from our instrumentation and product teams #### ### **🎯 Reach out if…** - You’re graduating in Summer 2027 or sooner and are interested in a full-time position - role: PhD Student -  Multi-Tier Optical Circuit Switching for AI Datacenters
description: Huawei Heisenberg Research Center (Munich) is responsible for advanced technology research, architectural development, design and strategic engineering of our products. The Optical Technology Laboratory in Munich researches and develops signal processing, components, systems, and optical switching for fixed access, data center networks, metro and long-haul optical networks. The department engages in local research and collaborates with academic and industrial partners from the European ecosystem. Datacenters are undergoing a paradigm shift driven by the explosion of AI/ML workloads, distributed cloud computing, and high-performance computing (HPC). Traditional electronic packet switching (EPS) faces severe scaling bottlenecks in bandwidth, power consumption, latency, and cost, while optical circuit switching (OCS) offers a promising alternative with high bandwidth density and lower energy per bit. We are seeking a highly motivated PhD student to join us, focused on multi-tier OCS datacenter networks for AI infrastructure. The project proceeds in three phases: characterizing switching technologies across the nanosecond, microsecond, and millisecond regimes and their port-count trade-offs; architecting multi-tier fabrics that map these classes onto the scale-up, scale-in, scale-out, and scale-across tiers of the hierarchy (intra-node, rack/super-node, cluster, and cross-datacenter domains, respectively); and jointly optimizing traffic placement, scheduling, and reconfiguration so that switching time, power consumption, cost, and application performance (e.g., collective completion time and tail latency) are balanced for large-scale AI training and inference. Join us as a PhD Student — Multi-Tier Optical Circuit Switching for AI Datacenters (m/f/d) Your mission Survey OCS switching technologies across the speed ladder — nanosecond-class burst and packet switching (e.g., semiconductor optical amplifiers, photonic integrated circuits), microsecond-class switches (e.g., piezo-actuated and fast MEMS, rotor switches, arrayed waveguide gratings), and millisecond-class space-division switches (e.g., 3D MEMS, liquid crystal, wavelength-selective switches) — and systematize their trade-offs in switching time, port count, insertion loss, power, reliability, and scalability. Build technology-level cost and power models covering switch fabrics, transceivers, lasers, amplifiers, fiber, and control overhead, enabling fair comparison of OCS classes on capital cost, operational power, and cost per switched bit at a given radix and reconfiguration time Develop analytical and simulation models of multi-tier OCS fabrics that capture reconfiguration delay, circuit setup overhead, congestion, and available bandwidth under demand-aware and demand-oblivious control, and validate them against published measurements and testbed experiments Formulate the tier-assignment and traffic-placement problem as a multi-objective optimization (e.g., mixed-integer programming, network flow, combinatorial algorithms) that maps parallelism dimensions and traffic classes — tensor-, pipeline-, data-, and expert-parallel flows — onto the appropriate OCS tier and port scale under performance, power, and cost constraints. Design scheduling and traffic-engineering algorithms that exploit mixed switching granularities, for example placing latency-sensitive collective communication on fast, small-radix tiers while serving elastic bulk traffic on slow, high-radix tiers, and reconfiguring a tier only when the amortized benefit exceeds its switching cost Evaluate the proposed architectures and algorithms on representative AI workloads, including MoE inference and super-node-scale training, through flow- and packet-level simulation, trace-driven analysis, and control-plane prototyping; publish results in top-tier venues such as JLT, JSAC, OFC, ECOC, SIGCOMM, and INFOCOM, and contribute to the doctoral thesis Your areas of expertise A Master's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical or Optical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field, with an excellent academic record. Strong theoretical background in graph theory, combinatorial optimization, linear/integer programming, network flow, or queuing theory; experience with multi-objective optimization, and familiarity with learning-based methods (e.g., reinforcement learning, graph neural networks), is a plus Solid understanding of datacenter network architectures and high-performance interconnects (InfiniBand, RoCE, Ethernet, NVLink), and of optical switching technologies (OCS, WSS, ROADM) including their key metrics: switching speed, port count, insertion loss, and crosstalk Understanding of distributed deep learning workloads: collective communication primitives, data/tensor/pipeline/expert parallelism, and the traffic characteristics of large language model training and inference Strong programming skills in Python; experience with C++ or another systems language, mathematical solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX), and network or discrete-event simulators is expected A demonstrated ability to conduct research independently, evidenced by publications in peer-reviewed venues, a strong thesis, or comparable project work Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to work in an international, interdisciplinary team By applying to this position, you agree with our Recruitment Privacy Statement. You can read in full our privacy policy here . Your rewards of working here Our culture is characterized by innovative power and team spirit as well as the intensive exchange of knowledge and experience within our global network. We offer healthy meals ranging from traditional Chinese to western delicacies in our famous company canteen. To keep your development ongoing, you will find a broad range of training opportunities. Many online and face-to-face training programs incl. language courses in German and Mandarin. Our diverse and welcoming environment is shaped by different backgrounds and around 40 individual nationalities. Self-responsible work in a competent, motivated and constantly growing team. Our ICT solutions, products and services are used in more than 170 countries and regions, serving over one-third of the world's population. WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. Throughout your journey, you’ll take part in events, meetups and initiatives designed to connect the talents of tomorrow with our teams. And because we truly believe in the potential of the people who join us, some apprentices choose to continue their journey with Betclic after their apprenticeship. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME 🎮 As a member of the Global Security team, you will join the Physical Security team under the supervision of the Senior Physical Security Officer and contribute to protecting Betclic's people, workplaces and critical assets across the Group. We are looking for a proactive, curious and motivated Physical Security Apprentice to support the continuous development and implementation of Betclic's Physical Security Program. You will contribute to strengthening the company's physical security posture by supporting day-to-day security operations, participating in risk assessments and helping deliver projects that enhance the protection of our offices, employees and business activities. This role combines operational security, project management, risk assessment and cross-functional collaboration, making it an excellent opportunity for someone interested in Corporate Security within an international and fast-growing technology company. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 In this role, your main missions will be: Support the continuous improvement of Betclic's Physical Security Program. Participate in physical security risk assessments across Betclic offices and operational sites. Contribute to the deployment and monitoring of physical security measures to protect employees, visitors and company assets. Assist in the administration and continuous improvement of physical security systems, including access control, CCTV, intrusion detection and visitor management solutions. Support badge administration and access rights governance. Participate in the management, investigation and follow-up of physical security incidents, including reporting and corrective action tracking. Maintain security procedures, standards, documentation and operational playbooks. Support Business Continuity and Crisis Management activities through exercises, documentation and preparedness initiatives. Coordinate with Workplace, HR, IT, Legal, Compliance and external security providers on security-related projects. Monitor physical security KPIs and prepare dashboards and management reports. Support workplace security awareness initiatives promoting employee safety and security best practices. Conduct research and benchmarking on emerging physical security technologies, industry trends and best practices. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm! This apprenticeship is for you if: You are a Master's student in Physical Security, Corporate Security, Risk Management, Crisis Management or a related field, looking for a 12-month apprenticeship. You have a strong interest in protecting people, assets and business operations within an international environment. You are passionate about physical security, risk prevention and business resilience. You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess risks and propose pragmatic solutions. You are organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities. You handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion. You possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams. You are comfortable using Microsoft 365 and collaborative workplace tools. You are proactive, autonomous and eager to learn. You possess strong written and verbal communication skills in English (French would be a plus). A first experience (internship, apprenticeship or academic project) in Corporate Security, Physical Security, Facilities Management, Risk Management, Business Continuity or HSE would be an asset. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 If your application is shortlisted, Claudia will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). You will then complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). Next, you will meet the Senior Physical Security Officer , who will be your future mentor. Finally, Claudia will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes around four weeks to ensure an optimal candidate experience. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 ✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic) 🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport) 🏡 Hybrid work model 📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year 🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin 🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life 🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…) Apprenticeship or Professionalization Contract starting in September 2026 – Based in Bordeaux Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX All our positions are open to people with disabilities.
