role: Product Management Intern, End User Experience - Winter 2027
description: ***1Password is growing.** We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.* **About 1Password** *At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.* *If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.* We're looking for a promising new Product Manager Intern who is excited about gaining hands-on experience in a friendly and fast-paced environment. At 1Password, the Product Management organization plays a key role to ensure our products and features solve the most important customer problems. As a Product Manager Intern, you will work closely with development, design, and other functions to deliver solutions that have both customer and business value. The End User Experience team is responsible for the daily activities of users across B2C and B2B. We are also stewards of the Family Organizer role. This is a MASSIVE surface area to cover and a huge opportunity for someone looking for a challenging new role. We'll help you gain valuable experience and realize your potential as a product manager, and hope that you'll leave us with a passion for learning, some new friends, and the self-confidence to take on whatever comes next. This is a remote opportunity within Canada/US. This position will be for 4 months - January to April 2027. **What You Can Expect:** - Develop deep customer empathy through interviews, research, and data analysis - Work closely with your counterparts in development and design to scope and deliver impactful features - Assist in gathering new evidence of problems in the customer base and market - Represent Product Management in various meetings such as agile ceremonies - Perform research on competition and trends as needed - Use and help mature the implementation of our Product Management processes and tooling, particularly with AI **What we're looking for:** - Confidence: A willingness to take on new challenges, and see them through to completion. - Humility: You're not afraid to ask "stupid" questions and make mistakes (as long as you learn from them). - Curiosity: You look for better ways of doing things, even if everyone seems happy with how they are. - Teamwork: We work together, and succeed as a team! **Bonus points for:** - Experience writing and refining detailed requirements. - An understanding of general technologies, coding tools, and leveraging AI - Exposure to Pragmatic Marketing or other Product Management frameworks. - Personal experience using 1Password (or other password managers). **Our culture** At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, *1Password is not for everyone*. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged at 1Password—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. **Our approach to remote work** We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of most roles. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. **How we’re using AI today** Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers. **What we offer** We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 🏝 Generous PTO policy - 2.08 days per month (1.5 work weeks per 4 month term) 💖 Company-wide wellness days (1 per quarter) 🌎 Employee-led inclusion and belonging programs and ERGs 🏠 Remote-first environment 🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly 💡 1Password University access and learning sessions 🥳 Monthly internship events and socials *1Password is part of*[*Team True North*](https://www.communitech.ca/how-we-help/team-true-north/)*, a comprehensive group of Canadian tech firms with performance and growth rates that match the top 1% of companies worldwide – companies with the highest probability of reaching $1 billion in annual revenue. We believe in tech for good, and establishing Canada as a preferred destination for growing careers wherever we can!* **You belong here.** *1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.* *Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at and we’ll work to meet your needs.* *Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.* *Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.* *1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. You will work closely with product owners and other developers to build and optimize systems that ingest, parse, and index content from thousands of online sources. The work we do is diverse, challenging, and rewarding. Agility PR Solutions develops state-of-the-art tools that help public relations professionals discover media influencers and derive actionable insights from global media coverage. In this role, you will contribute to both: Backend and pipeline systems (Java, event-driven architecture with Kafka, search indexing with Solr) Content acquisition and integration (TypeScript, web scraping and crawling, source integrations) You will solve problems related to large-scale data processing, distributed workloads, and content quality, while learning how our pipelines power AI-driven product capabilities. At Agility PR Solutions, we value collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning. You’ll be part of a team that supports growth, knowledge sharing, and innovation. description: Position Summary Acuren Group is recruiting an Engineer in Training (EIT) to join our Structural Engineering team. Acuren is one of North America's largest providers of integrated inspection, testing, and engineering services, operating across 110+ locations and serving clients in the oil & gas, power, petrochemical, and building infrastructure sectors. In this role, you will develop hands-on expertise in structural integrity assessment, fitness-for-service evaluations, and field inspection programs — working directly with clients across industrial facilities, plant sites, and civil infrastructure. Under the mentorship of senior structural engineers, you will grow toward independent project leadership and, in time, the professional certification responsibilities that come with it. Responsibilities Field Inspection & Structural Programs Travel to client sites to lead and oversee structural inspection programs for industrial structures, buildings, platforms, and civil infrastructure Perform condition assessments of steel, concrete, and wood structures, identifying deficiencies and recommending remediation strategies Conduct and support lifting equipment inspections (cranes, hoists, rigging, and custom lifting fixtures) in accordance with ASME B30 and applicable provincial standards; progress toward signing off on lifting equipment inspection certifications Operate in industrial environments including refineries, chemical plants, and power generation facilities; field travel is expected up to 50% of the time depending on client scheduling Engineering Analysis & Assessment Support fitness-for-service (FFS) assessments for structural systems and mechanical equipment — including storage tanks, pressure vessels, and pipelines — in accordance with API 579-1/ASME FFS-1 and related standards Develop and apply finite element analysis (FEA) models to evaluate structural integrity under various loading conditions (pressure, gravity, thermal, displacement) Assist with structural analysis and design for rehabilitation, repair, and load-upgrade projects Integrate field inspection data (LiDAR scans, UT thickness, NDT results) into engineering models to support accurate, defensible assessments Project & Client Delivery Act as site lead on structural inspection projects, managing field activities, client communication, and timely report delivery Prepare professional engineering reports documenting findings, analysis, and recommendations Proactively understand client requirements and identify opportunities for additional Acuren services Follow up with clients on implementation of recommendations and support ongoing inspection program planning Manage work within budget and schedule, ensuring efficient use of resources Requirements University degree in Civil or Structural Engineering; Mechanical Engineering considered with relevant structural coursework Membership in, or eligibility for, the applicable provincial engineering association (P.Eng. in progress); registration as an EIT required Genuine interest in structural integrity and inspection work; prior co-op or project experience in structural analysis, industrial inspection, or a related field is an asset Familiarity with structural engineering standards (e.g., NBCC, CSA S16, ACI 318) and exposure to pressure equipment or mechanical standards (API, ASME) is a plus Proficiency in structural analysis software and/or FEA tools is an asset Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce clear, client-ready technical reports Ability to work effectively in industrial environments and comply with site safety requirements Understanding of, and commitment to, applicable provincial Occupational Health and Safety legislation, ISO systems, and Acuren's Safety and Quality Management Systems Proficiency in MS Office; valid Class 5 driver's licence with a clean driving record required Benefits The strength of Acuren lies in its outstanding people. As a rapidly growing, intensely innovative, international publicly traded company, the opportunities to pursue challenging and diverse career development paths are vast. Complemented by an attractive and comprehensive total compensation package, including paid time off, employer paid benefits, RRSP + Company match, tuition grants, discounted fitness memberships and insurance offerings, employee assistance programs and more! At Acuren we commit to the principles of a respectful workplace and offer tremendous opportunities to those who wish to succeed.Join our team at Acuren and embark on a rewarding journey where you will contribute to the company's growth and success while advancing your career. Apply now to be part of our dedicated team of professionals. Company Overview Acuren’s strength begins with its people. Guided by our values— People First, Integrity Always, One Team, Higher Standards, and Innovative —we work to create safe, respectful, and high-performing environments for our employees, clients, and communities. We are honored that our people have recognized Acuren as worthy of inclusion in the Forbes 2024 and 2025 list of Canada’s Best Employers. This recognition reflects the importance we place on investing in our people, protecting everyone we work with, and acting with integrity in every engagement. Acuren delivers comprehensive inspection, testing, certification, and asset integrity solutions that help organizations ensure critical assets are safe, compliant, and optimized for reliable performance. Our specialized expertise and advanced capabilities support clients across energy, industrial, and public infrastructure sectors. Our services include inspection; traditional and advanced NDE/NDT; failure analysis; rope access; materials, field, and reliability engineering; drones; robotics; V-Deck; and condition-based monitoring. Through these capabilities, we help clients evaluate asset condition, manage operational risk, and make informed decisions throughout the asset lifecycle. Our work supports the integrity and safety of assets across petroleum refining, pipelines, power generation, pulp and paper, mining, pharmaceutical, aerospace, and automotive industries. Acuren employs more than 5,000 professionals who support mechanical integrity and inspection programs across industrial sectors. Our approach is practical and focused: provide capable local teams with certified, well-equipped personnel supported by trained and experienced leaders. Building on a strong heritage of safety, quality, and professionalism, we continue to advance technical capabilities and support reliability programs that create value for clients and employees. This role is designed for someone who is organized, curious, dependable, and eager to learn how engineering projects are planned, tracked, and supported. The intern will work closely with the Project Administrator, Project Managers, and technical staff to help with repeatable project coordination tasks, data organization, documentation, meeting support, and routine reporting. This position will play an important support role in helping project teams stay organized, communicate clearly, and keep project information current. **What You'll Be Doing:** - Project Coordination Support: Assist the Project Administrator or Project Managers with day-to-day tracking for multiple engineering projects, including maintaining task lists, updating project tracking tools, organizing project folders, and following up on routine action items. Help track project onboarding items, training requirements, site access needs, deliverable lists, and assigned project roles under the direction of the Project Administrator or Project Manager. Handle project, client, budget, and contract-related information with appropriate care and discretion. - Planning and Scheduling Support: Assist with maintaining project schedules, work plans, internal deadlines, and deliverable calendars. Help compare current project information against planned milestones and flag missing, outdated, incomplete, or inconsistent information for follow-up. - Portfolio Organization: Support organization across multiple active projects by maintaining shared tracking tools, project lists, reference materials, and recurring reporting tools. Learn how project priorities, client needs, and internal deadlines are balanced across a portfolio of work. Manage shifting priorities while staying organized, communicating clearly with stakeholders, and approaching challenges with persistence, curiosity, and follow-through. - Budget and Schedule Tracking Support: Assist with updating project budget and schedule tracking tools and related project records, helping identify missing or inconsistent data. The intern may help prepare routine summaries or status updates for review by the Project Administrator or Project Manager. - Data Management and Excel Support: Use Excel to organize project data, maintain trackers, clean up spreadsheets, perform basic checks, and support routine reporting. A strong working knowledge of Excel is expected, including comfort with formulas, filters, sorting, formatting, and basic charts or summaries. Interest in learning more advanced Excel tools, such as pivot tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, or macros, is strongly preferred. - Administrative Support, Documentation, and Meeting Support: Assist with meeting scheduling, preparation, agenda notes, minutes, action item tracking, project documentation, and status updates. Take clear notes during project meetings and client meetings, prepare and distribute meeting notes, and help track action items through completion. Help keep folders, references, and project records organized and current. - Communication Support: Communicate clearly and professionally with project team members and, as appropriate, clients to request information, confirm details, and follow up on routine items under supervision. This role requires someone who is comfortable asking questions, taking direction, documenting answers, and following up when information is incomplete or unclear. - Process Improvement: Help identify repeatable tasks that can be clarified, simplified, or better documented. Contribute to checklists, templates, tracking tools, and other practical tools that improve consistency and reduce rework. - Professional Skills and Personal Qualities: Demonstrate strong communication, organization, curiosity, reliability, and follow-through. The ideal intern will be comfortable asking questions, learning new tools, taking initiative on assigned tasks, and persisting respectfully when information is needed. A positive attitude, strong attention to detail, willingness to learn, and tenacity are important for success in this role. **What You'll Need:** - A technical background is preferred, including coursework, internship experience, or early career experience in structural, civil, mechanical, or another engineering discipline; hard sciences or construction management may also be considered. - Candidates should have strong Excel skills, an interest in project controls or project management, and a willingness to learn tools such as Microsoft Project. - Prior experience in an administrative, project coordination, or project controls support role is helpful but not required. - Candidates are not required to perform technical work, but opportunities to support both administrative and technical activities may be available for those interested in doing both. This internship may also provide a path toward a longer-term or permanent role for the right candidate. **Benefits Overview:** Full-time temporary employees are eligible for medical insurance, paid holidays and sick leave. Supporting the preparation and assessment of traffic signal layouts and junction improvement proposals. Contributing to road safety assessments and audits, helping to identify potential issues and develop appropriate solutions. Supporting the development of active travel and sustainable transport schemes, considering the interaction between pedestrians, cyclists, public transport, and general traffic. Assisting with the preparation of technical reports, drawings, calculations, presentations, and other project documentation. role: Remote Armed Security Officer/CDL Driver (Rotational)- Kuparuk - CP
description: Job Description The Remote Armed Security Officer provides professional armed security services for commercial and industrial clients in remote environments where health, safety, and security are the highest priorities. Assigned to the Kuparuk oil field, this position is responsible for protecting personnel, facilities, equipment, and critical infrastructure through proactive security operations, access control, emergency response, and customer service while ensuring compliance with company and client policies. All duties are performed in accordance with NMS' mission, vision, and values. This position follows a two (2) weeks on, two (2) weeks off rotational schedule and is based at the Kuparuk oil field. Responsibilities Conduct routine armed security patrols of assigned buildings, facilities, and grounds by foot, vehicle, or electronic monitoring systems to ensure the safety and security of personnel, property, and critical infrastructure. Control access to client facilities by verifying identification and authorizing entry for employees, visitors, contractors, and authorized personnel. Inspect doors, windows, gates, fences, and other access points to ensure they are properly secured and report any deficiencies. Observe, document, and report property damage, unusual occurrences, suspicious activity, safety hazards, and security incidents. Enforce company and client policies and procedures by providing direction to individuals, addressing rule violations, and removing unauthorized persons from the property when appropriate. Notify personnel of visitors and coordinate visitor access in accordance with established procedures. Respond appropriately to alarms, emergencies, medical incidents, fires, and other critical situations to protect life, property, and client assets. Operate and maintain camp billeting, visitor management, and electronic access control systems while ensuring accurate documentation of authorized personnel and visitors. Monitor facility systems, including fire protection, security, lighting, heating, ventilation, and related building systems, and report operational concerns as required. Safely carry and maintain assigned firearms and security equipment in accordance with company policy, state regulations, and contract requirements. Provide transportation services using vehicles ranging from standard passenger vehicles to buses and off-road vehicles, as required. Provide emergency medical response, including CPR, AED use, basic first aid, and patient movement, within the scope of training and certification. Promptly report unsafe conditions, equipment deficiencies, or sanitation concerns to the appropriate supervisor. Complete incident reports, daily activity logs, and other required documentation accurately and in a timely manner. Perform other duties as assigned in support of departmental and operational objectives. Qualifications High school diploma or GED equivalent required. Minimum of three (3) years of full-time professional experience in security, law enforcement, or military service. Relevant post-secondary education may be substituted for a portion of the required experience. A valid Class B Commercial driver’s license with passenger endorsement, air brake endorsement and valid CDL medical card. Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record for the previous three (3) years to be eligible under company vehicle insurance policy. Ability to obtain an Alaska Guard License prior to employment. The applicant is responsible for the applicable licensing fee. Must obtain and maintain a State of Alaska Armed Guard License upon hire. Must demonstrate safe handgun handling skills and successfully pass a law enforcement-style firearms qualification in accordance with contract requirements. Ability to qualify for required credentials and certifications, including but not limited to TWIC and ATF Explosives Possessor authorization, as required by the contract. Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and contract-specific software. Must successfully complete all pre-employment requirements, which may include a criminal background check, drug screening, physical examination, fit-for-duty assessment, and hearing test. Applicants who do not reside near an approved testing facility are responsible for travel expenses to the nearest testing location. Ability to reside in dormitory-style accommodations and comply with remote camp standards, including housekeeping and cleanliness requirements. Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team while maintaining positive relationships with coworkers, clients, and customers. Ability to exercise sound judgment and make effective decisions with minimal supervision, particularly during emergency situations. Ability to work a two (2) weeks on, two (2) weeks off rotational schedule. Ability to stand and/or walk for up to twelve (12) hours per shift and perform duties in remote Arctic weather conditions. Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand English as required by the contract. Must comply with all company and client safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements. CANDIDATES RESIDING OUTSIDE ANCHORAGE AREA: Candidates residing in the Lower 48 for any contract and/or hired for the BP contract: For the purposes of pre-employment testing, Anchorage will be considered the point of hire (with the exception of drug testing, which will be conducted near the candidate’s place of residence). Employee is responsible for any travel expenses and needed accommodations related to pre−employment tasks that need to be completed in Anchorage, AK. This includes, but is not limited to, any safety training requirements, required pre−employment testing and/or training such as physical, DOT physical/medical card, fit for duty, audiogram, and/or other testing required by contract/company (such as NSTC, APICC training, security licensing requirements, etc. Candidates residing in Alaska for Alyeska and Hillcorp contracts: pre-employment testing will be scheduled near the candidate’s area of residence within the state. The only exception is when the candidate lives in a region without the necessary service providers to complete all requirements. Flights to Remote Locations: All employees are responsible for all expenses related to reporting to point of hire (Anchorage, AK) for scheduled trips paid for by the company for remote locations. Working Conditions and Physical Requirements Weather: Indoors and Outdoors, frequently exposed to arctic outdoor weather conditions. Noise level: Moderate to Loud. Description of environment: This is a remote camp environment. Physical requirements: Employee is required to lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. Frequently to constantly required to sit, stand, walk, use hands/fingers to handle or feel, climb, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, talk/hear, see, taste/smell, and carry weight/lift. Fit For Duty Test: Lift: Lift 50 lbs. from floor to knuckle x2 Lift: Lift 50 lbs. from floor to waist x 2 Carry: Carry 35 lbs. with two hands for a minimum distance of 150 feet, self-paced Allow a 60 second rest break after 75 feet. Push: push horizontally with a peak force of 60 f-lbs. with two hands Pull: pull horizontally with a peak force of 60 f-lbs. with two hands. Stoop & Twist: Perform alternate cross over toe touches x 10 each side, self-paced but continuous. Kneel: Kneel on one knee and stand. Return to kneel on opposite knee. Repeat alternate kneeling sequence x 3 for each knee, self-pace but continuous. Stand from Supine Position Test: From a supine, recumbent position, while wearing arctic gear , test recipient must be able to stand without assistance x 3, self-paced (this task must be accomplished safely without significant loss of balance or falling.) Allow one re-test when there is a loss of balance considered unsafe or a fall. Walk: Walk on a treadmill at 3 MPH for 10 minutes with good balance, Stairs: Climb up and down 10 steps x 2 for a total of 20 steps, self-paced. Shoveling: Perform a shovel test for five (5) minutes self-paced but continuous (i.e., no breaks) using a standard snow shovel with a 3 lb. weight attached to the shovel blade. (e.g. sand bag weight securely taped to the shovel blade.) Stairs & Carry: Climb up and down 10 steps x 2 for a total of 20 steps while carrying 30 lbs. in one hand and using the other hand to grasp a railing for safety, self-paced. Allow a 60 second rest period after climbing up and down 10 steps while carrying. Competencies Customer Service – Provides outstanding customer service; manages difficult or emotional situations; responds promptly to customer needs; responds to request for service and assistance; meets commitments in a timely manner. Interpersonal Skills – Focuses on solving conflict; maintains confidentiality; listens to others without interrupting; keeps emotions under control; remains open to other ideas. Oral Communication – Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions; demonstrates group presentation skills; participates in meetings. Written Communication – Writes incident, logs and other reports clearly; able to read and interpret written information.

From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. This is a general application used to fill multiple internship openings across our Vehicle Controls teams. description: WELLTOWER – REIMAGINE REAL ESTATE WITH US At Welltower, we’re transforming how the world thinks about senior living and wellness-focused real estate. As a global leader in residential wellness and healthcare infrastructure, we create vibrant, purpose-driven communities where housing, healthcare, and hospitality converge. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and endlessly ambitious—guided by our mantra: The only easy day was yesterday. We’re looking for bold, independent thinkers who thrive on challenge, embrace complexity, and are driven to deliver long-term value. Every team member is empowered to think like an owner, innovate fearlessly, and lead from where they stand. If you're passionate about outcomes and inspired by the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare infrastructure, we want you on our best-in-class team. SUMMARY We are seeking a Summer Interior Design Coordinator Intern to support Welltower’s West Coast Design team. This internship provides hands-on exposure to large-scale design projects for senior living residential real estate and will support projects from design development through installation and closeout. The intern will work closely with Catie Underhill and the broader Design team while gaining practical experience in sourcing, documentation, field coordination, vendor communication, and project execution. This is a field-based role requiring a home office and residence in Northern California or Southern California, with travel to properties within the assigned region as needed. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Participate in and support the design team through all phases of multiple design projects, from design development through construction management and installation. Assist with sourcing furniture, fabrics, fixtures, and finishes in line with project needs, the design team’s vision, and project budget. Develop furniture, fabric, finish, and material studies for in-house designers. Assist in preparing and maintaining finish schedules, specifications, furnishing budgets, product logs, and shop drawings. Coordinate with architects, contractors, vendors, and operator partners to support project execution. Assist with scheduling installations, field verification, and punch-list completion. Attend and support design presentations, progress meetings, frame walks, installations, final walks, and follow-up meetings. Maintain project documentation and records and assist with vendor invoice coordination and payment documentation. Build productive relationships with the Design team, design showrooms, vendors, consultants, and operator partners. Stay current with design trends, materials, building codes, regulations, and industry standards relevant to residential, hospitality, and commercial design. Use and continue developing proficiency in one or more of the following: AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop), Revit, Microsoft Office, SketchUp, and Design Manager. Escalate project issues requiring design decisions to the Interior Design Manager. Assist the VP of Design and the broader Design team with special design projects as necessary. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. TRAVEL This role may require regular travel (up to 50%) to properties throughout Northern and Southern California, as well as occasional travel to regional offices, design showrooms, vendor locations, and project installations as needed. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree program in Interior Design, Architecture, Interior Architecture, or a related field; students who have not yet completed their degree are encouraged to apply. Prior professional design experience is not required; relevant coursework, design studio experience, internships, or project-based experience is preferred. Interest in hospitality, multi-family, commercial, or senior living design; prior senior living design experience is not required. Working knowledge of, or coursework using, design tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, InDesign, Photoshop, PowerPoint, and SketchUp is preferred. Basic understanding of building codes and ADA/accessibility principles is preferred; willingness to learn is required. Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment. Strong organization, multitasking, prioritization, and deadline-management skills, with attention to detail and a willingness to take initiative. Valid driver’s license and ability to travel, including occasional overnight trips and flights, as required for project work. description: Welcome to GEP Who We Are GEP, with over 30 offices internationally, is the fastest growing procurement and supply chain solutions firm – consulting, software and managed services. GEP has succeeded by being smart and creative; solving complex problems and finding opportunities for the world’s largest organizations. How You Grow at GEP We recognize people who make a genuine difference, work hard and drive achievements. Results are noticed and rewarded. It’s how you will grow a career at GEP, and in a much shorter time frame than at other firms. Celebrating Everyone GEP succeeds through the ideas and creativity of our team members so we embrace people of all experiences, nationalities, abilities, cultures, races, gender identities, sexual orientations and ages. What makes you unique and different is celebrated and will help GEP stand out even more. And we are a women-founded and -owned company so our foundation is making GEP a great place to work for women, a place where women can learn, advance and give back. About the Role At GEP, we develop our Business Network platform to help companies exchange invoices and other business documents electronically across international markets. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding business needs, solving problems, and translating complex information into clear requirements. Working closely with Product Managers and R&D, you will help us develop country-specific e-invoicing and compliance capabilities, assessing how new requirements fit our existing solutions. You do not need to be an e-invoicing expert to join us. We welcome junior candidates with strong analytical potential and an interest in technology. We provide training in our platform, solutions, and compliance domain. What You Will Do • Analyze business processes and country-specific e-invoicing and reporting requirements, including Continuous Transaction Controls (CTC). • Compare new requirements with existing platform capabilities, identifying what can be reused, configured, or extended. • Translate findings into clear business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, and acceptance criteria. • Work with Product Managers, R&D, and customer-facing teams to clarify needs, evaluate options, and build a shared understanding. • Support development and testing by answering questions, reviewing expected behavior, and identifying gaps or exceptional scenarios. • Maintain practical documentation in Jira and Confluence, and identify opportunities to improve our solutions and ways of working. What You Bring • Strong analytical thinking and a structured approach to problem-solving. • At least 1 year of relevant experience in business analysis, data analysis, solution analysis or project management, or a similar role supporting software products, integrations or coordination related. • The ability to research unfamiliar topics, ask relevant questions, and turn findings into clear documentation. • An interest in technology and a willingness to understand how systems, integrations, and data flows work. • A proactive, collaborative approach and fluent written and spoken English. Nice to Have — Not Required • Familiarity with APIs, XML/JSON, system integrations, or data mapping. • Experience with WebMethods or Node.js. • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools. • Experience in data, solution or business analysis, implementation, technical support, invoicing, or electronic document exchange. What We Offer • Training and support to develop your product, compliance, and technical analysis skills. • Close collaboration with experienced Product Managers, analysts, and R&D teams. • The opportunity to contribute to international solutions and take increasing ownership as your experience grows. • A hybrid working model combining flexibility with regular collaboration in our Toruń office.

**Overview** Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized scientists and engineers, who pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment. Gray Systems Lab ([GSL](https://azuredata.microsoft.com/)) is an applied research lab within Azure Data. We conduct research and development in databases, big data, and cloud systems, working closely with product teams to design innovative solutions to real-world problems. Our team is friendly and inclusive. We focus on a variety of exciting areas, including: machine learning for systems, reinforcement learning, fine-tuning and post-training techniques, agentic workflows and systems, resource management, query optimization and execution. We also work on workload optimization, graph analytics, data storage formats and governance, modern and emerging hardware (e.g., graphics processing units (GPUs), Non-Volatile Memory express (NVMe), and field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs)), program analysis, data provenance, and ontologies. Our work spans both Microsoft internal and open-source systems, including Fabric, Spark, Structured Query Language (SQL) Server, MySQL, Apache Iceberg, and others. We provide opportunities to pursue ideas arising from internal collaborations and external partnerships with universities, while remaining active scholars in the research community. We are looking for graduate students interested in cutting-edge research conducted in close collaboration with advanced industry product groups. Past Research Internships have resulted in both production-system impact and publications at top conferences. Applicants should demonstrate a track record in one or more areas of systems, databases, or data science, as well as an aptitude for hands-on system building and rigorous experimental design, including running and analyzing experiments at scale. **Responsibilities** Research Interns put inquiry and theory into practice. Alongside fellow doctoral candidates and some of the world’s best researchers, Research Interns learn, collaborate, and network for life. Research Interns not only advance their own careers, but they also contribute to exciting research and development strides. During the 12-week internship, Research Interns are paired with mentors and expected to collaborate with other Research Interns and researchers, present findings, and contribute to the vibrant life of the community. Research internships are available in all areas of research, and are offered year-round, though they typically begin in the summer. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** - Currently enrolled in a Doctorate Degree program in computer science, statistics, mathematics, or relevant field. **Other Requirements** - Research Interns are expected to be physically located in their manager’s Microsoft worksite location for the duration of their internship. - In addition to the qualifications below, you’ll need to submit a minimum of two reference letters for this position as well as a cover letter and any relevant work or research samples. After you submit your application, a request for letters may be sent to your list of references on your behalf. Note that reference letters cannot be requested until after you have submitted your application, and furthermore, that they might not be automatically requested for all candidates. You may wish to alert your letter writers in advance, so they will be ready to submit your letter. **Preferred Qualifications** - Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages, such as Python, Java, C#, C++, Rust. - Experience with one of the following: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Spark, Apache Iceberg, CUDA, or other database or big data systems. - Experience contributing to research communities and/or efforts, including publishing papers (being listed as author) at academic conferences. - Ability to take initiative but also follow a research/productization plan and work well as part of a team. - Proficient critical thinking and communication skills. The base pay range for this internship is USD $6,810 - $13,480 per month. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $8,920 - $14,610 per month. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. Public safety, critical infrastructure, and enterprise customers rely on Remote Flight Deck (RFD), Skydio’s browser-based piloting experience, to get eyes on the scene in seconds and coordinate a response. ## **Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing!** **Multiply Labs** is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: **the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more.** Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. ## **Why This Matters** We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next-generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. ## **The Stack & the Scale** - **The Mission:** Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. - **The Technology:** Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dexterous manipulation, and imitation learning. - **The Location:** Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. - **The Backing:** Supported by premier investors, including **Casdin Capital, Lux Capital, and Y Combinator.** To learn more and to view a video of our robots in action, visit us at [](https://www.multiplylabs.com) and follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/multiply-labs). ### About the Role We are looking for a Mechanical Engineering Co-op/Intern to join our team in San Francisco for a full-time co-op/internship position starting in January 2027. You will apply your engineering skills to design robotic cartridges and consumables involved in the manufacturing of novel pharmaceutical products. You’ll work directly with a cross-functional hardware and software team on designing and building the current and next generations of Multiply Labs’ robotic consumables. The work spans selecting and designing consumables, setting high-level design goals, building prototypes, and taking designs to production. You’ll succeed in this role if you can optimize designs using first-principles engineering approaches. We run several projects at once, so you’ll need strong documentation skills and the ability to turn ideas into action. You’ll help drive decisions on major projects while coordinating with colleagues. ### Responsibilities - Own consumable and robotic design projects - Investigate applicable technologies and components - Prototype, test, and iterate on designs - Create supporting design documentation, including 3D CAD models and detailed drawings ### Qualifications - Currently working towards a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering or a related field - Strong mechanical fundamentals, creative problem-solving, attention to detail, and communication skills - Ability to solve complex technical problems by breaking them down into simpler pieces and executable tasks - Experience with 3D CAD software (Onshape, SolidWorks, etc.), including modeling and creation of detailed drawings - Knowledge of mechanical components, common engineering metals, plastics, joining methods, part fabrication methods, and finishing operations - Understanding of design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA) principles - Highly motivated, independent, curious, and eager to learn *Additional preferred qualifications:* - Experience iterating through design cycles from concept through production, including concept generation, downselection, rapid prototyping, testing, analysis, and manufacturing - Hands-on experience with machine shop and prototyping tools ### Physical & Working Conditions - Ability to reach, stoop, crouch, and kneel, including entering and working inside a robotic cluster for maintenance, cleaning, or intervention - Ability to lift up to 25 lbs (equipment, parts, tools) and up to 5 lbs overhead - Manual dexterity to use hand tools, manage cabling, and perform mechanical adjustments - Work primarily in a manufacturing area adjacent to a lab; must follow strict safety protocols (e.g., BSL-2) and maintain situational awareness - Potential exposure to hazardous materials, including biological agents and cryogenics, while servicing equipment - Required use of PPE (lab coat, safety glasses, gloves) for extended periods - Flexible schedule, with occasional evenings or weekends for time-sensitive builds or testing ### Total Rewards & Life at Multiply Labs - **Competitive Compensation:** $5,000/month. - **Real Ownership:** Own meaningful design projects on robots that go into production, not side tasks. - **Mentorship:** Work side by side with experienced mechanical, robotics, and software engineers. - **Office Perks:** An energetic SF office culture featuring **catered team lunches**, stocked kitchen, and frequent team events. - **Great people, meaningful work**, and a team that genuinely **believes in what we’re building**. - **No Set Hours:** Set your own schedule in alignment with your manager and team. We hold a high bar, measuring success by impact and outcomes—not hours logged. Come build the world’s best robots—and help make life-saving therapies accessible to all.

role: KIP Spring 2027 - Data Analysis Intern - Open The Books
description: **[The Koch Internship Program](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/koch-internship-program/) (KIP)** is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the [admissions process](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/application-process/) early! **About Open the Books** [Open the Books](https://www.openthebooks.com/) is a project of American Transparency, a 501(c)(3) dedicated to educating the public on waste, fraud and abuse and fighting for real-time spending transparency. We believe transparency building block of representative government that makes all our other freedoms possible. We operate the largest private database of public spending in history: 10 billion points of data that includes all federal salaries, line-by-line federal spending, all 50 state “checkbooks,” millions of state-level salaries and pension funds, and spending across more than 17,000 municipalities. We won’t stop until we’ve captured every dime and put it online, in a close to real-time as possible. The database is open to journalists, researchers, activists, public officials – and most importantly – every American taxpayer. **About the role** The Data Analysis Intern will help brainstorm and develop creative research projects that leverage Open the Books’ proprietary database to tell unique stories about government waste. Leveraging the nation’s largest repository of public spending, a successful candidate will be excited to consider data comparisons that can move the needle on the conversation about wasteful spending at every level of government (federal, state and local). Candidates with an interest in quantitative research and those who follow the news cycle closely will be a fit with our team of watchdog journalists! **This is a full-time, fully remote role.** ### Responsibilities - Work with Deputy Policy Director to understand the depth and breadth of available datasets - Work with the Deputy Policy Director and analyze the relevant datasets to draw interesting conclusions - Brainstorm and pitch comparative analyses that can offer taxpayers new insights about the efficacy of public spending ### Qualifications - Willing to proactively report progress and pitch ideas in a remote work environment - Proficient with Microsoft Excel with an interest in further training on data analytics tools. - Experience with visualization tools like Tableau, PowerBI or comparable tools is a plus. - Enthusiastic about using data to tell surprising, counterintuitive stories about public policy outcomes - Aligned with our vision to hold government accountable for its use of tax dollars and steer public spending back toward founding principles

**About Blueprint** Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology. Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams. At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build. **Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.** ## In this role You will design, build, and maintain the infrastructure, automation tools, and deployment pipelines that support software development and AI model training workflows. This hands-on role combines DevOps engineering, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and build and release engineering to improve reliability, reduce manual work, and help engineering teams deliver software efficiently. You will troubleshoot complex technical issues, automate repetitive processes, and support end-to-end development and deployment workflows in a collaborative, onsite engineering environment. ## Responsibilities - Design, build, maintain, and optimize continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. - Automate software build, testing, validation, packaging, deployment, and release processes. - Develop Python scripts and automation tools to streamline engineering and operational workflows. - Provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure and development environments. - Manage source control, branching strategies, build systems, artifact management, and release workflows. - Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration automation. - Manage software dependencies, environment configurations, credentials, secrets, and deployment settings. - Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational health checks. - Troubleshoot build failures, deployment issues, infrastructure problems, networking, and environment configuration challenges. - Improve system reliability, deployment consistency, release quality, and developer productivity through automation. - Support containerized applications and deployment environments where applicable. - Identify repetitive manual processes and develop automated solutions to improve engineering efficiency. - Collaborate with software engineers and technical stakeholders to improve development, testing, and deployment workflows. - Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides. - Evaluate and implement tools and technologies that improve automation, infrastructure management, and engineering workflows. ## Required Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field. - 2+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD, build engineering, or release engineering. - Strong Python programming and scripting skills. - Experience with Microsoft Azure or another major cloud platform. - Experience with Git and modern source control workflows. - Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms. - Understanding of software build, testing, deployment, and release processes. - Experience troubleshooting infrastructure, build, deployment, and environment issues. - Familiarity with Windows and/or Linux operating environments. - Ability to independently investigate technical problems, identify root causes, and implement solutions. - Strong technical communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. ## Preferred Qualifications - Experience with Azure DevOps and GitHub. - Experience with Docker and containerized application environments. - Familiarity with Kubernetes or other container orchestration technologies. - Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or Ansible. - Experience with monitoring, logging, observability, and alerting solutions. - Familiarity with networking, identity and access management, certificates, secrets management, and cloud security. - Experience supporting development, testing, staging, and production environments. - Experience building automation for AI model training, deployment pipelines, or other machine learning engineering workflows. - Experience working in large-scale technology or enterprise engineering environments. **Salary Range** At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities. Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore [Have Fun](https://www.playthatmovesyou.com/p/have-fun) and [Is Motion Gaming Back?](https://www.playthatmovesyou.com/p/is-motion-gaming-back), as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations. Nex employees may be expected to collaborate with colleagues across different time zones. Depending on the role and location, occasional travel may also be required for company events, external meetings, and other business-related activities. **Important Notice:** ⚠️ To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in **@nex.inc**. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us. **Location: San Jose, CA** **Type: Full Time Internship** ### **The Role** As a UI Motion Artist Intern, you’ll help bring our games and experiences to life through expressive, polished, and engaging UI motion. You’ll work across a variety of projects, each with its own unique visual style and audience. One day, you might be creating goofy, playful, and personality-driven UI animations for one of our games; the next, you could be designing clean, energetic, and polished motion for a fitness experience. From screen transitions and button interactions to UI animations and visual effects, you’ll learn how to adapt your motion design to support the tone, style, and goals of each project. With multiple projects across our team, you’ll have the opportunity to explore a wide range of UI motion styles, collaborate closely with artists and designers, and take your work from early ideas and prototypes through final implementation in Unity. This isn’t just portfolio work. Your work has the opportunity to ship in a real commercial product and be seen by over 500k+ users every day. **What You'll Do** - Create **UI motion, transitions, button interactions, and visual effects** that make our games and experiences feel polished, responsive, and engaging. - Work across a variety of projects and adapt your motion design to different visual styles—from **goofy, playful, and personality-driven games** to **clean and polished fitness experiences**. - Turn **static UI designs and game screens into dynamic, expressive experiences** through thoughtful animation and VFX. - Explore and prototype different **motion concepts, timing, transitions, and visual treatments** to find the right feel for each project. - Collaborate closely with **UI/UX designers, artists, and game designers** to ensure motion supports both the visual direction and the player experience. - Take UI motion from **concept and prototyping through final implementation in Unity**. - Create and maintain **reusable UI animation and VFX assets** while following established art and production guidelines. ### **Should Have** - **Must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program at an accredited college or university.** - Strong foundation in **UI motion design and animation**, with a good understanding of timing, pacing, easing, and visual feedback. - Ability to bring **static UI designs to life** through engaging transitions, button interactions, motion, and VFX. - Ability to **adapt to different visual styles**, from goofy and playful game experiences to clean and polished fitness interfaces. - **Who we are** Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress. Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that. Atoms builds Physical AI real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive. This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale. We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life. If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us. **About the Role** We are seeking an AI Research Intern to join our founding team and bridge the gap between high-level AI research and real-world physical actuation for our next-generation autonomous transport platforms. In this role, you will contribute to core research initiatives on Perception, World Models and Action models. You will help translate cutting-edge theoretical breakthroughs into scalable, real-world deployment on physical autonomous systems, driving how our platforms perceive, simulate, and navigate complex environments. **What you'll do** - Integrate emerging research from the broader AI community, identifying and prototyping the most promising solutions. - Design and build end-to-end multimodal models that translate real-time visual perception and high-level behavioral goals into physical vehicle actuation. - Research and develop cutting-edge RL and distillation techniques for trajectory planning. - Develop interactive world models from raw multi-sensor logs, allowing the team to re-simulate events and query what a vehicle would see if it altered its trajectory. - Ensure core autonomous driving models can seamlessly adapt to novel urban environments and edge cases. - Partner with validation and research teams to run model experiments through rigorous simulated scenarios, detecting regressions and identifying systemic performance bottlenecks. **What we're looking for** - **Education:** Currently enrolled in a PhD degree program in Computer Science, EECS, Robotics, AI, or a closely related field. - **Research Track Record:** Publications or active submissions in top-tier AI or robotics venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, RSS, ICRA, CoRL). - **Core Expertise:** PhD level research background focused on at least one of the following domains: - Generative World Models / Video Generation / Diffusion Models - Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or embodied AI - Reinforcement Learning (RL), trajectory optimization, or decision-making systems - Large-scale multimodal Transformer architectures applied to robotics or spatio-temporal data - **Framework Fluency:** Advanced hands-on proficiency with PyTorch or JAX for training and fine-tuning large-scale neural networks. - **Programming:** Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of C++. **Preferred qualifications** - Prior research or internship experience in autonomous driving, mobile robotics, or spatial AI. - Hands-on experience with Sensor Fusion integrating inputs across multi-camera setups, LiDAR, and Radar. - Familiarity with Bird’s-Eye-View (BEV) visual representations, 3D occupancy forecasting, multi-task learning, or specialized data tokenization for spatial data. - Prior experience with large-scale distributed training on GPU/TPU clusters (e.g., DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, Ray, or PyTorch FSDP). **Why join us** At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow. **What else you need to know** This role is based in our Mountain View or San Francisco office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change, we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week. The hourly pay range for this internship role is **$70/hr per hour.** Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis. **Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?** *#LI-Onsite*

En tant que Level Designer Assistant à Ubisoft Bordeaux, vous contribuerez à créer des espaces de jeu cohérents et agréables à parcourir pour un jeu encore non annoncé. Au sein de l’équipe de contenu, vous travaillerez sous la supervision d’une personne chargée de la conception de niveaux et en étroite collaboration avec les Level Artists. U ne convention de stage délivrée par votre école est nécessaire. Lieux : Bordeaux Ubisoft est une référence mondiale du jeu vidéo, avec des équipes réparties aux quatre coins du monde qui créent des expériences de jeu originales et mémorables, de Assassin’s Creed à Rainbow Six en passant par Just Dance et bien d’autres encore. Nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait progresser à la fois les joueurs et les équipes. Si vous êtes passionné·e par l’innovation et que vous souhaitez repousser les limites du divertissement, rejoignez notre aventure et aidez-nous à créer l’inconnu! Ubisoft Bordeaux Fondé en 2017 par une poignée d’ d'Ubisoft, notre studio compte plus de 400 talents issus de 20 nationalités différentes. Nos équipes interviennent sur les plus grandes franchises d’Ubisoft : sur Assassin’s Creed, avec la production en lead d'Assassin's Creed Mirage en 2023, sur Assassin's Creed Shadows et l'expansion Claws Of Awaji ou encore des jeux non-annoncés. Au-delà de nos productions AAA, nous contribuons à l'innovation technologique du groupe, grâce à notre pôle d'expertise autour du moteur de jeu Anvil et des services online d'Ubisoft, Online Services. Join VONQ’s HAPI Partnerships team for a hands-on dive into the world of SaaS and API integrations. As a Technical Support & Partner Enablement Intern, you won't just be "handling tickets", you will be a key player in ensuring our global partners (ATS & HCM systems) successfully launch their integrations. This role is designed for someone who wants to understand the "under the hood" mechanics of how software platforms talk to each other. What is HAPI HAPI (Hiring API) is VONQ’s powerful partner integration platform. It allows software providers to embed a marketplace of job boards directly into their systems. You’ll be working at the intersection of business strategy and technical implementation. Your Impact & Learning Journey: During this internship, you will transition from a learner to an owner in the following areas: Partner Onboarding: Learn to guide partners through the technical lifecycle, from initial documentation sharing to successful launch. Content Strategy: Own the HAPI Knowledge Base. You’ll learn how to translate complex technical concepts into clear, user-friendly documentation. Data Architecture: Gain a practical understanding of XML data mapping—the "language" of the job board industry—by helping partners sync their data with our network. Ecosystem Management: Proactively coordinate with job boards and partners via Slack and Teams, developing professional communication skills in a fast-paced B2B environment. Who You Are: Current Student: You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program for the entire duration of the internship. A Tech Enthusiast: You are curious about how APIs and SaaS platforms work (you don’t need to be a developer, but you enjoy "figuring things out"). An Organized Communicator: You can take a messy process and make it clear for others. English fluency is a must. Detail-Oriented: You enjoy the "puzzle" of data mapping and ensuring everything is in its right place. Location: Based in the Netherlands (Rotterdam area) is preferred for hybrid collaboration. The Practical Details: Compensation: €500–600 per month. Start date: ASAP - November 2026 Commitment: 4 or 5 days per week (minimum 30 hours) for the upcoming 6 months. Growth: You will work directly with our Partnerships and P&E teams, receiving consistent feedback and mentorship to help kickstart your career in Tech.

Du bist an verschiedenen Standorten der Bosch-Gruppe im Großraum Linz tätig, mit Schwerpunkt auf unseren Rexroth-Standorten in Oberösterreich. Du unterstützt uns dabei die OT-Sicherheitsrichtlinien auf Basis der IEC 62443 im Facility Management unserer Standorte ganzheitlich umzusetzen. Du setzt organisatorische und technische Security-Maßnahmen um, stimmst dich mit weiteren Bereichen der Security ab und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Systeme gegen Cyberbedrohungen gewappnet sind. Du stellst den sicheren Betrieb sowie den technischen und organisatorischen Lebenszyklus unserer bestehenden Applikationen und der zugehörigen Infrastruktur im Facility Management sicher. Du begleitest den lokalen Rollout neuer zentraler Anwendungen im Rahmen konzernweiter Projekte und übernimmst anschließend deren Betreuung. Du unterstützt bei der physischen Standortsicherheit und gestaltest die Schnittstelle zur zugrunde liegenden Infrastruktur, z. B. bei der Zutrittskontrolle, aktiv mit. Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: Du hast Lust auf Neues, stellst dich gerne komplexen Herausforderungen und möchtest dich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln. Potential projects include (not limited to): HRbot embedded into the intranet site that answers basic policy questions for employees or directs them to key contacts & reference materials; Creates workflows from ADP to create standard employee letters HRBP; Looks at data sources and creates logic to ensure data accuracy including automatic audits; tools for enhanced data analytics and predictive analytics; Library of “prompts” for HR team and managers Build and iterate small automations and agent workflows that connect to common tools and data sources (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, and Excel). Required Qualifications High School diploma or Equivalent Ability to adapt quickly and positively to changing priorities and processes. Ability to work under minimal supervision. Strong communication and organizational skills Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience using AI assistants for prompting and iteration (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) to draft, summarize, analyze, or automate work. Demonstrated ability to rapidly prototype and iterate AI-powered solutions (e.g., testing prompts, validating outputs, and refining workflows based on feedback).
