role: Early Adopter & Product Builder Intern, Creative AI
description: # # 🎨 About OpenArt OpenArt is an AI Storytelling and Visual Creation Platform used by millions worldwide. We’re building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We believe the future of creativity is AI-native, and we’re shaping that future. 🚀 Why Join OpenArt - **Real impact through leadership exposure** — work directly with C-level leaders and the key decision-making committee, with opportunities for your ideas and judgment to shape a product used by more than 10M users worldwide. - **A direct role in growth strategy** — help leadership assess where to expand, which customers and partners to prioritize, and how to plan for scale. - **Exposure to the creative AI ecosystem** — research the market and gather insights from creative professionals, agencies, model providers, operators and investors. - **Return offer opportunities** — strong interns will be considered for full-time roles across product, engineering, research and GTM. # **About the Role** You'll help shape how OpenArt feels to use. This role is for builders with a technical background and strong product taste: people who follow AI progress closely and know how to turn new capabilities into features creative professionals love. # Employment Type Year-round internship with rolling start dates: full-time in summer, part-time (15–20 hrs/week) during the fall and spring semesters. Minimum 3-month commitment # What You’ll Do - **Track tech progress:** follow new AI models, tools and tech trends at the cutting edge, often before public launch through early access, understand what each makes possible, and bring a regular take on what OpenArt should adopt or build. - **Turn ideas into features:** translate new capabilities into feature ideas, prototype them, and work with designers and engineers to ship them. - **Test hands-on:** run usability tests on new features and benchmark competing creative AI products, then form a clear judgment on what's great, what's broken and what to do next, and get the team aligned on it. - **Partner across teams:** work with Growth and Community on creator programs, challenges and showcases that highlight great work made on OpenArt. - **Stay close to users:** listening to users is part of doing this job well. Talk with them every day (interviews, Discord, social), understand what they need, and let that shape every feature you push for. # What We’re Looking For ## **Core Requirements** - Studying or trained in CS, engineering, HCI, design or a related technical field. We welcome undergraduate and graduate students at any stage, as well as candidates on a gap year or in other situations. - Proactively using AI creative tools (OpenArt, Midjourney, Runway, Krea, Higgsfield, ComfyUI or similar) with strong opinions on what makes them great or frustrating. - A builder with product taste: you have engineering skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, working with APIs), you've built or shipped something (an app, side project, tool or design), and you can explain the choices behind it. ## **Nice to Have** - Close involvement in developer and creative professional communities, which gives you early exposure to new trends and high-value information. - Good taste in what you read and strong learning habits, so you catch important trends early. # **Work Setup** - Bay Area required (hybrid allowed) - Visa sponsorship available ## Compensation & Benefits The expected base salary range for this role is $40 to $50 per hour, plus the same in-office benefits as our full-time employees.

role: Supply Chain Data & Analytics Intern (2027 Summer Internship)
description: **About Northwood:** Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it. **Role:** We are seeking a **Supply Chain Data & Analytics Intern** to join our team for the summer in 2027. You will be at the cutting edge of turning complex supply chain challenges into high-impact, data-driven solutions. You won’t just be analyzing spreadsheets—you’ll be designing predictive models, building automated data pipelines, and creating tools that shape how we forecast demand, optimize inventory, and manage supplier performance across a fast-growing, high-tech operation. You will collaborate directly with engineers, operations leaders, and data scientists to influence strategic decisions and make an immediate, visible impact on the company’s growth trajectory. experience with SQL, Python, R, or data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) is a plus. - Experience with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, or machine learning applied to operations or supply chain problems. - Interest in supply chain operations and how data can drive efficiency and resilience. - Strong communication skills-you can translate numbers into insights and tell a story. - Self-starter who is curious, detail-oriented, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment. **Preferred Qualifications:** - Prior experience in the aerospace, satellite, telecommunications, or defense industries - Experience with ERP Systems (NetSuite, Oracle/SAP) - Startup or fast-paced environment experience a plus **Additional Information:** *To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.* Northwood Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; description: The Orthopedic Research Scholar opportunity is a one-year position that gives an outstanding medical student the opportunity to be part of globally recognized research in the Pediatric Orthopedic Department at the Nemours Children’s Hospital. This fellowship provides the medical student with all the tools necessary to be successful in the development and execution of meaningful pediatric orthopedic research projects during the year, with a view to presentation at national meetings and eventual publication. Design and complete IRB’s, adhere to Department and Nemours research policies, collect and review clinical data, measure X-rays, complete manuscripts for publication and presentation at conferences. Perform literature searches and analysis of existing data to support protocols, and publications. Attend daily/weekly clinical conferences, visiting speakers, quarterly Journal Club and many other educational events. Participate in in a high-volume clinical practice that allows the student to shadow and gain clinical exposure to inspire research ideas. Observe surgical procedures. Collaborate with some of the most recognized and prolific thought leaders in the pediatric orthopedic profession, in an institution known for its scholarship in complex diagnoses such as: osteogenesis imperfecta, scoliosis, cerebral palsy and progressive neuromuscular conditions, skeletal dysplasia’s (dwarfism), hip dysplasia, limb deformities, sports medicine, and more. Graphic Design Summer Intern Come join the Tillamook Team, one of the fastest-growing dairy brands in the US, where we Play to Win to create over 200 dairy products in 6 different categories: cheese, ice cream, yogurt, sour cream, butter, and cream cheese. About the TCCA Summer Intern Program: Tillamook County Creamery Association (TCCA)’s Summer Internship Program is a 10 to 12-week program for graduate and undergraduate students to join the Tillamook team to connect to our 115-year-old heritage. Our interns play a significant role in solving real-world business challenges and enjoy bites of our ice cream, cheese and beloved dairy products every step of the way. In addition to the farm tour, we host multiple enriching experiences throughout the duration of the program, that include being an honorary Tillamook taste bud for the day with our immersive cheese and ice cream tastings, “college-inspired” cooking class with our executive chef, resume & interview workshop, sales market tours and so much more! The right tools — elevated and innovative design, consistent templates, one source of truth — free the team from rebuilding collateral and make Tillamook show up premium, consistent, and differentiated in every pitch. The application window will be open until the position is filled or until we reach our cap of 100 applicants. We will review applications and move selected candidates through our interview process with the goal of having all interns identified no later than the end of the year. What you will do: The Brand Design and Sales teams would like to partner to bring in an intern whose project would be to research best in class sales, sell-in, and pitch materials and presentations and then bring them to life here at Tillamook. This will touch a wide variety of disciplines, from 3D Event design to motion design and potentially even sound and scent design. What they propose and create will be limited only by their research and their imagination (and our budget). Here’s a day in the life: Sell-in sheets and other sales materials in a variety of media: Print; interactive; digital. Working with cross-functional team to translate data sets and insights into effective creative presentations that drive sales results. Researching and understanding emerging tech trends in the CPG space and how to apply them. Supporting food service projects: landing page development; art direction; photo shoots; other sales materials Other graphic design related projects as needed. Knowledge, skills, and abilities: Education level: Upper classman - undergrad, Graduate student Preferred fields of study: Graphic design, web design, multimedia studies Experienced in Graphic design layout, photo manipulation, output for print & digital. description: The Orthopedic Research Scholar opportunity is a one-year position that gives an outstanding medical student the opportunity to be part of globally recognized research in the Pediatric Orthopedic Department at the Nemours Children’s Hospital. This fellowship provides the medical student with all the tools necessary to be successful in the development and execution of meaningful pediatric orthopedic research projects during the year, with a view to presentation at national meetings and eventual publication. Through this program, the candidate will have access to substantial research resources including statistical support, research methods instruction (through our integrated research education seminar series), IRB-support, clinical databases, and more. In addition to research, the fellow will have the opportunity to participate in the day-to-day clinical activities of mentors they are assigned to, based on their interests. There is also an opportunity to observe surgical procedures in the operating room. Primary Responsibilities Collaborate with scientists, physicians, and staff to plan, organize and conduct research in assigned projects. Design and complete IRB’s, adhere to Department and Nemours research policies, collect and review clinical data, measure X-rays, complete manuscripts for publication and presentation at conferences. Perform literature searches and analysis of existing data to support protocols, and publications. Attend daily/weekly clinical conferences, visiting speakers, quarterly Journal Club and many other educational events. Participate in in a high-volume clinical practice that allows the student to shadow and gain clinical exposure to inspire research ideas. Observe surgical procedures. Collaborate with some of the most recognized and prolific thought leaders in the pediatric orthopedic profession, in an institution known for its scholarship in complex diagnoses such as: osteogenesis imperfecta, scoliosis, cerebral palsy and progressive neuromuscular conditions, skeletal dysplasia’s (dwarfism), hip dysplasia, limb deformities, sports medicine, and more. Qualification Requirements: Candidates must be recent graduates of a U.S.-based medical school or currently enrolled medical students at any level of training in a U.S.-based medical school. For Confidential Consideration: Please apply below. #LI-JV2 IPOS2026

# About Brelle ## Energy for what moves us. The next generation of vehicles and aircraft won't be built with yesterday's manufacturing playbook. Brelle is building a new approach to manufacturing for an increasingly electrified world, bringing together advanced engineering, software, testing, and automated production to develop and build high-performance energy and powertrain systems. We're a California based, venture backed team working with some of the most demanding names in high performance mobility, including supercars and superbikes. Our work spans novel battery pack architecture, full-stack software, and automated manufacturing, with the goal of making machines lighter, safer, and more capable. We're building something ambitious, and we're still early. That means real ownership, difficult technical problems, and the opportunity to see your work move from an idea to something real. We value people who think beyond their job description, challenge conventional approaches, and follow through on what they take on. **Build something exceptional. Own your work. See it move.** # About the Opportunity Brelle welcomes applications from students interested in internship and co-op opportunities across engineering and related technical disciplines. This posting provides a centralized opportunity for us to connect with promising early-career talent and consider candidates for placements aligned with our evolving project and team needs. As an intern or co-op student, you’ll have the opportunity to apply your technical knowledge to real engineering challenges, contribute to the development of next-generation energy and powertrain systems, and learn alongside a team working at the forefront of electrified performance. We’re looking for curious, driven individuals who enjoy solving difficult problems, take ownership of their work, and thrive in a fast-moving, hands-on engineering environment. ## *Areas of Opportunity* Depending on your background, technical interests, and the needs of the team, opportunities may span areas such as: - **Mechanical Engineering & CAD:** Create and update 3D models, assemblies, detailed 2D engineering drawings, and mechanical designs; support design iteration and development. - **Electrical Engineering:** Support electrical design, component integration, wiring and harnesses, and related electrical systems. - **Systems Engineering:** Contribute to system architecture, requirements development, component integration, and cross-functional engineering coordination. - **Prototyping, Testing & Validation:** Support prototype builds, test setup and execution, data collection, troubleshooting, and design validation. - **Manufacturing & Production Engineering:** Contribute to design for manufacturability, assembly processes, tooling, production methods, and process improvement. - **Software & Controls:** Support embedded systems, controls, data analysis, automation, and software development for energy and powertrain systems. Specific responsibilities will depend on the placement, your skills, and the projects you support. Not every area will have an active opening at all times. ## *What You'll Bring* - Current enrollment in a college or university program in engineering or a related technical discipline. - Strong technical fundamentals and a genuine interest in building, testing, and improving real-world systems. - A hands-on, analytical approach to solving challenging problems, with a willingness to question assumptions and explore better solutions. - Initiative, attention to detail, and a willingness to take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments. - The ability to collaborate across disciplines, communicate openly, and consider the broader team’s needs while making meaningful progress independently. - The ability to learn quickly, adapt to changing priorities, and contribute in a fast-moving environment. Relevant technical projects, personal builds, research, laboratory experience, CAD proficiency, programming experience, or previous internships are valuable. Experience with engineering design, prototyping, manufacturing processes, or design for manufacturability may be particularly relevant, depending on the placement. We’re interested in what you’ve built, how you approach problems, and how you apply your skills—not just what’s listed on your resume. ## Internship & Co-Op Details Placements may be structured as internships or co-op terms, depending on the candidate’s academic program and the needs of the business. Placement duration, start date, schedule, and specific responsibilities will be determined based on the opportunity. Candidates should indicate their field of study, technical interests, anticipated availability, and preferred placement duration when applying. ## Compensation & Benefits Internship and Co-Op placements are paid positions. Compensation will be determined based on the specific placement, relevant experience, and other applicable factors. Benefits include: - Team meals twice a week - Monthly team events - A well-stocked kitchen with snacks and drinks - One-time $500 stipend to help offset expenses during your placement ## How to Apply Submit your application using the **Apply** button below. We review applications based on candidates’ skills, technical interests, and alignment with current and anticipated team needs. If a suitable opportunity arises, our team may reach out to discuss next steps. **Brelle is an equal opportunity employer.**

# **About us** B2B payments are a multi-trillion-dollar industry and, as the industry pushes further into digitization and faster settlement, fraud has become a massive problem — to the tune of $43B in annual losses. [Walrus](http://walrusfi.com) is the leader in B2B payment verification, with clients that include some of the biggest names in investment management. Our DoubleCheck platform combines advanced authentication, proprietary technology, AI, and novel UX to collect and confirm payment details. DoubleCheck has defined a new category: verifying the safe transfer of financial information and assets. Walrus is led by PhD computer scientists and security researchers, with decades of experience in engineering, cybersecurity, and cryptography, and many research accomplishments at Harvard, Stanford, MIT, the University of Chicago, Columbia, UTexas, and NYU. We’re backed by one of the world's leading fintech VC funds, as well as founders and former executives of Twitter, Google Maps, Databricks, and Kayak. # **The role** You will be part of the core team at Walrus, working on our [flagship product](https://www.walrusfi.com/doublecheck). You will design, build, and own exciting new modules; examples include payments, reputation, and new kinds of authentication. We are an early-stage company, so you and the team will work together to create standards and culture that will endure for years to come. Of course you’ll get to design and innovate solutions to hard problems, and write a lot of code. But beyond that, as all entrepreneurial software teams do, you’ll be able to design ways of approaching software development. We are looking for people who are thoughtful, not only about software problems, but about how teams work together to solve them, and how people collaborate to build an energizing and supportive workplace. # **About you** You are someone who cares a lot about designing software in a thoughtful way that takes into account bug prevention, testability, and maintainability. You are comfortable with the idea that product design should be data-driven, using evidence rather than opinion. You are: - Experienced with tools for testing. You know that the best software developers demonstrate that their code works, rather than dumping it on a QA department. - Curious, and have an interest in teaching and learning from your colleagues. - A strong written communicator. - Graduating in December 2027, anytime 2028, or spring 2029 with an undergraduate degree in computer science, math, physics, or electrical engineering. # Optionally We strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the criteria listed; the description is meant to be indicative, not a precise description of a pigeonhole. - You have internship or co-op experience designing, building, and deploying sophisticated web applications. - You have experience with modern UI frameworks, web standards, and web development best practices. - You have a detailed understanding of the design of data models for use in relational databases. - You have used cloud infrastructure to deploy reliable and scalable web applications. - You have built authentication flows and/or implemented secure APIs. - You have built or used tools for data analysis, performance profiling, and debugging. # What it’s like to work with us We’re a tight-knit, early-stage team that’s focused on building a product that our customers love. We have a strong company culture based on collaboration, ownership, and mentoring. We meet sparingly and efficiently. We understand our innate biases and celebrate diversity. We have a low-ego workplace, where we provide the tools for everyone to do their best work. You will work closely with the leadership team, and have room for extensive growth within the company. - This internship will be based at our office in NYC (Financial District). Relocation assistance for the summer will be provided. - For full time permanent employees, Walrus offers competitive compensation and benefits, including salary, equity, paid medical insurance, dental, vision, company contribution to wellness, good coverage for dependents, parental leave, retirement, relocation assistance, and unlimited PTO. We believe talent comes from all backgrounds and walks of life, and are committed to providing a comfortable environment for everyone to work. *This is a temporary internship position with full time hours. The annual base pay for this internship is $77,000 - $113,000 (depending on location and experience). This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law.* *Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.*

## **About Sygaldry** Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference for AI. By integrating quantum and AI, we're accelerating the path to superintelligence, and addressing the problem of rising compute costs and energy bottlenecks. Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to deliver the combination of cost, scale, and speed necessary for advanced AI applications. We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. We're looking for individuals ready to define the intersection of quantum and AI and drive its profound global impact. ## **About the Role** We are seeking a hands-on research engineer to build, integrate, and operate the experimental systems behind our quantum program. You will work on real hardware: building advanced scientific machines and developing devices across the boundaries between electronics, optics, timing, firmware, and software. A Ph.D. is not required; we care about what you have built. ## **What You'll Work On** - Build, test, and commission electronic, optical, vacuum, and cryogenic subsystems. - Integrate lasers, rf and microwave hardware, control electronics, and data acquisition into systems. - Debug failures spanning electronics, optics, timing, firmware, and software. - Write automation, calibration, and analysis tooling that makes measurements repeatable. - Improve lab infrastructure and procedures so systems stay reliable and usable. - Produce documentation that allows other team members to operate, maintain, and reproduce your work ## **You May Be a Good Fit If You Have** - Hands-on experience building, aligning, integrating, or repairing real instruments and experimental setups. - Practical depth in one or more of: optics and photonics; electronics; RF, microwave, and controls; embedded or FPGA development; vacuum and cryogenics; scientific software and automation; device fabrication and characterization. - A track record of making something work reliably, and of finding the real cause of a stubborn failure. - Python or similar for instrument control, data acquisition, and analysis. Experience integrating tools across hardware control interfaces and software systems. - A B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in physics, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Especially practical experience in a hardware development or production industry. - Comfort working across disciplines, and clear reporting of what worked, what failed, and what you fixed. ## **How We’re Different** At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail. We’re looking for scientists, engineers, and operators to forge new paths with us at the intersection of quantum and AI. We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you think your skills, experience and aspirations make you a good match for this position, we encourage you to apply. description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Follow through completion of component qualifications by relevant stakeholders, ahead of production need dates - Reduce complexity of supply chain through commonality optimization & component/supplier rationalization - Lead all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle - Manage ad-hoc cost issues e.g., tariffs / import export cost, and cost inflation - Drive the design and implementation of new supply chain processes and systems, ensuring they meet business requirements and are built for scale - Manage project schedules, identify critical path activities, and proactively identify and mitigate risks to keep initiatives on track - Drive alignment across stakeholders and influence without formal authority in ambiguous, high-stakes situations **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, or a related technical field. - As a Junior Systems Integration Engineer, you will support the integration, configuration, test, and verification of hardware and software components within complex tactical communications and information systems. The role will provide development opportunities across the system engineering lifecycle, including lab-based integration, troubleshooting, formal test execution, reporting, and support to field activities. You will work as part of a multi-disciplined engineering team, contributing to the delivery of system integration and test activities that meet customer needs, quality standards, and programme timescales. Key Responsibilities A Junior Systems Integration Engineer would typically: Support product and system integration activities for tactical C4I / TacCIS solutions in laboratory and controlled environments. Assist with the setup, configuration, and commissioning of hardware, software, and network components used in integration and test activities. Contribute to the preparation of integration and test plans, procedures, scripts, and supporting documentation. Execute defined integration and test activities under guidance, capturing results accurately and maintaining associated evidence. Support verification, validation, and assurance activities by collecting test data and helping produce reports and technical summaries. Investigate technical issues and defects using a structured fault-finding approach, escalating where appropriate. Assist with build, test, and process automation activities, as well as continuous improvement of integration and test methods. Work with engineers and other stakeholders to support design maturity by feeding back observations from lab integration and test execution. Maintain clear, well-structured technical records using approved engineering tools and Microsoft Office applications. Demonstrate an ability to want to learn and develop and take on more responsibility as knowledge and experience grows. Understand the importance of deadlines and adapt to delivering tasks within programme timescales. Support field-based trials, experimentation, or acceptance activities when required. Typical Daily Activities Typical day-to-day activities may include: Building and configuring system rigs, virtual machines, servers, or network elements for integration tasks. Running test procedures and recording outcomes, anomalies, and observations. Performing first-line technical troubleshooting across software, hardware, and network interfaces. Supporting the production of defect reports, test reports, and acceptance evidence. Assisting with the use of engineering lifecycle tools such as DOORS, RQM, RTC, ALM, or equivalent platforms. Collaborating with more experienced engineers to understand system behaviour, interfaces, and integration risks. Degree, HNC/HND, apprenticeship, or equivalent experience in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Networking, or a related discipline. Hybrid working with two/three days a week in our Edinburgh office, depending on ‘in-office’ support required that week. ## About us Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well. And we’re now expanding into Europe. We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale. We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand. If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company. It’s a fast moving, collaborative environment with plenty of variety, from supporting joiners, movers and leavers, to managing the Mac device lifecycle and SaaS admin. You’ll quickly build hands on experience with the latest tech. ## What you’ll own - Act as the first point of contact for internal IT queries, owning triage and providing first contact resolution where possible - Meet first response SLAs and keep colleagues updated on ticket progress through clear, friendly communication - Support the joiner / mover / leaver process, from equipment provisioning and account setup to access changes and deactivation, maintaining an accurate IT asset register - Keep endpoints compliant with our security standards in a Mac first environment - Use our ticketing tools (e.g., Jira Service Management) and suggest pragmatic improvements to workflows and automation - Be a friendly face for TechOps, especially on busy office days - helping new starters settle in and resolving day-to-day issues quickly ## This role’s for you if... - You’re proficient with Mac and comfortable supporting colleagues in a Mac based environment (essential) - You have a strong interest in technology, a problem solving mindset and clear, empathetic communication (essential) - You’re organised, proactive, friendly and confident engaging with people across the business (essential) - You’re happy to work 2–3 days a week from our Edinburgh office to support colleagues in person (essential) - You’ve had exposure to Microsoft 365 - Azure AD, Entra, Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive (desirable) - You’ve used Jamf or other endpoint management (e.g., Intune) and understand the basics (desirable) - You’ve used Jira Service Management or similar ticketing systems and/or the Atlassian suite (desirable) ## This role isn’t for you if... - **You’re** **less comfortable in people-facing roles.** As the first port of call for IT issues, and one of the first faces employees meet as they join Seccl, strong people skills are essential! If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen - **You don’t like change.** You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty ## What’s in it for you We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people: - 💰 **£27,000 - £30,000**, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance - 🌴 **27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays**, your birthday off and paid dependant leave - 💙 **Two volunteering days each year** - 🌎 **The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year** - 🌟 **Secclbrate**, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget - 🏅 **One-month paid sabbatical after eight years** - 🏥 **Private medical insurance with AXA Health** - 👪 **Enhanced parental leave** - 💻 **MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up** - 📖 **£750 annual learning budget** - 🌻 **Health and wellbeing support**, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace - 🌱 **Financial wellbeing benefits**, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy - 🎁 **Perkbox**, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks - 🚲 **Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing** ## Our culture We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work. We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact. Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team. ## Interview process Interviewing is a two-way process. We’ll keep you updated throughout. ## Everyone’s welcome We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. **We’d love to hear from you.**

We specialize in integrating enterprise networking capabilities from global IT leaders with purpose-built hardware and software platforms designed to meet the most stringent environmental requirements. The Software Quality Engineering team champions quality across the entire product life cycle by embedding engineering-driven testing into the development process. As an SDET intern, you won't just execute test cases — you'll write code to test code, building the automation, tooling, and frameworks that guarantee our products work as intended. At Anduril, Software Quality Engineering is a development function: we actively build new products and projects while supporting production. You'll apply real software engineering skills — programming (Python), version control, and CI/CD — to bring the quality discipline directly into production, engineering, and supplier management workflows. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** As an SDET engineer, you'll be part of one of our Agile Software Development teams responsible for a variety of projects. Data logging for self-driving cars - Link aggregation technology for better connectivity on trains - Government services such as emergency response, disaster recovery and security - Hardware platforms used by AI/ML for object recognition – Deep learning inference engine using object detection networks like Faster R-CNN on Intel CPUs or the integrated Intel GPU **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** - role: Stage - Consultant Digital Product Passport - Colomiers
description: Dans le cadre du programme d’innovation au sein de notre agence, vous contribuerez à construire une démarche permettant d’évaluer le potentiel de création de valeur du Digital Product Passport pour les entreprises industrielles. L'objectif sera de partir des données nécessaires au DPP pour identifier les usages et services additionnels qu'elles pourraient permettre, et ainsi aider un industriel à construire le business case associé au financement d'une démarche DPP. Le stage sera initialement orienté vers le secteur aéronautique, avec une ouverture vers d’autres secteurs de l’industrie manufacturière. Vos missions : Veille et benchmark Analyser le cadre réglementaire européen et les exigences associées au DPP, Identifier les données qui devront être disponibles et partagées selon les typologies de produits étudiées. Benchmarker les initiatives et expérimentations DPP menées par différents industriels et identifier les cas d’usage et sources de valeur recherchées. Données et création de valeur Cartographier les données nécessaires à la construction d’un DPP et leurs sources dans l’écosystème industriel. Explorer les usages additionnels pouvant être développés à partir de ces données : traçabilité, maintenance, réparation, réemploi, recyclage, information client ou nouveaux services. Mener une première analyse sur la gouvernance et l'accès aux données : articulation entre le partage d'informations via le DPP, la conformité RGPD et la protection des données confidentielles ou du secret des affaires. Construire une première approche permettant de mettre en regard effort / investissement DPP et valeur potentiellement générée. Prototypage Sélectionner un ou plusieurs cas d’usage représentatifs du secteur aéronautique. Concevoir une maquette / démonstrateur orienté client, illustrant comment les données du DPP peuvent être exploitées au-delà de la conformité réglementaire. Collaboration et valorisation Travailler en lien avec les équipes Conseil, Innovation et les expertises internes autour de la circularité. Capitaliser la démarche, le benchmark et le démonstrateur afin qu’ils puissent être réutilisés dans de futurs contextes clients. En dernière année d’école d’ingénieur, de Master ou formation équivalente, avec une spécialisation en génie industriel, systèmes industriels, PLM, transformation digitale, data ou développement durable, vous recherchez un stage de fin d’études. Vous avez, ou souhaitez développer, des compétences autour de : l’analyse de processus et de systèmes industriels ; la gestion et la valorisation de données produit ; le PLM et le cycle de vie produit ; l’économie circulaire et les enjeux environnementaux ; l’analyse de business cases et l’identification de nouveaux services ; la veille, le benchmark et la réalisation de prototypes. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre curiosité, votre capacité d’analyse et de synthèse, votre autonomie et votre goût pour l’innovation. Vous aimez comprendre des sujets complexes, confronter des problématiques réglementaires, métier et technologiques et surtout les traduire en solutions concrètes pour les industriels. Venir au sein de CIMPA, c’est : S’impliquer dans de nombreux projets dont vous êtes moteur afin de renforcer la notoriété de notre entreprise et l’engagement de nos équipes, Avoir le goût du challenge pour réussir vos missions à temps, Développer votre autonomie et votre sens de l’initiative, Développer une compétence métier, Profiter d’un encadrement bienveillant. The world is how we shape it. Ce que nous vous proposons : CIMPA, c’est aussi un accompagnement de proximité, l’accès à un catalogue de formations e-learning, des avantages CSE, une mutuelle famille, une participation aux frais de repas et bien d’autres avantages liés à la convention collective de la métallurgie. En effet, nous prenons différents engagements dans cet objectif : accompagnement personnalisé dans la perspective de construire et concrétiser le projet professionnel, formation / certification, mobilité professionnelle, évaluation individuelle de la performance, etc. #LI-HYBRID #CIMPA #PLM #paris #industrie4.0 #usinedufutur #recrutement #soprasteria Employeur inclusif et engagé, notre société œuvre chaque jour pour lutter contre toute forme de discrimination et favoriser un environnement de travail respectueux. C’est pourquoi, attachés à la mixité et à la diversité, nous encourageons toutes les candidatures et tous les profils. Employeur inclusif et engagé, notre société œuvre chaque jour pour lutter contre toute forme de discrimination et favoriser un environnement de travail respectueux. C’est pourquoi, attachés à la mixité et à la diversité, nous encourageons toutes les candidatures et tous les profils. S’appuyant sur son savoir-faire des produits complexes de haute technologie, la vocation de CIMPA est de fournir à ses clients un avantage concurrentiel en améliorant l'efficacité opérationnelle tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. Complexité technologique, long cycle de de vie, exigences de sûreté et sécurité, chaine logistique multi-dimensionnelle… : nous nous engageons pour transformer, optimiser et renforcer l’approche de conception et production industrielles et les systèmes d’information associés. Nos services complets et modulaires autour du Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) couvrent chaque étape du cycle de vie du produit : la conception du produit, sa fabrication, l'entrée en service jusqu’à la maintenance et le support. La connaissance du métier industriel de nos clients conjuguée à notre savoir-faire dans les technologies de l’information fait notre force. Nous intervenons auprès des différentes Directions et Fonctions qui suivent l’évolution du produit. CIMPA s'adresse à l'industrie manufacturière, ainsi qu'aux fournisseurs des grands donneurs d’ordre, opérateurs, partenaires et clients, dans le secteur de l’aéronautique, de la défense, de l’énergie et du transport.

# AI Finance Researcher (MBA Student) ### About the Role AI systems are becoming increasingly capable of building financial models, analyzing business performance, and generating investment research. Yet complex financial decisions still demand the experience, critical thinking, and professional judgment of seasoned finance experts. At **Julius Research**, we're recruiting exceptional MBA students with professional experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Investment Banking (IB), Private Equity (PE), Venture Capital (VC), Hedge Funds, Corporate Finance, Asset Management, or Equity Research. Your primary responsibility will be to **create sophisticated financial challenges that test the limits of frontier AI models.** Your work will expose weaknesses in today's leading AI systems and contribute to improving their financial reasoning capabilities. # What You'll Do - **Design expert-level financial research and analysis tasks** inspired by real-world finance and investment workflows. - Create complex financial modeling challenges involving DCF valuations, LBOs, three-statement models, forecasting, budgeting, and scenario analysis. - Develop realistic FP&A problems involving revenue forecasting, budget variance analysis, cash flow planning, unit economics, and business performance evaluation. - Construct investment research scenarios involving M&A, company valuation, market analysis, investment due diligence, and capital allocation decisions. - Design multi-stage analytical problems that require interpreting incomplete data, reconciling conflicting information, and making defensible financial judgments. - **Identify weaknesses in advanced AI models** by evaluating their calculations, assumptions, analytical approaches, and financial conclusions. - Develop expert solutions, scoring criteria, and research benchmarks to measure AI performance. # Required Qualifications - Currently enrolled in a **Top 25 MBA program** (or recent graduate), preferably with a concentration in Finance, Investments, or Corporate Strategy. - **2+ years of professional experience** in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Hedge Funds, Asset Management, Equity Research, or related finance roles. - Previous experience as an Investment Banking Analyst/Associate, Private Equity Associate, Venture Capital Associate, Investment Analyst, Equity Research Analyst, FP&A Analyst/Manager or Corporate Finance Analyst. - Strong understanding of financial statement analysis, financial modeling, forecasting, company valuation, or investment research. - Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: - **Investment Banking & Private Equity:** DCF valuation, LBO modeling, comparable company analysis, M&A, and transaction due diligence. - **Venture Capital & Growth Equity:** Startup valuation, financial projections, market sizing, unit economics, and investment underwriting. - **Hedge Funds & Equity Research:** Fundamental research, earnings analysis, financial forecasting, and investment thesis development. - **Corporate Finance & FP&A:** Budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial planning, management reporting, and three-statement modeling. - Excellent quantitative reasoning, problem-solving, written communication, and attention to detail. # Preferred Qualifications - Experience at a leading investment bank, private equity firm, venture capital fund, hedge fund, Fortune 500 finance team, or high-growth technology company. - Proficiency in Excel financial modeling and tools such as Capital IQ, Bloomberg, FactSet, PitchBook, or financial planning software. - Interest in artificial intelligence, large language models (LLMs), and AI applications in financial services.

AI is becoming increasingly capable of performing financial analysis, building valuation models, and interpreting investment data. But the most demanding work in finance requires far more than applying formulas or following established frameworks. At Julius Research, we're recruiting exceptional MBA students with experience in Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Hedge Funds, and Equity Research to help advance the financial capabilities of frontier AI systems. Your primary responsibility will be to **create sophisticated financial challenges that test the limits of AI intelligence**. You'll draw on your professional experience to develop realistic investment scenarios requiring deep financial expertise, analytical thinking, and nuanced decision-making. By evaluating how leading AI systems approach these challenges, you'll uncover gaps in their capabilities and help establish new standards for AI performance in finance. # What You'll Do - **Create expert-level financial challenges** inspired by real investment banking, private equity, venture capital, and hedge fund workflows. - Develop sophisticated financial modeling exercises involving DCF valuations, LBOs, M&A transactions, and capital structure analysis. - Construct realistic investment scenarios incorporating incomplete information, conflicting financial indicators, and complex business considerations. - Design research assignments requiring the interpretation of SEC filings, earnings reports, financial statements, and market data. - **Identify limitations in advanced AI models** by assessing their analytical methods, financial assumptions, and investment conclusions. - Develop detailed solutions, evaluation frameworks, and benchmarks to measure AI performance against professional finance standards. # Required Qualifications - Currently enrolled or previously completed a **Top 25 MBA program**, preferably with a finance or investment focus. - **2+ years of professional experience** in Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Hedge Funds, Asset Management, or Equity Research. - Previous experience as an Investment Banking Analyst/Associate, Private Equity Associate, Venture Capital Associate, Hedge Fund Analyst, Investment Analyst, or Equity Research Analyst. - Strong technical expertise in financial modeling, company valuation, financial statement analysis, and investment due diligence. - Hands-on experience with DCF, LBO, comparable company analysis, precedent transactions, or investment underwriting. - Experience preparing investment memoranda, pitch books, equity research reports, or investment committee presentations. - Excellent quantitative reasoning, analytical judgment, and written communication skills.

At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality. ## About the Role As a Software Engineer Intern working on Rhoda Platform, you'll work on the software foundation that keeps our robots running. You'll own real projects on the software platform stack: ranging from on-robot software, networking and communication infrastructure, data collection pipelines, telemetry, teleoperation, inference infra, developer tooling etc., and see your impact run on physical robots by the end of your internship. You'll sit with the engineers who build our robots and ship code that the team depends on every day. ## What You'll Do - Contribute to the networking and communication infrastructure connecting onboard robot systems to each other, to the cloud, and to teleoperation and monitoring systems - Help build data collection pipelines that capture sensor, telemetry, and behavioral data from the robot and upload it reliably to cloud storage for model training - Work on telemetry and observability systems that give the team real-time visibility into robot health and field performance - Build internal tooling that accelerates robot software development: deployment pipelines, logging, debugging tools, and field testing utilities - Support bring-up and field testing on live hardware, debugging issues across the onboard software stack - Collaborate with ML, perception, and control engineers to keep onboard systems reliable and training data high quality - Automate internal workflows to improve execution efficiency of the Rhoda teams ## What We're Looking For - Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field — or a recent graduate - Solid computer science foundation: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and networking - Genuine passion for working on robots — coursework, research, personal projects, competition teams, or internships all count - Strong programming skills in C++, Python, Golang, or Rust - Curiosity and comfort working with physical hardware in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment - Ability to debug across layers, from driver-level issues up to application behavior - Open to learn new things and grow from knowing nothing to an expert on arbitrary technical topics ## Nice to Have (But Not Required) - Experience with bringing up & manipulating robots - Familiarity with networking, IPC, or communication protocols (e.g. gRPC, DDS, QUIC, WebSockets) - Exposure to cloud storage and data pipelines (AWS, GCP, S3, GCS) - Experience with perception pipelines, control systems, or learned models running on real-time robot stacks - Prior work on prototype or pre-production hardware ## Why This Role - Your work is the connective tissue of the robot — the networking, data, and tooling infrastructure that determines how fast the team can develop and improve our humanoids in the field - Work across the full onboard stack alongside perception, control, and ML engineers & researchers on a platform pushing the frontier of humanoid robotics - Real ownership on a small team, with your code running on real robots — not a side project on the shelf

At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality. ## **The Role** Our foundation world models have to run fast enough to control robots in the real world, and efficiently enough to support large-scale research. As an Inference Infrastructure Engineer Intern, you'll work with our infra and research engineers to make model inference faster and more efficient across the stack, from data pipelines down to GPU kernels. You'll own a scoped, high-impact project end to end, ship it into our production or research workflow, and present your results to the team. ## **What You'll Do** - Profile and benchmark inference for large video and world models to find bottlenecks in latency, throughput, and memory. - Apply and evaluate inference optimization techniques like quantization and low-precision inference, step distillation and sampling acceleration for diffusion-style models, attention and caching optimizations across frames, model compilation, and graph-level optimizations. - Make data movement and processing more efficient: video decoding and preprocessing, input pipelines, host–device transfer, caching, and storage/IO paths that feed inference and training. - Write and tune GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton, or similar) for performance-critical operators, and integrate them into our inference stack. - Build tooling and benchmarks that let the team track performance regressions and improvements reliably. - Work with researchers to turn promising ideas into production-quality infrastructure. ## **What We're Looking For** You don't need all of these. Strong depth in **any one** of the areas below is enough to apply: - **ML inference optimization:** hands-on experience making deep learning models run faster or cheaper, e.g. quantization (INT8/FP8), pruning/distillation, operator fusion, mixed precision, or compilers and runtimes such as `torch.compile`, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, or TVM. - **Data efficiency optimization:** experience speeding up data loading and preprocessing pipelines (especially video or other high-bandwidth sensor data), cutting IO and memory overhead, or improving data/compute utilization in ML systems. - **GPU kernel optimization:** experience writing or tuning GPU kernels in CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, or similar; familiarity with the GPU memory hierarchy, occupancy, and profiling tools (Nsight Systems/Compute, PyTorch profiler). ### **Basic Qualifications** - Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field. - Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++. - Solid understanding of deep learning fundamentals and at least one framework (PyTorch preferred). - Comfortable reading performance data and reasoning about trade-offs between latency, throughput, memory, and accuracy. ### **Nice to Have** - **Experience with video model inference is a huge plus**, e.g. optimizing video generation, video diffusion, or world models, or real-time video understanding pipelines. - Research experience in systems or ML, e.g. publications or substantial research projects (MLSys, OSDI/SOSP, CVPR/ICCV, NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR, or similar). - Experience with real-time or latency-critical inference, e.g. on robots or edge/embedded accelerators. - Experience with multi-GPU inference (tensor/sequence/pipeline parallelism). - Contributions to open-source ML systems projects. ## **What You'll Get** - A real project with measurable impact on robots operating in the real world. - Mentorship from experienced infra and research engineers. - Access to modern GPU compute for experiments.

About LCCC: Established in 1963, Lorain County Community College is the first community college in Ohio with a permanent campus. For six decades, LCCC has served the diverse needs of greater Lorain County region by providing affordable access to higher education and now serves approximately 13,000 students each year in certificate, associate, bachelor’s and master’s degree programs. Since 1963, one in four Lorain County residents have taken classes at LCCC and more than 43,000 have earned a degree. LCCC was recently ranked in the top 10% of most affordable colleges in the nation and more than 90% of LCCC graduates live and work in Northeast Ohio. 45% of Lorain County’s high school graduates earn college credits through LCCC’s high school dual enrollment programs. LCCC also partners with more than 700 employers and offers 170 industry-recognized credentials to better prepare the workforce for the future. LCCC is a dynamic, student-centered college intentionally designed to support individuals with balancing multiple roles on their path to college completion. 85% of LCCC students work while attending college, with majority working at least half-time. The average age of LCCC’s students is 24, and many bring life experiences that include caring for dependents, serving in the military, or completing some prior college. Over 80% of LCCC students received financial assistance through grants and scholarships, and LCCC has been nationally recognized for holistic, fully integrated services and commitment to student success. Lorain County Community College seeks to hire and employ locally whenever possible. Employees should reside in Ohio, where they can be responsive to on-campus work requirements, and within a reasonable commuting distance of their work location.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS Data Centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost. The Data Center Engineering Operations Trainee will be responsible for Data Center Engineering Operations within an Amazon Data Center including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting. We are looking for an individual with little to no experience, a result-driven individual with technical (electrical/ mechanical) understanding and the drive and passion to learn data center engineering operations. The role will report to the DCEO Manager and be responsible for sustaining availability, cost management, risk assessment and mitigation, review corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure and metric reporting. You’ll interface with a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. This position is for a 6 month fixed term hire with a possibility to convert to a full time role. Key job responsibilities - Learning the Data Center industry through in-classroom and on-site experience. - Assist the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed, is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation. - Maintaining performance benchmarks, conduct analyses & prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility infrastructure operations & maintenance. - Generate Change Management requests & Incident Management tickets for DCEO as directed. - Learn and contribute to documentation relevant to business & facility operations. - Assist with the installation of the racks and the provision of power/cooling within its constraints. - Be involved with the routine maintenance and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc. - Assist and learn about the design, implementation, commissioning and build out of new facilities. - Assist with the management of the Facility assets and the provision of infrastructure & inventory asset management as directed. - May participate in Construction & Operational Meetings as required. - Assist with Work Order compliance and review of contractual SLAs. - Interface with Infra Ops teams for day to day operational requirements. - Assist in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering or services issue. - Delivery of exceptional customer service and satisfaction. - Meet daily hours of operations, shift and on-call requirements for response during shift rotations. This role may involve bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching, ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely. Due to the location of our sites, candidates should possess a valid driver's license and their own vehicle. A day in the life At today’s large-scale data centers, you will be involved in: - Provide support and assistance to the onsite operations team, in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service-Level Agreements (SLA). - Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management. - Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained. - On-site management of contractors, subcontractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation. - Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center. About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Basic Qualifications - Interest in maintenance of a Data Center or Critical space facility. - Strong verbal and written communication skills. Strong attention to detail. - Strong leadership and organizational skills. - Facilities Management mindset. - Ability to prioritize in complex, fast-paced environment. - Physical Security protocol awareness . - Computer literate, confident with Office Suite - This position also has a physical component requiring the ability to lift rack equipment; it may require working in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines. Preferred Qualifications - Degree or Technical (Military/ Trade School) - Degree / Cert IV and relevant experience - Data Center Engineering/Operations Experience - Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or relevant discipline.

role: Associate Delivery Consultant Intern, National Security, AWS Professional Services

Job Summary Do you want to experiment with innovative technologies, including Cloud Computing, Machine Learning, and GenAI? Are you passionate about educating, training, designing, and building cloud computing solutions to help customer solve their most challenging problems? Amazon Web Services (AWS), a leader in Cloud Computing, is seeking interns to join our AWS Professional Services Internship program. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in a fast-growing business and to deliver value to AWS customers of all sizes from startups to global brands. The skills and experiences you gain will be highly sought after throughout the industry and give you the opportunity for the career of a lifetime. AIML - AIML role supports our services that leverage data and produce business insights, which may include using Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence/Generative Artificial Intelligence (ML/AI/GenAI). Helping our customers use and integrate Big Data services in what is arguably our industry’s most exciting space. The portfolio of services covers EMR (Hadoop), DynamoDB (NoSQL), MongoDB, Apache Cassandra, Amazon Q, and Bedrock. Modernization - Modernization resources are specialists in designing applications that run natively in the cloud using programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, Typescript, etc. They are experts in building programs that run on any number of platforms including virtualized instances, containers, or server less architecture. They are full stack developers with backend, frontend, and UX skillsets. About the team Upon successful completion of the internship program, selected interns will receive a full-time offer to join ProServe Associate to Consultant (A2C) Delivery. A2C Delivery develops the next generation of ProServe consultants who use generative and agentic AI to solve customer challenges and drive innovation within ProServe. A2C Delivery focuses on accelerating career development for recent graduates and early career professionals entering technical roles, advancing their skills and helping customers design and build flexible and resilient cloud-based solutions. While in A2C, you will learn key technical and professional skills from top AWS subject matter experts that you can use in your career working with AWS’s customers. Mentorship & Career Growth Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skillset. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Work/Life Harmony Our team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

### About Humble Robotics Working at Humble Robotics means taking on the biggest change in ground transportation in decades. We’re a fast-moving, close-knit team of AV industry veterans and innovative thinkers. You will build test boards, help integrate hardware on the bench and on the vehicle, and support our staff engineers on existing designs. You will work hands-on with real hardware from your first week. *The person who fills this role would primarily work from Humble Robotics’ San Francisco office 5 days a week. We aim to create an in office environment that fosters a collaborative, generative atmosphere where the team can build together.* ### What You'll Do - Design test boards in Altium: breakout boards, adapters, and simple fixtures for bench and vehicle tests. - Assemble, solder, and rework boards; do first power-on and basic checks. - Help integrate hardware on test benches and vehicles with the hardware integration team: wiring, power-up, and troubleshooting. - Support staff engineers on existing designs: schematic updates, part selection and alternates, BOM updates, and design review preparation. - Run bench tests with an oscilloscope, DMM, logic analyzer, and power supplies; record test results and known issues. - Write automation scripts in Python or other languages to automate tests and analyze test data. - Document your boards, test setups, and results so the team can use them after your internship. ### What You Bring - Currently enrolled in a degree program in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field. - Hands-on experience with Altium Designer: schematic capture and PCB layout of at least one board. - Coursework in Circuit Theory and Embedded Electronics; Humble Robotics is built by people who grew into the hardest problems in this field, not just people who'd already solved them.* ### Compensation This role is eligible for base salary + benefits + equity compensation. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, and location. ### Perks and Benefits - Competitive compensation - Fully stocked kitchen with drinks, snacks and weekly catered meals - Collaborative in office environment located in San Francisco

role: KIP Spring 2027 - Policy Data Analyst Intern - Empire Center for Public Policy
description: **[The Koch Internship Program](https://standtogetherfellowships.org/koch-internship-program/) (KIP)** is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. [The Empire Center](https://www.empirecenter.org/) is looking for a talented individual for our policy data analyst role. Working as a policy data analyst at the Empire Center provides a unique work experience at a leading state-based think tank. The Empire Center is dedicated to making New York a better place to live and work by promoting public policy reforms grounded in free-market principles, personal responsibility, and the ideals of effective and accountable government. Through research papers, policy briefings, commentaries and conferences, the think tank seeks to educate and inform New York State policymakers, news media and the general public. **Overview** As the Microsoft **Data Center Campus Director**, you will drive the delivery of world-class support services across your campus or metro. You will interact and maintain relationships with various authorities and partners across all sectors of the data center industry. You will use keen business acumen and financial management skills to manage operating costs effectively, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, security, and ecological responsibility. Excellent interpersonal awareness, ability to navigate ambiguity, and your mature communication skills will be pivotal in bringing your program management, technical abilities, and leadership experiences to a whole new level in supporting Microsoft’s success! Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Data Center Campus Director, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. This will include leading incident management calls with customers and senior leadership, the timely resolution of incidents, post-incident reviews, and the implementation of improvement plans - Ensure financial management of your metro including the development of detailed budgets, forecasts, and management of operational and capital spend - Management and oversight of all vendor/partner contracts and relationships including leased-facility landlords, IT and CE service providers, and partner support teams - Collaborate with global and regional management teams and contribute to improvement programs - Learn, live, and coach the One Microsoft culture and values. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. As the engineering landscape evolves, we are developing the next generation of technical talent with strong computer science fundamentals, and the engineering judgment to build impactful products and platforms.
