Demonstrated analytical skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset to identify potential issues and drive solutions through verification - Intellectual curiosity and first-principles thinking, with the ability to develop robust, practical solutions to complex mechanical design challenges - Willingness to engage directly in hands-on development, assembly, and testing activities - Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical stakeholders - Passion for mechanical product design, system functionality, and performance - Exposure to rapid prototyping methods such as 3D printing and laser cutting - Familiarity with basic electronics and components commonly used in electromechanical systems, including motors, sensors, heaters, and PCBAs - Ability to independently identify, implement, and validate technical solutions while collaborating effectively within a team environment - Experience with experimental testing in a laboratory, workshop, or academic setting - Embodies SharkNinja's success drivers: - Rarely Satisfied – Adopt a “no delays” mentality in delivering against market needs/timing - Progress over Perfection - Make quick, daily progress and continuously adapts to achieve results rather than requiring perfect planning - Details Make the Difference - Can coordinate timelines & deliverables to ensure accuracy and consistency across all consumer-facing materials

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. The Test and Evaluation team at Anduril works across the entire spectrum of products and business lines, as well as all flight operations and test range management. Our team conducts full system level development testing, new production acceptance testing, sub-component qualification testing and much more. This varies from Road Runner flight testing, Anvil checkouts, tower calibration, surrogate integrations and much more. In short, if it involves test, we support it. If you are interested in working in an extremely innovative and fast-paced environment, where your work directly makes an impact and difference in the products that are fielded this is a fantastic opportunity. Come join the team and get hands on relevant real-world experience come join the T&E team. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** - Participate in developmental testing in a fast-paced test environment. - Contribute to planning and execution of T&E of hardware and software with emphasis placed on planning, conducting subsystem, simulation, ground, and flight test, initial issue investigation, and process improvement/development. - Track the status of test issues and observations and work cross-functionally to establish priorities for issue resolution. - Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze test results, identify performance trends, and recommend enhancements or corrective actions. - Work with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, hardware engineers, and product managers. - Conduct subsystem, ground, and flight testing at private and government-owned test ranges. - Work in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices. - Ensure the safe operation and rigorous evaluation of all test efforts. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. - Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester. - Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program. - Ability to complete a 12-week in-person internship in one of our offices in summer 2027. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Prior experience with software code/script building using programming languages such as Go, Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, etc. - Prior experience with Linux based systems and command line. - Ability to troubleshoot/repair electronics - Working Knowledge with COTs Small UAS autopilot and mission planning software. - Prior experience with Pixhawk flight controllers running Ardupilot and PX4 for air vehicles, including setup, operation, and tuning. - Experience working with manned aircraft personnel and familiar with aviation terminology. - Familiarity with rapid prototyping, 3D printing, laser cutting, and working with composite materials. - Experience with CAD modeling and PCB design. - FAA Part 107 certification. - Direct experience in the development, testing, and deployment of mission autonomy systems in a defense or aerospace context. - Hands-on experience with simulation environments and tools used for testing autonomous systems. - Ability to understand new concepts quickly; apply them accurately; organize, schedule, and coordinate work phases; and determine the appropriate approach at the task level or, with assistance, at the project level to provide solutions to a range of complex problems. - Working understanding of engineering concepts, principles, codes, and theory; experience demonstrating a broad application of those concepts; and, expanding knowledge of principles, concepts, theory, and practices in related technical specialties. - Experience and working knowledge of the National Airspace System and UAS operating rules and regulations thereof. - Demonstrated experience developing and executing test plans - Strong analytical skills and the ability to work effectively in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment. - Strong computer and documentation experience. - Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team; able to perform complex tasks in one or more engineering areas. - Ability to travel as required for test planning and execution - Able to work extended hours as required - Bias for action – if you see a problem, you want to solve and fix it US Hourly Range $32—$40 USD The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. role: Software Engineer Internship for HPI Students
description: **About the role** Banks and fintechs use Taktile to automate critical decisions, like credit, fraud, and compliance, in real time. We're building the infrastructure that makes financial institutions truly AI-native, and we've partnered with the **Hasso Plattner Institute (HPI),** a leading computer science institute in Europe, to offer a dedicated opportunity designed only for HPI students. Starting in April 2027, you'll join one of our engineering teams for 6 months in Berlin and ship real features, with experienced engineers mentoring you along the way. Several HPI alumni already work here, from early-career engineers to senior engineers leading major parts of our product. This program is tailored for Computer Science students eager to gain hands-on industry experience while building the foundations for a world-class engineering career. If you have strong engineering fundamentals and want to grow fast in a team where what you build reaches customers soon after you ship it, we'd love to hear from you. ## **What You'll Do** - Depending on your final team, either work on backend components written in Python / FastAPI, hosted on an AWS serverless architecture, or work on React/Typescript front-end components, or a combination of both! - Engage actively in team rituals such as daily syncs, planning sessions, demos, and technical deep-dive discussions. - Grow as an individual and accelerate your career by learning from our experienced team, contributing to a foundational layer of the product, and joining cross-team learning groups. ## **Requirements:** - Taktile is a hybrid company that requires working 3 days/week from our Berlin HQ in Germany. - Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential as we operate in a remote environment requiring clear and effective communication. - Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision. - Availability for a 6-month full-time internship. ## **Required Experience** - Fantastic Computer Science fundamentals. Data structures, algorithms, networking, distributed systems, databases, and everything in between! ## **Ideal, But Not Required** - Exposure to AWS, especially Lambda. - Experience with frontend development - React or similar frameworks. ## **Our Offer** - Work with colleagues who lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you, and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here. - Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo. - Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe. - Receive a MacBook Pro as well as cutting-edge hardware. ## **Our Stance** - We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply. - We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism, and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears. ## **About Taktile** Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at [](http://taktile.com). **Through this exclusive partnership with Taktile, HPI students have the unique opportunity to gain industry experience in a high-growth startup environment while continuing their education among some of Europe’s brightest technical minds.** ## ***About Your Employment.*** *Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. role: Werkstudent / Praktikant HR Operations & Process Automation (m/f/x)
description: Deine Startbasis: Du unterstützt uns initial im Tagesgeschäft – von der Vor- und Nachbereitung der nationalen und internationalen Payroll über die Erstellung von Arbeitgeberdokumenten bis hin zur Datenpflege im System und der Steuerung des Abwesenheits-Workflows. Die Mission: Du analysierst genau diese manuellen Abläufe mit der Payroll-Brille. Dein Ziel: Die Digitalisierung und Automatisierung dieser Prozesse. Mithilfe von Tools wie Google Apps Script, Gemini/ChatGPT und Codex schaffst du manuelle Routineaufgaben ab und baust effiziente, digitale Workflows. Du hast ein Auge auf unsere Rechnungsfreigaben in unserem Finance-Tool und hilfst uns dabei, Belege mit Relevanz für die Pauschalversteuerung zu identifizieren und freizugeben. Du bist ein kompetenter und serviceorientierter Ansprechpartner für unsere Mitarbeitenden. Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Personalmanagement, Psychologie oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. Du hast ein Grundverständnis für bzw. starkes Interesse an Payroll-Prozessen. Du bist technikaffin und bringst idealerweise erste Erfahrungen (oder viel Motivation zur Einarbeitung) im Umgang mit Google Apps Script, Codex und Generativer KI (wie Gemini oder ChatGPT) mit. Du bist hochmotiviert, denkst prozessorientiert, arbeitest selbstständig und zuverlässig. Da wir ein internationales Team sind, bringst du fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit. Für Werkstudent:innen: Verfügbarkeit von 16-20h/Woche Für Praktikant:innen: Mindestdauer 6 Monate Werde Teil eines der am schnellsten wachsenden und sichtbarsten Fintech-Startups in Europa und schaffe einen innovativen Service, der einen wesentlichen Einfluss auf das Leben unserer Kunden hat Zusammenarbeit mit einem internationalen, vielfältigen, integrativen und wachsenden Team, das es liebt, die besten Produkte für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln Bei uns sind alle Praktika gleich viel wert: Wir vergüten auch Pflichtpraktika Arbeite flexibel von zuhause oder in unserem zentralen Office mitten in München oder Berlin Interne Knowledge Sharing Sessions über die Grenzen Deines Teams hinaus Produktives Arbeiten mit modernster Hardware und Tools Kostenloses Abo für den Prime+ Broker Scalable Capital ist eine führende digitale Investmentplattform und ermöglicht Menschen in Europa ihre Finanzen selbst zu gestalten. Mit dem Scalable Broker können Kundinnen und Kunden günstig und einfach professionell in Aktien, ETFs und weitere Börsenprodukte investieren sowie Sparpläne anlegen. Die digitale Vermögensverwaltung Scalable Wealth bietet eine professionelle Geldanlage in ETF-Portfolios, die auch von renommierten B2B-Partnern als White-Label-Lösung eingesetzt wird. Gemeinsam mit dem Gründer- und Führungsteam um Erik Podzuweit und Florian Prucker arbeiten sie an einer neuen Generation von Finanzservices.

BNB Chain is making mass blockchain adoption a reality as a community-first and open-source ecosystem built on the principles of permissionlessness and decentralization. By contributing to the development of the infrastructure and supporting the community, BNB Chain is on the mission to help onboard a billion new users to Web3. If you want to contribute to building the Web3 ecosystem while working in a collaborative and dedicated team that is enabling some of the most exciting innovations of our era, join us as we pave the way for blockchain to change the world for the better. We are looking for a hands-on Tech Ops Intern to support Web3 users and operations across community platforms, blockchain infrastructure, and AI-powered support workflows. This role combines technical troubleshooting, product development, and fast-paced coordination across time zones. #### **What You Will Do** - Help operate Web3 community and support channels, including Telegram and Discord, and follow up on user questions in a timely manner. - Triage issues involving blockchain nodes, RPC services, chain synchronization, and on-chain development; gather logs and reproduction steps, and coordinate with the relevant teams. - Develop, maintain, test, and troubleshoot Telegram Bots and Telegram Mini Apps used in support and operations. - Help organize and improve the AI Support knowledge base by structuring common questions, troubleshooting steps, and response workflows. - Respond quickly to urgent issues, assess their scope, reach the right owners, and keep stakeholders updated through resolution. - Document investigations and solutions so recurring issues can be handled more efficiently. ### Required Qualifications Working knowledge of Web3 and public blockchain ecosystems, including basic concepts such as nodes, chain synchronization, wallets, and on-chain transactions. - Familiarity with RPC usage and common troubleshooting approaches. - Experience operating or administering Telegram and Discord communities or support channels. - Proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language, such as Python, Java, or JavaScript, with the ability to build software independently. - Ability to develop and maintain Telegram Bots and Telegram Mini Apps, and to debug, test, and troubleshoot them. - Strong logical thinking and problem-solving skills; able to quickly understand user issues, organize evidence, and drive follow-up. - Responsive, efficient, and dependable, including when urgent issues require timely coordination across teams. - Fast learner with clear communication and effective collaboration skills. - Availability to work five days per week. ### Preferred Qualifications - Experience with Web3 projects, developer communities, technical support, or node operations. - Experience with blockchain explorers, node providers, or RPC debugging tools. - Experience building scripts, automation tools, or AI-powered support workflows. - Professional English communication skills and availability to provide some coverage outside China Standard Time, especially for collaboration with Europe or the Americas.

Main Purpose of Role The Junior Technical Training Specialist –is a crucial role, responsible for, development and delivery of technical training programs for Medical device segment employees. This role is ensuring that Medical device segment employees are supported in acquiring the necessary skills and knowledge for effective conformity assessments in the ever-evolving landscape of medical device regulations. Key Accountabilities Training Course Preparation: Support the Training team in the preparation and maintenance of core training courses related to medical devices, & MDR/IVDR/ISO13485/MDSAP. This includes conversion of raw training material into e-learning modules, leveraging your own technical knowledge and collaborating with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to ensure all content is highly effective and meets defined learning outcomes. Routine administration support to competence and training team including but not limited to training certificates management, enrolments, training records upload into CAPCAP and collaboration with CV reviewers. Peer Reviews and Assessments: Assist the Training team in conducting peer reviews and marking assessments for trainee exercises, such as Technical File mirror review, to ensure understanding of the conformity assessment process. Training Scheduling: Support the Training team in scheduling training sessions (including CPD, webinars, workshops, Team Calibration and peer-review activities) and tracking the progression and qualification status of new trainees. Regulatory Knowledge: Proactively maintain current and in-depth knowledge of relevant medical device regulations, including the EU MDR/IVDR/ISO13485/MDSAP, to ensure all training materials and delivery methods are compliant. Skills & Knowledge Fluent in English Teaching & Mentoring Skills: Ability to effectively impart knowledge and support the learning process. E-learning and F2F Training: Proficiency in both online and face-to-face training methodologies. Communication: Excellent communication skills to convey complex information clearly. Internal Client Focus: Prioritising the needs and expectations of internal stakeholders. Project Management & Teamwork: Ability to manage projects and collaborate within a team environment. Building Relationships: Establishing and maintaining positive relationships with stakeholders Experience Essential Experience in the field of medical devices gained in the IVD/MD industry. Proven experience in progressively training technical skills, preferably within multinational organizations both in online and face to face methodologies. Desirable Setting priorities and working with minimum supervision. Bachelor level education, preferably in engineering, science, or research-based subjects or modules. 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. Headway is hiring a Technical Recruiter to build and run our campus recruiting program as we grow the engineering teams powering our next stage of growth. You'll own the day-to-day execution of our university presence — from event programming to offer close — and serve as Headway's primary face to campus talent across technical disciplines. As a member of the Engineering Recruiting team, you'll operate as a talent partner and collaborator with hiring managers and the broader TA team, driving predictable hiring outcomes in a high-growth environment with a high talent bar. Your work will directly shape Headway's ability to deliver for providers and patients nationwide. ## You will: - Drive Headway's campus recruiting execution end-to-end: managing event logistics, candidate pipelines, offer positioning, and conversion — working in partnership with TA leadership - Manage the summer internship program end-to-end: driving intern hiring, coordinating project scoping with managers, supporting onboarding, running community programming throughout the summer, and facilitating performance evaluation and return-offer decisions - Partner with HR and Recruiting Programs on the surrounding infrastructure — return offer processes, post-offer engagement, and start-date conversion — that turns campus hires into long-term Headwegians - Support full-cycle searches for new grad and intern roles, spanning aggressive top-of-funnel sourcing and strategic close motions in late stages - Act as a strategic and adaptable partner to hiring managers, quickly refining approach and process as needed to accelerate progress - Ensure every candidate follows a consistent, structured, inclusive process that raises the hiring bar and improves consistency across teams - Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through every step of the process ## You’d be a great fit if you… - Bring 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including meaningful time in campus or university recruiting (in-house, agency, or relevant experience even if you didn’t carry the TA title) - Have a track record of building and managing university relationships and running campus event programs that actually convert - Operate as a strategic and positive partner to your stakeholders, maintaining progress and acting as a true collaborator even in moments of ambiguity - Can break down complex programs into clear execution plans, diagnosing challenges and proposing solutions proactively - Manage multiple workstreams with structure, balancing high volume with attention to detail and predictable execution — especially across a program with seasonal spikes - Think creatively about sourcing and outreach to find and engage top early-career technical talent - Care about candidate experience and community-building, not just pipeline throughput - Communicate clearly and with presence, whether aligning with hiring managers, pitching Headway on campus, or guiding candidates through the process # **Compensation** The expected base pay range for this position is $122,000 - $190,000, based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and geographic location. ## **Comprehensive benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave. role: Systems Intern - Validation, Software, Design, Architecture & Packaging (USA)
location: Austin, Texas, United States; Santa Clara, California, United States
description: Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities. **Overview:** A chip isn't a product until it's a working system. These teams cover both ends of that: getting silicon to boot and validate correctly,building the board, power, mechanical, thermal, packaging and IO around it. You submit one application, you have one recruiter screen - then we match you to the specific team below and location that fits best. - **Systems & Silicon Validation:** Post-silicon testing of physical chips and integrated systems to ensure they meet all functional, electrical, and performance specs. - **System Software:** Development of foundational software, including firmware, drivers, and operating systems, that directly controls and interfaces with hardware. - **System Design:** The process of defining, integrating, and mapping out hardware components such as PCBs, software modules, and interfaces into a complete product blueprint. - **System Architecture:** Define the high-level structural framework, interfaces, and data-flow pathways between the CPU, memory, and peripherals. - **Packaging:** A package is what is placed between the silicon and the board; and its design requires detailed electrical, electromagnetic, and mechanical simulations and analysis. This role is on-site, based out of Austin, TX or Santa Clara, CA. **Who You Are** - Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in EE, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or Mechanical Engineering - Coursework or projects in embedded systems, microwave and signal integrity, board-level design, or thermal/mechanical engineering using low-level programming (C/C++, Python) or hardware design and/or simulation tools (e.g., CAD, FEA, Verilog). - Problem solver with strong foundational knowledge in one of these areas: electrical engineering, digital logic, computer architecture, or thermal/mechanical. - Curious learner who is passionate about the intersection of software, silicon architecture, and the physical constraints of chip packaging and printed circuit boards (PCBs). **What We Need** - **Systems & Silicon Validation:** Assist in post-silicon testing of physical microchips under real-world workloads to ensure they meet all functional, electrical, and performance specifications. - **System Software:** Contribute to developing foundational software—including firmware, drivers, and operating systems—that directly controls and interfaces with the semiconductor hardware. - **System Design & Architecture:** Help map out, define, and evaluate high-level structural frameworks, optimizing the power delivery and high-speed performance benchmarks of both the silicon components and the underlying PCBs. - **Semiconductor Packaging & Mechanical Design:** Design and layout, Electromagnetic (signal integrity and power integrity), mechanical design, and stress analysis **What You Will Learn** - Hands-on silicon experience using industry-standard lab equipment to bridge the gap between theoretical hardware design, physical packaging layouts, and real-world chips. - Low-level software development by writing production-grade firmware, device drivers, and diagnostic tools that run directly on bare metal. - Mechanical & thermal engineering for electronics by learning how structural stress, heat dissipation, thermal expansion, and mechanical shock affect the structural integrity and performance of PCBs and packages. - Cross-functional collaboration working alongside world-class architects, mechanical designers, package engineers, and software teams to understand how complex, large-scale chip ecosystems are built from scratch. **USA Hiring Timelines** This internship opportunity is available throughout our 3 terms with the following corresponding recruitment cycles: - Winter Term: Jan–Apr work term, Sept–Dec recruit. - Summer Term: May–Aug work term, Oct–Apr recruit. - Fall Term: Sept–Dec work term, Jan–Aug recruit. *Please note these timelines are for reference only. Actual timelines may vary.* *Compensation for all interns at Tenstorrent ranges from $50/hr - $70/hr including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.* *Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.* *This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.*

About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut. The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win. The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year. In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando. In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League. role: Robotics Research, Robot Learning & Manipulation Intern (Spring, Summer, & Fall 2027)
description: [FieldAI](http://www.fieldai.com)’s Irvine team is where embodied AI meets real robots, real sensors, and real field deployments. Based in the heart of Southern California’s robotics ecosystem, we build risk-aware, reliable, field-ready AI systems that solve the hardest problems in robotics and unlock the full potential of embodied intelligence. If you want your work to ship, get tested on hardware, and improve through real deployments, Irvine is the place. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-only architectures, combining rigorous engineering with learning systems proven in globally deployed solutions that deliver results today and get better every time our robots run in the field. ### About the Internship We are offering Spring, Summer, and Fall 2027 research internships in the Irvine office for Master’s and PhD students advancing robotic manipulation. You will investigate how robots can perform useful physical tasks reliably across diverse objects, environments, and robot platforms. Working closely with researchers and engineers, you will own a focused research project and help translate promising ideas into capabilities that can be tested on hardware and improved through real deployment experience. Research directions and methods will be shaped by your expertise and the problems we encounter in the field. The goal is to produce original research with measurable impact on what our robots can accomplish. ### What We Offer - Real deployment problems: Work on manipulation challenges grounded in customer use cases and operational needs, with opportunities to evaluate beyond controlled laboratory settings. - Physical robots and hardware: Develop and validate your work on robotic systems, including humanoids, mobile manipulators, and arm-equipped quadrupeds. - Research ownership: Shape a focused project, propose your approach, and carry it through implementation, experimentation, and hardware validation. - Deployment feedback: Use observations and failure cases from real operation to guide research and improve reliability. - Close technical collaboration: Work with researchers and engineers across robot learning, perception, control, hardware, and deployment. - Research contributions: Pursue work suitable for leading conferences and journals, with opportunities to release code, datasets, or other research artifacts. ### What You Will Get To Do - Develop manipulation capabilities that address meaningful physical tasks in real environments. - Investigate how skills transfer across objects, tasks, environments, and robot platforms. - Address practical challenges such as uncertainty, contact, changing conditions, and failure recovery. - Design experiments that measure task success, generalization, and reliability under realistic operating conditions. - Integrate and validate research on physical robots, collaborating with engineering teams to address system constraints. - Document findings, present results, and contribute to publications or reusable research tools. ### What You Have - Current master’s or PhD enrollment in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, AI/ML, or a closely related field. - Research experience in robotic manipulation, robot learning, embodied AI, or a related area. - A strong research or open-source track record, demonstrated through substantive publications, research software, or technically rigorous projects. - Clear ownership of original research or technical development, including implementation and evaluation. - Strong foundations in robotics, machine learning, and experimental design. - Proficiency in Python and/or C++. - Ability to work independently, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate across research and engineering disciplines. ### The Extras That Set You Apart - First-author publications at venues such as RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICLR, or ICML, or journals such as RA-L, T-RO, or IJRR. - Significant contributions to open-source robotics or machine learning projects with demonstrated adoption. - Hands-on experience taking research from an initial idea to reliable operation on physical robots. - Experience evaluating robotic systems outside controlled laboratory conditions. - Public research code, datasets, or robot demonstrations showing technical depth and measurable results. - Experience with robot integration, sensing, control, or data collection infrastructure.

role: Robotics Research, Embodied AI Intern (Spring & Summer 2027)
description: Spring or Summer 2027 FieldAI is transforming how robots interact with the real world. We are building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready AI systems that address the most complex challenges in robotics, unlocking the full potential of embodied intelligence. Our solutions are already deployed globally, and we continuously improve model performance through rapid iteration driven by real field use. As a Robotics Research Intern in Embodied AI, you will investigate fundamental research problems in robot behavior and learning, active perception, human-robot interaction, or at the intersection of these areas, with a focus on complex, unstructured environments. You will work at the intersection of research and real-world deployment, developing new algorithms, validating them on physical robots, learning from field data, and contributing to publications at leading robotics and AI venues. # What You'll Do Depending on your research background and interests, you may work on one or more of the following areas: - Robot Behavior & Learning: Research methods for learning, adapting, and generating robot behaviors from demonstrations, interaction, experience, and real-world data, enabling robots to perform long-horizon tasks in dynamic and unstructured environments. - Active Perception & Embodied Reasoning: Develop methods that enable robots to actively reason about what to inspect, where to observe, and what actions to take next based on task objectives, observations, uncertainty, and environmental context. - Human-Robot Interaction: Develop approaches for intuitive human-robot collaboration, including natural task specification, interactive robot behaviors, human-in-the-loop reasoning, and adaptation to user intent and feedback. - Embodied AI Models: Investigate and adapt foundation models, including vision-language models, vision-language-action models, and world models, for reasoning, planning, interaction, and decision-making on physical robots. - Real-Robot Experimentation: Implement and evaluate research algorithms on robotic platforms operating in realistic, unstructured environments, and use deployment data to iteratively improve the underlying methods. - Research & Publication: Conduct cutting-edge research in embodied AI and robotics, design rigorous experiments and evaluations, and contribute to publications at leading robotics and AI conferences and journals. # What You Bring - Currently pursuing or recently completed a PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. - Strong research foundation in one or more areas such as robot learning, planning and decision-making, embodied AI, perception, active perception, or human-robot interaction. - Familiarity with state-of-the-art research in embodied AI and robotics. - Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++. - Experience with modern machine learning frameworks. - Experience developing and evaluating algorithms for robotic or embodied systems. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to formulate research questions and design rigorous experiments. - Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across research and engineering teams. # What Will Set You Apart - Hands-on robotics experience, including testing and deploying autonomous systems on physical robots. Experience with ROS or ROS2 and real robotic systems. - Publications at leading AI and robotics venues such as CoRL, ICRA, IROS, RSS, NeurIPS, CVPR, or similar. - Research experience in robot behavior and learning, such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning, learning from demonstrations, or learning from interaction and real-world experience. - Research experience in active perception or active inspection, including task-driven perception, information-gathering behaviors, viewpoint selection, or reasoning under uncertainty. - Experience in human-robot interaction, language-conditioned robotics, shared autonomy, or interactive robot learning. - Experience fine-tuning or deploying large multimodal models, particularly vision-language, vision-language-action, open-vocabulary, or related foundation models. ### **Why Join FieldAI** FieldAI is tackling one of robotics’ hardest problems: deploying robots in unstructured, previously unknown environments. We are solving one of robotics' hardest challenges: reliable deployment outside the lab. Our Field Foundational Models™ raise the bar for perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, with an emphasis on explainability and safety for real-world use. You will work alongside a world-class team that values creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. We bring a decade-long track record of real-world deployments, strong performance in DARPA challenges, and experience from organizations such as DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX. ### **Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution** Solving problems at this scale takes a team as unique as the mission. We are looking for people who push beyond conventional approaches, enjoy tackling tough and ambiguous questions, and bring interdisciplinary perspective. Our success depends on exceptional AI researchers and engineers, as well as strong software developers, product designers, field deployment experts, and communicators who can turn breakthroughs into real capability. We are headquartered in Irvine, Southern California, with teammates across the US and around the world. Join us to shape the future of embodied intelligence as part of a fun, close-knit team building systems that work in the real world. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We evaluate candidates and employees based on merit, qualifications, and performance, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status. description: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. AECOM is seeking an Entry-Level Environmental Engineer to join our team in Milwaukee, Wisconsin , and contribute to environmental investigation, remediation, and site redevelopment projects. This position offers an opportunity to apply engineering fundamentals to environmental challenges while learning from experienced engineers, scientists, and geologists in a collaborative consulting environment. This position is expected to begin ASAP. In this role, you will support the planning and implementation of environmental field programs, evaluate site investigation data, and assist with the development and implementation of remediation solutions. Field responsibilities may include environmental sampling, groundwater monitoring, remediation system inspections, collection of operating data, and oversight of subcontractors performing drilling, excavation, and other field activities. Office responsibilities will include engineering calculations, data analysis, technical report preparation, and support for remediation design and project documentation. The ideal candidate is interested in developing practical environmental engineering skills, solving technical problems, and contributing to projects that improve environmental quality and protect human health. Strong communication, organizational, and analytical skills, combined with a commitment to health and safety, will be important to success in this role. Key Responsibilities Assist with environmental site investigations, remediation projects, and environmental engineering studies for public- and private-sector clients. Support field programs involving soil, groundwater, surface water, sediment, and soil vapor sampling, groundwater monitoring, and remediation system data collection. Assist with evaluating environmental conditions and identifying potential engineering approaches for site investigation, remediation, and environmental management. Collect, organize, and analyze field and laboratory data to support environmental assessments, engineering evaluations, and remediation decisions. Assist with the preparation of engineering calculations, technical memoranda, investigation reports, remediation work plans, design documents, figures, and other project deliverables. Support the evaluation, operation, and monitoring of environmental remediation systems, including documenting system performance and identifying conditions that may require further investigation. Assist with field oversight of subcontractors performing drilling, well installation, excavation, sampling, and other intrusive or remediation activities. Help evaluate project activities and technical results against applicable environmental regulations, permits, engineering standards, and client requirements. Coordinate with engineers, scientists, geologists, laboratories, contractors, and other project team members to support project schedules, budgets, and technical objectives. Participate in project health and safety activities, follow site-specific safety plans, and help identify and communicate potential hazards. Support project administration, including data management, quality control, records maintenance, and tracking project deliverables. Travel to project locations as required, including occasional overnight stays, and perform fieldwork in varying weather conditions and site environments. Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education. Valid U.S. Driver’s License required to visit project sites, clients, and other AECOM offices. As a condition of employment, selected candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Records review. Candidate will submit to medical surveillance screening upon hire. Due to the nature of the work, U.S. Citizenship is required. Preferred Qualifications: Experience or academic background relevant to environmental engineering, environmental remediation, water quality, site investigation, or environmental data analysis. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary project teams. Ability to travel to project sites and perform fieldwork, including outdoor work in varying weather conditions. Ability to follow established engineering procedures, quality requirements, and applicable health and safety standards. Relevant years of experience supporting environmental engineering, site investigation, remediation, or environmental consulting projects. Master's degree in Environmental Engineering or a related engineering discipline. OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER certification and current refresher training, as applicable. First Aid/CPR certification. Experience with environmental sampling, groundwater monitoring, remediation systems, engineering calculations, or environmental data analysis through employment, internships, or academic projects. Familiarity with environmental remediation technologies, including groundwater treatment, soil remediation, and contaminant containment or removal. Familiarity with federal and state environmental regulations, including requirements administered by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources. Experience preparing technical reports, engineering calculations, figures, data tables, or project documentation. Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and other standard Microsoft Office applications; familiarity with engineering or data analysis software is an asset. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and an interest in developing practical, cost-effective engineering solutions. Demonstrated ability to manage assigned tasks, communicate effectively, and work collaboratively with clients, colleagues, and subcontractors. This position is based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and requires a hybrid work schedule that includes scheduled in-office work. Fieldwork and travel to project sites are required. Travel may include regional assignments, occasional overnight stays, and work at sites with varying physical and environmental conditions. Relocation assistance is not available for this position. Our Ground Engineering team in the United Kingdom and Ireland (UK&I) comprises 150 professionals who provide a comprehensive range of services, including project management, feasibility studies, ground investigation design and interpretation, detailed design, contract administration, and construction supervision. We work on ground engineering projects across the UK&I and internationally, supporting both internal and external clients. Our primary focus areas include energy, water, nuclear (decommissioning and new build), power, road and rail, aviation, ports and harbours, as well as commercial and industrial developments, and landslip investigation and remediation. We work for leading UK and International clients, including National Grid, BP, Sellafield, Associated British Ports, Transport Scotland, National Highways, Transport Infrastructure Ireland, Network Rail, and local authorities, as well as for prominent contractors and developers. Our impressive portfolio features a range of regional and national projects, such as the Great Grid Upgrade, STEP Fusion, pumped storage hydro projects in the Scottish Highlands, Snowdonia VIP, A83 Rest and be Thankful, M54-M6 Link Road, water schemes for various water utilities clients (UK&I) and HMNB Devonport redevelopment. Additionally, we are involved in overseas projects such as Eastlink in Sweden. As a Ground Engineering Apprentice, you will work alongside experienced geotechnical engineers and engineering geologists whilst studying towards a Level 6 Degree Apprenticeship in either Civil Engineering or Geoscience. You will gain practical experience across a variety of ground engineering projects, developing the technical knowledge necessary to build a successful career within the industry. As an apprentice, you will: Assist with desk studies and site investigations. Support the planning, procurement and supervision of ground investigations. Help analyse geological and geotechnical data. Contribute to the development of ground models and interpretative reports. Assist with assessments of foundations, earthworks, slope stability, and retaining structures. Use industry-leading digital tools such as OpenGround and Leapfrog. Participate in site visits and fieldwork activities across the UK. Collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams. Develop your technical and professional skills through a structured apprenticeship programme. This role is ideal for students and school leavers looking to pursue a career in Ground Engineering through a Level 6 Degree Apprenticeship. Minimum of 5 GCSEs (or equivalent) at Grade 4/C or above, including Mathematics and English. Three A-Levels (or equivalent such as BTEC Level 3 in Civil Engineering), including Maths and a physical science at grade C or above – required for Level 6 Degree Apprenticeship A genuine interest in geology, geotechnics, civil engineering and the built environment. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Enthusiasm for learning and professional development. Ability to work effectively within a team. Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible, as CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected on a rolling recruitment basis for either immediate or advanced offer starts. Please include a covering letter with your application, detailing all predicted and/or obtained academic grades, the dates you are able to work (to/from), and the locations you are interested in. We support and encourage office attendance across all grades to foster a collaborative working culture and facilitate on-the-job learning for early career staff. You must have the right to work in the UK. Professional Development Our 2-year Graduate Development Programme (GDP), combined with our extensive portfolio of projects worldwide, will challenge and inspire you to make a real difference to the world we live in. The GDP is a core component of our business strategy, designed to cultivate top talent across various disciplines to lead our business into the future. We currently have over 750 graduates in our programme across the UK&I, representing more than 40 different disciplines, each making a tangible impact on the environment we all share. In addition to the GDP, we enrol all our Ground Engineering Graduates in GEO Grounding , our in-house technical training academy, which focuses on a series of modules including Desk Study, Geological Interpretation and Geomorphology, Ground Investigation (Design and Site Supervision), Ground Model Development, Parametric Assessment and Geotechnical Design. GEO Grounding comprises module attendance followed by trainer-student discussion workshops to enhance learning. # **Role highlights:** - **Rotational Product Manager** - Location: Espoo, Finland, with frequent travel - Working type: Hybrid (3 days / in office per week) - Department: Product Management - Employment type: Permanent - Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required) ## **Why this role is different** Few people get to start their product career in space. You will. ICEYE's Rotational Product Manager program develops early-career talent into product leaders in the space industry. You don't need product management experience to apply. We're looking for people with an outstanding academic record, ideally in a technical field, and a track record of standing out at work, who are deeply curious and learn fast. Over 24 months, you'll work in two product teams on our hardware or software products. In each one, you'll own a product end to end, from understanding the customer's problem to deciding what gets built and shipping it. Your work will shape how our customers use satellite data to make decisions that matter. A senior product leader will mentor you through each rotation, and you'll go through the program with a cohort of peers. You'll work closely with engineers, scientists and senior leaders, and you'll travel to meet customers and our local teams, working on some of their toughest problems. This program is fast and demanding, and it will stretch you. It may also be the most rewarding experience of your early career. When the program ends, you will have the opportunity to move into a permanent product manager role, or to explore roles in other domains at ICEYE. Spots are limited, and we review applications on a rolling basis, so apply today! ## **Who We Are** ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. **Your day-to-day responsibilities** - Own the roadmap for a product area in each rotation, and decide what the team builds next and why - Talk to customers, users and internal experts to understand their problems, and turn what you learn into clear requirements - Work with engineers and designers from defining a problem through to shipping and measuring the result - Use data to set priorities and make decisions, and explain the tradeoffs behind them - Work with sales, solutions, operations and other teams to get what you build into customers’ hands - Present your findings and plans to your team and to product leadership - Learn the technical domain of each team, from satellites and ground systems to the software customers run ## **What we’re looking for** **Must haves:** - An outstanding academic record, ideally in a technical field such as engineering, computer science or physics - Technical work experience through internships or a first full-time role, where you stood out - You can break down a problem, design an analysis and test your assumptions with data - You learn fast and are comfortable digging into how complex systems work with engineers - You take ownership and can move a team forward without formal authority - Fluent written and spoken English, and happy to travel frequently **Nice to haves:** - Business exposure, for example an internship or short role in consulting, a startup or a product team - Some exposure to product work, for example as an engineer, analyst or designer working closely with a product team - Experience with SQL, Python or other data tools - Interest in space, defence or other mission-critical industries **Application Process** - **Applications close on 8th November 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish time).** We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply early - Recruiter interview - Home assignment, presented to interview panel - CPO interview - The program starts on 2 February 2027 ## **Working at ICEYE** At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win. ### **How We Work (Our Values)** **Make the impossible possible**: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way. - **Be curious**: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions. - **See the big picture:** Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others. - **Drive effective teamwork:** Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions. - **Act as one team:** We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift. - **Have fun**: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins. ### **Benefits** Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Attraction will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process. Base salary range for this position depends on level of experience and will be negotiated individually. ### **Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion** We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. role: (Physical) Security Specialist Intern - 2027 Internship, DC Security
description: Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying. Behind every click, stream, and cloud service is real hardware — and someone needs to make sure it gets where it needs to be. As a Logistics Specialist Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will help manage the supply chain that keeps our data centers running, from receiving and tracking parts to ensuring the right equipment is in the right place at the right time. This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Logistics Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs. Who Should Apply We welcome applications from: - Students in the last year of their Technical/Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Supply Chain, Logistics, or a similar discipline who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career. About the Role You will join a creative, dynamic team of Logistics Specialists dedicated to providing world-class customer service — and you will be part of operating the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure. This hands-on role supports our procurement and supply chain operations. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. What You Will Do - Monitor inventory levels to ensure proper stock levels are maintained - Receive parts, maintain inventory records, and check out parts - Load and unload shipments and transport parts between different locations - Assemble, address, stamp, and arrange for the shipment of merchandise and materials - Assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations - Unpack incoming shipments and verify contents - Maintain precise records of all commodities going in and out of the facility Physical Requirements This role involves physical activity, including: - Regularly lifting and moving up to 16 kilograms (approximately 35 pounds) unassisted, and participating in group lifts for heavier items - Lifting loads of up to 22 kilograms (approximately 49 pounds) and carrying them for short distances - Continuously climbing and descending stairs safely (applies to sites with stairs) - Reaching and stretching to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance - Pushing or pulling heavy objects into position - If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation during the application or hiring process, visit for more information. Internship Structure Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday. This is a paid internship. Please note that a full-time Logistics Specialist position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying. Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go. From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help keep the supply chain moving for one of the world's largest cloud infrastructures — making sure the right parts arrive at the right place at the right time so millions of customers stay connected. - Impact. Your work keeps data centers stocked and operational. Every shipment you process and every part you track plays a role in keeping AWS running for customers around the world. - Action. You will move fast, solve real logistics challenges, and see the results of your work every day. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice. - Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will learn how a world-class supply chain operates at massive scale and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon. - Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape. About the team AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

## About Novita AI Novita AI is an AI & Agent Cloud platform for builders. We provide high-performance Model APIs, dedicated inference infrastructure, and Agent Sandbox environments that help developers and enterprises build, deploy, and scale production AI applications. ## The Role As a **Forward Deployed Engineer Intern**, you’ll work directly with customers to help them build and launch production AI systems. You’ll sit at the intersection of engineering, customer success, and product, working alongside experienced engineers and GTM team members. Unlike a traditional software engineering internship, much of your work will start with an actual customer problem. A customer might need help understanding why an API is slow, scaling an inference workload, integrating a model endpoint, reproducing an error, or launching thousands of concurrent agent sandboxes. Your job is to understand the problem, investigate it, and help drive it to resolution. ## What You’ll Do - Work directly with customers building AI products and agents. - Help integrate Novita Model APIs, dedicated inference endpoints, and Agent Sandbox. - Reproduce and debug customer issues involving APIs, networking, containers, Linux, and inference workloads. - Investigate errors, latency, throughput, concurrency, and reliability issues. - Build demos, integrations, scripts, PoCs, and reference implementations. - Help customers move from experimentation into production. - Partner with product, engineering, and SRE teams to resolve customer issues. - Write documentation, runbooks, and internal tooling that make future deployments easier. - Identify patterns across customer workloads and translate them into product improvements. - Learn how customer usage, technical success, and business growth connect. As you gain experience, you may independently own technical relationships with selected customers. ## What We’re Looking For ### Requirements - Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. - Strong programming fundamentals. - Proficiency in Python or another general-purpose programming language. - Familiarity with Linux and APIs. - Strong debugging and problem-solving ability. - Comfortable communicating directly with customers. - Ability to explain technical concepts clearly. - High ownership and willingness to work through ambiguous problems. - Available approximately 20 hours/week during the academic term or full-time during summer. ### Nice to Have - Experience building applications using LLM APIs. - Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure. - Experience with agent frameworks or coding agents. - Familiarity with vLLM, SGLang, Ray, or other inference systems. - Understanding of inference concepts such as latency, throughput, caching, batching, and concurrency. - Hackathon projects, open-source contributions, or startup experience. - Experience teaching, consulting, developer relations, or supporting technical users. - Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese. ## What Success Looks Like During your internship, you will: - Help real customers successfully deploy AI workloads. - Become comfortable debugging production-facing problems. - Build reusable tooling or documentation used by future customers. - Develop strong intuition around how modern AI infrastructure works. - Learn how engineering decisions affect customer adoption and business outcomes.

## About Novita AI Novita AI is an AI & Agent Cloud platform for builders. We provide high-performance Model APIs, dedicated inference infrastructure, and Agent Sandbox environments that help developers and enterprises build, deploy, and scale production AI applications. Our customers range from fast-growing AI startups to teams building coding agents, AI assistants, and large-scale inference products. ## The Role We’re looking for a **Technical GTM Intern** who is excited about both technology and customers. This is not a traditional sales internship. You’ll work directly with technical founders, engineers, and AI teams to understand what they are building, help them evaluate and adopt Novita AI, and support them as they move from experimentation into production. You’ll operate at the intersection of technical discovery, customer engineering, and go-to-market. One day you may help a customer understand an inference performance issue; another day you may help scope a production workload, coordinate a quota increase, or identify how an account can expand. You do not need previous sales experience. We care much more about technical curiosity, communication ability, ownership, and your ability to learn quickly. ## What You’ll Do - Work directly with AI startups, developers, and technical teams evaluating Novita AI. - Understand customer workloads, including model usage, latency, throughput, concurrency, reliability, and sandbox requirements. - Help customers get started with Novita’s Model APIs, dedicated inference endpoints, and Agent Sandbox. - Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to troubleshoot technical issues and remove blockers to production adoption. - Support customer conversations around usage, quotas, capacity, pricing, and production rollout. - Research and identify promising AI companies, developers, and emerging use cases. - Track customer adoption and identify opportunities for workloads to grow. - Build lightweight demos, scripts, or technical examples when useful to move a customer forward. - Gather product and competitive insights from customer conversations. - Work closely with engineering, product, and GTM teams across the US and Asia. As you ramp up, you may independently own smaller customer relationships from initial conversation through technical evaluation, production adoption, and expansion. ## What We’re Looking For ### Requirements - Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or another technical field. - Strong interest in AI products, developer tools, or cloud infrastructure. - Comfortable communicating with engineers and learning technical systems quickly. - Basic understanding of APIs, LLMs, and modern AI applications. - Some programming experience, ideally with Python or another general-purpose language. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - High ownership and willingness to follow problems through to resolution. - Comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup environment. - Available approximately 20 hours/week during the academic term or full-time during summer. ### Nice to Have - Experience building AI or software side projects. - Experience using LLM APIs or developer platforms. - Familiarity with inference concepts such as tokens, latency, throughput, caching, rate limits, or concurrency. - Hackathon, startup, developer community, or open-source experience. - Previous customer-facing, consulting, teaching, or leadership experience. - Interest in startups, product, sales, or business development. - Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese. ## Who Thrives in This Role You may be a strong fit if you enjoy: - Understanding how technology works. - Talking to people and figuring out what they actually need. - Debugging why something isn’t working. - Helping customers successfully launch products. - Moving quickly between technical and business problems. - Thinking about how a technical workload can grow into a meaningful customer relationship. This role is especially well suited for technical students who enjoy building things but don’t necessarily want their entire career to be limited to writing code.

Depuis 2014, Wiremind s’impose comme une entreprise technologique qui transforme les secteurs du transport et de l’événementiel grâce à une approche à 360° combinant expérience utilisateur (UX), logiciels et intelligence artificielle (IA) . Notre expertise repose principalement sur l’optimisation et la distribution des capacités de nos clients. Nous travaillons sur des projets variés tels que la prévision de la demande et la tarification des billets, l’optimisation 3D du fret aérien ou encore le scraping des prix de nos concurrents .
