role: MBA Technical Strategy and Operations Intern
description: **Who we are** Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress. Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that. Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive. This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale. We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life. If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us. **About the role** We are looking for a graduate student intern with a vehicle or mobility background to support technical strategy and operations for our vehicle engineering team. You will own a defined workstream within one of our programs: the plan, the milestones, the dependencies, the risks, and the weekly readout to engineering leadership. Depending on the workstream, you may also support issue tracking, manufacturing during vehicle builds, and analysis for engineering decisions. The role is hands-on. Expect regular time in the garage, and on the production floor with the engineers and technicians doing the work. **What you’ll do** - Own the plan for a defined workstream, such as a build, a bench, a supplier transition, a fleet readiness milestone, or a process rollout. Maintain milestones, dependencies, risks, and open actions. - Publish a weekly status readout to engineering leadership with progress, blockers, decisions needed, and a recommendation for each escalation. - Keep the issue record current. Prepare the weekly triage, chase owners for updates, and roll the results into the weekly readout. - Support vehicle builds as needed, including build readiness, parts and kitting status, work instructions, and issue capture on the floor while a build is in progress. - Pull the quotes, lead times, cost data, and fleet data the program needs, and build the comparisons the engineering owner uses to decide. - Work with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, fleet operations, and finance to move your workstream forward. - Identify what is slowing your workstream down, propose a fix, implement it, and measure the result. **What we’re looking for** - Current graduate student in an MBA, an engineering master's (mechanical, electrical, industrial, systems, automotive, or similar), or a related master's program such as engineering management, operations, or supply chain. - Prior background in vehicles or mobility, including automotive, EV, autonomous vehicles, commercial vehicles, fleet operations, mobility services, off-highway or heavy equipment. - Comfortable with technical material, including build plans, test reports, and BOMs. - Experience owning a deliverable through to completion against a schedule. - Comfortable in a garage and on a production floor. - Able to commit 15-20 hours per week during the academic term on a consistent schedule, with regular onsite days in San Francisco. **Why join us** At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow. **What else you need to know** This role is based in our San Francisco office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week. The base starting rate for this role is **$56.00 per hour.** Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. **Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?** *#LI-Onsite*

Notre mission est d’accompagner la construction et le déploiement de modèles sobres, durables et solidaires en vue de générer un impact positif sur les écosystèmes et au sein de la société. Nous œuvrons auprès des acteurs publics et privés en vue de générer trois types d’impact : Atténuer le changement climatique et favoriser l’adaptation ; Préserver les ressources naturelles ; Protéger les droits humains fondamentaux et promouvoir la justice sociale. En France comme à l’international, Transitions s’appuie sur le dialogue entre acteurs pour répondre aux défis de la transition écologique et sociale . Notre agence est devenue une référence en matière d’accompagnement des territoires, de stratégies d’approvisionnement responsable des acteurs privés, et de transition vers des systèmes de production sobres et durables. Pour en savoir plus . Au sein de TRANSITIONS, l'équipe Approvisionnement Responsable accompagne les secteurs privé et public dans le renforcement de la responsabilité environnementale et sociale des chaînes d'approvisionnement agricoles, forestières et extractives (huile de palme, soja, coton, fruits, pâte à papier, bois, caoutchouc, minéraux, etc.). Nos clients sont des organisations de premier plan dans les secteurs de la fabrication de biens de consommation, des soins personnels, de l'alimentation et des boissons, de la mode et du luxe, de l'industrie et de la vente au détail qui nous ont choisis pour les aider à concevoir et à mettre en œuvre leurs politiques d'approvisionnement responsable et sans déforestation. Dans le cadre de l’évolution de ses missions liées à l’approvisionnement responsable, #Transitions recherche un stagiaire (H/F) pour accompagner ses équipes dans le traitement et la gestion de ses données liées à la traçabilité des chaînes d’approvisionnement. A l’interface des équipes de consultants et analystes de données, les principales responsabilités du poste sont les suivantes : Gestion et analyse de données dans le cadre des activités de traçabilité des chaînes d'approvisionnement : Traiter et exploiter les données récoltées, notamment au travers de l’application de procédures de traitement des données ; Participation active à la campagne de traçabilité tel un consultant, impliquant de la collecte de données issues de sources variées (internes, clients, fournisseurs, données publiques, webscraping, etc.) ; Appui à la mise à jour des outils d’analyse et de visualisation des données (tableaux de bord, KPIs, etc.) ; Soutien à la production des livrables (PPT, fichiers Excel) ; Soutien au travail de veille et de mise à jour des données liées aux alertes environnementales et sociales dans les chaînes d’approvisionnement ; Soutien actif pour établir des liens entre diverses sources de données, contenus et analyses afin de faciliter et améliorer l'élaboration de recommandations aux clients. Ponctuellement, soutien à d’autres missions et activités de Transitions en lien avec la gestion et le traitement de données. Vous préparez un diplôme Bac+4/Bac+5 avec une spécialisation en data management, analyse de données, système d’information ou informatique. Compétences techniques : Python (programmation, pandas, pdfplumber), SQL ; GIT, GITHUB, CI/CD, versionning ; ETL (Talend) ; Base de données (Snowflake serait un plus) ; PowerBi ; Maîtrise indispensable des outils de gestion de données low-code (Excel et Power Query notamment) informatiques et digitaux ; Maîtrise indispensable de l’anglais et du français, oral et écrit ; Compétences comportementales : Capacités relationnelles et d’écoute, autonomie et rigueur, vous vous épanouissez dans le travail en équipe Capacité d’adaptation rapide à des problématiques ou domaines techniques nouveaux ; Bonne capacité d’analyse dans la compréhension des demandes et d’un esprit de synthèse dans les réponses apportées ; Vous êtes suffisamment curieux·se et impliqué·e pour monter naturellement et de manière autonome en compétence ; Vous êtes sensibilisé·e aux problématiques écologiques. Dans un premier temps, lisez attentivement la job description afin de mettre en avant vos expériences et vos compétences qui vous semblent pertinentes pour cette opportunité ! Un CV personnalisé et détaillé vous permettra à coup sûr de vous démarquer 😉 Lettre de motivation ou pas ? A choisir, nous préférerons toujours quelques lignes expliquant votre motivation à candidater, plutôt qu’un texte générique copié/collé ! Un encart est d’ailleurs spécifiquement prévu à cet effet lors de votre candidature. N’hésitez à consulter notre article JobTeaser pour plus de conseils ! Je ne connais pas le secteur du jeu vidéo. Ai-je ma place chez Ubisoft ? Nous comptons dans nos rangs de nombreux profils qui ne sont pas des férus de jeux vidéo. Chez Ubisoft, nous cherchons à nous entourer de personnes passionnées, que ce soit par leurs spécialités, leurs métiers ou par le divertissement en général. A quoi m’attendre lors d’un stage ou d’une alternance chez Ubisoft ? Dès vos premiers jours, vous bénéficierez d’une Welcome Session vous présentant Ubisoft, son organisation et votre environnement de travail pour les prochains mois. Votre tuteur·rice et votre équipe vous accompagneront au quotidien, dans les premières semaines comme tout au long de votre expérience ! Une fois autonome, vos missions seront responsabilisantes et variées, peu importe le type de contrat. Travailler chez Ubisoft signifie travailler sur de vrais projets à mener au jour le jour. Un groupe Teams dédié vous permettra par ailleurs d’échanger avec les autres stagiaires et alternant·es. Quels sont les engagements sociétaux d’Ubisoft ? Nous cherchons à enrichir la vie des joueurs et joueuses par la création d’expériences de jeu originales et mémorables, et en nous appliquant à toujours améliorer l’impact positif de nos jeux. Ubisoft est une référence mondiale du jeu vidéo, avec des équipes réparties aux quatre coins du monde qui créent des expériences de jeu originales et mémorables, de Assassin’s Creed à Rainbow Six en passant par Just Dance et bien d’autres encore. Nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait progresser à la fois les joueurs et les équipes. Si vous êtes passionné·e par l’innovation et que vous souhaitez repousser les limites du divertissement, rejoignez notre aventure et aidez-nous à créer l’inconnu

JetZero is the inevitable solution to sustainable air travel. ### **The JetZero Team** We are experienced aerospace professionals and engineers, excited about the future. JetZero is developing a blended-wing body (BWB) aircraft. It uses up to 50% less fuel and will be built to accommodate zero-emission hydrogen propulsion. JetZero is the inevitable solution to sustainable air travel. ### **The JetZero Team** We are experienced aerospace professionals and engineers, excited about the future. Throughout your journey, you’ll take part in events, meetups and initiatives designed to connect the talents of tomorrow with our teams. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? ENTER THE GAME 🎮 Tech teams at Betclic are organized around agile development principles and are structured into autonomous Squads and Tribes, each responsible for a specific functional and technical domain. Thanks to this organization, you’ll take full ownership of your projects from start to finish: development, delivery, and production monitoring. You build it, you run it! By joining one of our Betclic teams, you’ll become part of a Fullstack team where you’ll enjoy the autonomy to grow by working alongside Backend and Frontend developers, testers, and other complementary skillsets. As a Data Engineer, you will join the Data Fabric team, composed of Data Ops, Data Engineers, ML Ops, and an Architect. The team's role is to ensure the availability of the data platform and to implement tools and best practices around data. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 In this role, your main missions will be: Data modeling and transformation — Design and maintain data models following a medallion architecture (bronze, silver, gold) using dbt, and structure their exposition in the data warehouse to make them consumable by business teams. Data pipeline orchestration — Develop and operate data pipelines with Airflow, ensuring reliability through monitoring and incident resolution. Data visualization support — Feed and evolve business dashboards in collaboration with Product Owners and Data Analysts. Data governance — Contribute to data retention, quality, and contracts between domains. Cost optimization and observability — Monitor and optimize cloud data costs (FinOps), and maintain pipeline observability through dashboards and alerting. Architecture and workflow contributions — Propose and contribute to improvements on the team's software architecture, development practices, and tooling. TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT - Snowflake - DBT - Omni - Datadog - Airflow - SQL (mandatory) - Dataviz (appétence) WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm! This internship is for you if: Currently pursuing a Master's degree in Data Engineering, you have gained initial experience (internship or academic project) as a Data Engineer. You are eager to grow within a dynamic team and an agile environment. You are curious, self-reliant, and have a strong desire to learn. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 If your application is selected, Mathilde will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening call (30 minutes). You will then be invited to complete the AssessFirst test (covering personality, motivations, and cognitive abilities). Next, you’ll meet with your future manager for a technical and team-fit interview. Finally, you’ll have a final HR interview with Maxime, where you’ll also review and discuss your AssessFirst results together. To ensure a smooth and candidate-friendly experience, the Betclic recruitment process typically takes between 4 to 6 weeks. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT ? 🎁 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic) 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport) 🏡 Hybrid work model 🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin 🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life 🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…) 6 months paid internship starting in February 2027 – Based in Bordeaux 📍 Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX All our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Electromechanical Production Technician Entry Level - $1,500 Sign-on Bonus! Looking for meaningful work where you can make a difference in global innovation? Engineer a better future with Aerotech, a global leader in precision motion and automation. Our customers create some of the most innovative products on the planet, from life-saving medical devices to tools for deep space exploration. Position Summary: The Electromechanical Production Technician is an entry-level production position that includes roles in various departments including Motors, Core Mechatronics, Electrical Assembly, Wiring and more. This on-the-job training role will align your strengths with a career path customized to your strengths and interests. This is a great opportunity for individuals looking to start or transition to a hands-on technical career. What will your day look like? At Aerotech, you could have the opportunity to: Experience many different aspects of precision automation manufacturing while training on-the-job alongside experienced motor assembly, electrical, mechanical, and electromechanical technicians Participate in a structured career development program intended to provide the skills necessary to become an expert in the precision manufacturing industry Read wiring and assembly drawings to determine product requirements Assemble cables and cable harnesses using hand tools, power tools, and soldering Route and attach wires to circuit boards, connectors, inline splices, and/or subassemblies using solder, crimp, and IDC termination methods Assemble and test complex, high precision mechanical and electrical components using a variety of proprietary testing and measurement equipment and software Assemble/Wire/Test precision motion systems Operate additive manufacturing (3D printing) equipment in the production of Aerotech parts Troubleshoot to determine the cause of malfunctioning products, work with peers and supervisors to find a solution, then perform modification and repair when necessary Grow into more advanced roles throughout the organization as you develop skills and experience What will separate you from the rest? role: Electrical Apprentice - Winter/Fall 2026 Class August - November
description: MCS is hiring for an Electrical Apprentice in Tampa, Florida. This is a full-time, permanent position with benefits. Winter/Spring 2026 Class January - April This will include a Full-Time position as an Apprentice Monday - Friday 7am - 4pm, with additional Classroom Time on Tuesday and Thursday evenings ... 6pm - 9pm for a 4 year Apprenticeship Program through the I.E.C. The Electrical Apprentice must demonstrate the ability to read, interpret and execute drawings, schematics, blueprints, and electrical code specifications for commercial electrical equipment installations. The Electrical Apprentice will require good communication skills and the ability to work well in a team setting. It is important that candidates keep abreast of industry trends and developments, as well as applicable Government regulations. Typical duties include: Installing, repairing, or replacing electrical wiring, receptacles, switch boxes, conduits, feeders, fiber-optic, line assemblies, lighting, and alternative electrical parts. Installing, repairing, or replacing generators and industrial storage batteries. Installing electrical circuits, as well as panels, conduit, protecting devices, switches, and equipment required to accommodate the CEC and/or NEC. Installing, maintaining, and calibrating industrial equipment and connected devices. Communicating clearly and concisely. Maintaining a working knowledge of the NEC. Reading and understanding blueprints/schematics. Required: Educational Requirements: High School diploma or equivalent, Apprenticeship training preferred. Certification Requirements: Ability to obtain a Florida State JLA (Jessica Lunsford Act) Badge. Experience Requirements: Needs to have a detailed knowledge of electrical codes and standards. Must enroll in the IEC program. (Currently enrolled candidates preferred). Must be able to read and interpret electrical schematics, diagrams, and blueprints. Ability to use basic hand tools, power tools, etc. Ability to read, speak and understand English. Knowledge of “Safe” working practices (ex. OSHA, Lock Out / Tag Out). Clean background with the ability to pass a required drug screening. Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, including overtime if necessary. Must be able to climb ladders. Must possess own transportation, as most locations aren’t accessible with public transportation. Mission Critical Solutions (MCS) is a leading-edge technology solutions provider headquartered in Tampa, Florida. MCS provides a broad range of Technology products and services organized in six core lines of business –Telecommunications, Structured Cabling, Audio-Visual, Security and Life Safety Systems, Electrical Distribution Systems, and Unified Communications. Fundamental Functions Work Environment Work assignments may vary based on client requirements. Work may be performed inside a large facility. An inside environment may be a cubicle (considerations: close quarters, low to moderate noise, bright or dim lighting). Work may be performed in the field. Outside work may include various environmental conditions including hot, dusty, cold, wet, icy, or windy climates. Schedule Regular attendance following an established work schedule is mandatory. It is important to be able to work any shift/designated hours required. You may be asked to continue performance during inclement weather or other conditions when others are not permitted to work. This position may require night and weekend work and could include travel to areas with varying field conditions. Physical Requirements May require climbing ladders, working at heights and in small, confined spaces such as under raised floors, inside closets, and server racks. Must possess the capability to sit, stoop, kneel, or crouch for extended durations. Will be required to operate in noisy environments with temperatures higher or lower than standard office conditions. Must be able to lift and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. Sitting at desk. Phone use and PC/laptop. May require lifting and carrying boxes of supplies or files. Extended periods of sitting while on PC/laptop or phone. Equipment and Machines General office equipment includes but is not limited to PCs/laptops, telephones, copiers, servers, switches, routers, and other computer equipment that supports the network environment. General field equipment includes but is not limited to hand tools, power tools, ladders, aerial/motorized lifts, and test equipment. This position may require the operation of motor vehicles as an essential job function. Candidates must possess a valid driver's license and a clean driving record. The ability to operate company vehicles safely and responsibly is crucial. Employees may be subject to periodic motor vehicle record checks, and any discrepancies may impact eligibility for the position. MCS of Tampa assumes no liability for accidents, incidents, or violations that may occur while employees are operating motor vehicles for non-work-related purposes. Safety is of utmost importance, and adherence to traffic laws and company policies governing the use of motor vehicles is mandatory. Travel Travel requirements will vary. Not all positions require travel. A current passport is required for Overseas travel. Other Essential Functions Employment is contingent upon obtaining and maintaining required certifications or licenses through the duration of the project or contract. Failure to obtain/maintain required certifications will result in disqualification for this position and could result in termination. Candidate must exhibit a professional behavior that promotes teamwork, fosters cooperation and enhances productivity in the workplace. Must be well organized with the ability to coordinate, prioritize, and execute multiple tasks simultaneously. Candidate must have the ability to communicate verbally and in writing to work effectively with various external customers including government, military, and contractor personnel at all levels. Candidate must be able to communicate effectively with individuals at all levels of the company. For office environments, grooming and dress are typically business casual but are dependent on the client’s standards. For field environments, grooming and dress must not pose a safety hazard to yourself or employees working in the same general area. MCS of Tampa employees must adhere to OSHA Standards. The position for which you are applying for may require a US government security clearance. This is to advise you, that should you be extended an offer, if you possess a dual citizenship (i.e., citizen of the US and another country), to be granted a clearance you will be required to relinquish your citizenship in the foreign country. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Job Title: Junior Software Developer Location: Remote, with occasional travel to U.S. Coast Guard in Kearneysville, WV Clearance: Ability to obtain Public Trust clearance Type: Full-time, W2 About VivSoft: VivSoft is a mission-driven technology company specializing in Cloud, DevSecOps, Artificial Intelligence, and Digital Experience. We are a diverse team of innovators focused on creating open, scalable, and automated solutions that drive digital transformation in federal space. Our work culture fosters collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. Job Summary: We are seeking a Junior Software Developer to support the U.S. Coast Guard Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Cyber and Intelligence Service Center (C5ISC) under the COMPASS program. This role will support the development and sustainment of C5I-Home and VDS eStorefront, two Angular and Node.js web applications used to support Coast Guard operations and vessel documentation services. The successful candidate will work as part of an Agile sprint team to develop enhancements, resolve defects, perform unit testing, participate in code reviews, and support releases across development, test, staging, and production environments. This is a hands-on software development role focused on consistent sprint execution, secure coding, application sustainment, and effective collaboration with senior engineers, QA teams, and Government stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Develop, test, and maintain Angular front-end components and Node.js services for C5I-Home and VDS eStorefront. Implement sprint-committed user stories, enhancements, defects, and maintenance tickets in accordance with defined acceptance criteria. Support PostgreSQL data integrations and application interfaces with services such as and . Write clean, secure, maintainable, and documented code in accordance with program standards and OWASP secure coding guidance. Identify and remediate application vulnerabilities identified through CI/CD and security scanning processes. Write and maintain automated unit tests and support QA testing in development, test, and staging environments. Assist senior engineers with troubleshooting production incidents, application defects, and performance issues. Submit merge requests, participate in peer code reviews, and address review feedback. Support deployment and promotion of application builds through development, test, staging, and production environments. Ensure user-facing application functionality complies with Section 508 accessibility requirements. Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Maintain accurate work item status, estimates, implementation notes, and technical documentation. Support monthly application maintenance releases and Government demonstrations and user acceptance testing. Use Government-approved AI-assisted development tools to improve development productivity and code quality. Provide occasional after-hours support for application releases and production incidents as required. Required Qualifications: 1-3 years of professional experience developing web applications. Experience with Angular, React, Vue, or a similar modern front-end framework. Proficiency with TypeScript or JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS. Working knowledge of Node.js and developing or consuming RESTful APIs. Experience working with relational databases and writing SQL queries. Experience using Git-based version control and merge request or pull request-based code review workflows. Experience writing and maintaining unit tests. Familiarity with secure software development and secure coding principles. Experience working in an Agile or Scrum software development environment. Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills. Must be U.S. citizen. Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable DHS/U.S. Coast Guard suitability determination for a Moderate Risk Public Trust position (Tier 2 / SF-85P). Ability to support core working hours of 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. Ability to provide occasional after-hours support for production releases or incidents. No degree required; relevant professional experience may be accepted in place of formal education. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field. Hands-on experience with Angular and TypeScript, including component architecture, reactive forms, and RxJS. Experience with PostgreSQL. Experience with C#/.NET and Microsoft SQL Server. Experience integrating applications with , , or similar federal identity or payment services. Experience developing or supporting applications for federal, DoD, DHS, or U.S. Coast Guard customers. Experience with Jira, GitLab, Jenkins, or comparable Agile development and CI/CD tools. Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker or OpenShift. Experience supporting production applications in enterprise environments. CompTIA Security+ CE or another DoD 8570/8140-aligned IAT Level II certification. AWS Certified Developer - Associate or comparable cloud certification. Existing DHS or U.S. Coast Guard suitability determination or active federal background investigation. Benefits: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans (Healthcare benefits are 100% employer-paid for employees only) Life Insurance Paid Time Off (Flexible/Combined PTO, Bereavement Leave, 11 Company Paid Holidays) 401K Retirement Plan with employer match Professional Development Training Reimbursement

RF Power Application Intern Role Overview: The RF Power Application Intern will design, assemble, and test RF Power application circuits in support of our RF power amplifier product line. The intern will learn to utilize RF models and measured data to drive circuit level designs. This will include learning to utilize RF test equipment and test software to perform RF measurements, such as s-parameters and circuit level characterization. This role will also utilize AWR to model and analyze RF device performance. Additional activity will include designing PCB layouts, hands-on PCB assembly and soldering, data analysis, and updating datasheets to reflect new application board designs. During the internship, the applicant will learn: RF matching design techniques RF circuit board simulation and manufacturing AutoCAD mechanical design Hands-on RF Power circuit assembly and test Documentation suitable for sharing with customers. Requirements: College student working towards a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, or the equivalent. Must have an interest in one or more of the following: magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), radar, cellular telephone, satellites, avionics or in an industry relevant to radio frequency power Mechanical aptitude, should have experience working with small tools. Soldering experience is a plus along with experience building small electronic circuits.

Packaging Engineer Intern Job Description: The packaging engineering group of MACOM supports the design, development, and implementation of packaging solutions for RF semiconductor devices. Interns may assist in package design work and in creating / reviewing assembly drawings using CAD software. They may collect data directly or coordinate work with external labs, using metrology and failure analysis tools and techniques. They may help design experiments and analyze results using statistical techniques and process improvement methodology. Interns may also, depending on skill level, run thermal and mechanical simulations with FEA software packages to characterize new materials and device designs. Interns will periodically need to put together reports of work and present to other engineers and management.

This is a Co-Op position, working 40 hours per week, during a 1-3 semester duration and requires in-person interaction. This is not a “summer-only” role. Assist engineers with daily activities in R&D Interns will assist with new product introduction Interns will assist with Sustainability work of existing product line. Cost improvement projects Production assistance projects Field Quality projects Interns will assist lab testing and setting up of units. Assist in launch planning of a new product category Learn how to manage technical data per engineers’ request Assist with development of technical literature for field application. Assist in Regulatory and data analysis as needed Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering. Interest or experience in product design Basic knowledge of engineering principles (thermodynamics, statics, or electronics) Strong planning skills Good presentation skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Excellent analytical and computer skills (Excel, Power Point, Word)

role: Product Management Intern / Stagiaire en gestion de produit
description: DESCRIPTION DE COMPAGNIE Ludia est un studio de jeux mobiles innovant basé à Montréal, où la créativité rencontre le jeu. Avec plus de 3,5 millions de joueurs mensuels à travers le monde, notre portfolio combine des franchises mondiales emblématiques à des créations originales, dont Jurassic World™ Alive , Jurassic World™: The Game , Dragons: Rise of Berk , Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Legends , et bien plus encore. Next Gen est une initiative conçue pour soutenir la prochaine génération de talents et encourager l’apprentissage continu dans l’industrie du jeu mobile. Ludia est à un tournant excitant de son histoire, et nous recherchons des talents passionnés et ambitieux pour nous accompagner dans cette nouvelle aventure. DESCRIPTION DU STAGE En tant que Stagiaire en Gestion de Produit , tu seras plongé(e) dans notre cycle de production dès le premier jour. Tu apprendras comment nous équilibrons l’expérience joueur, les données et les objectifs commerciaux afin de créer des jeux à succès. Au cours de ce stage à temps plein d’une durée de 6 mois, tu passeras de l’apprentissage et de l’observation à la prise en charge et à l’amélioration de changements produit ayant un impact réel. C’est une opportunité idéale pour un esprit curieux, analytique et créatif désireux de percer dans le développement de jeux mobiles. Ce que Tu Vas Faire 📚 Phase 1 : Immersion (Semaines 1–2) Jouer à nos jeux dans différents environnements pour apprendre les mécaniques et le parcours joueur. Lire la documentation produit et analyser les tableaux de bord de données. Explorer les jeux concurrents et comprendre les benchmarks du marché. Rencontrer les membres des équipes transverses (Design, Ingénierie, QA, Communauté, etc.). 👀 Phase 2 : Observation (Semaines 3–4) Assister aux réunions produit et participer aux rétrospectives et à la planification des sprints. Observer un PM Senior dans son quotidien et suivre son processus décisionnel. Analyser les métriques et commencer à comprendre comment évaluer la performance d’une fonctionnalité. Rédiger tes premières user stories et rapports de bugs. 🏗️ Phase 3 : Contribution (Mois 2–8) Prendre la responsabilité complète de petites fonctionnalités ou d’améliorations UX/qualité de vie. Analyser les données gameplay et proposer des optimisations. Collaborer avec les équipes Design, QA et Développement pour mettre en œuvre les améliorations. Participer à la priorisation du backlog et réaliser des analyses concurrentielles ayant un impact direct sur la roadmap produit. 🧠 TON PROFIL Être actuellement inscrit(e) dans un programme de Baccalauréat ou de Maîtrise en Jeux Vidéos, Business, Data Analytics ou domaine connexe, incluant un stage obligatoire dans le cadre du cursus. Maîtrise avancée d’Excel (ex. tableaux croisés dynamiques, VLOOKUP, modélisation de données) fortement souhaitée. Fort intérêt pour les jeux mobiles et les modèles économiques free-to-play . Esprit analytique avec curiosité pour le comportement des joueurs et la stratégie produit. Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration. Connaissance de SQL ou d’outils de visualisation de données (ex. Tableau, Looker) est un atout majeur. Le bilinguisme (FR/EN) est un atout, mais non obligatoire. PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT Nous voulons garder notre processus simple, humain et te donner l’occasion de démontrer ta créativité et ta façon de travailler. Candidature → Appel avec le recrutement → Exercice créatif → Rencontre avec l’équipe → Sélection finale Les candidat(e)s sélectionné(e)s recevront un court exercice créatif à réaliser à la maison avant la rencontre avec l’équipe. La rencontre avec l’équipe aura lieu le 3 novembre, de 14 h à 16 h, dans nos bureaux de Montréal. Tu auras l’occasion de présenter ton travail, d’expliquer ton processus créatif, de recevoir du feedback et d’échanger avec les personnes avec qui tu pourrais travailler. ✨ POURQUOI LUDIA Mentorat pratique et impact réel sur des projets en cours. Culture inclusive avec une passion pour la croissance et l’échange créatif. Mode de travail hybride flexible depuis notre studio chaleureux de Montréal. Accès à des ressources d’apprentissage et des sessions de feedback régulières. Des opportunités d’évolution de carrière au-delà du stage. Nous valorisons et célébrons la diversité au sein de notre équipe, et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif où chacun peut prospérer et contribuer avec ses perspectives uniques. Nous encourageons les individus de tous horizons à postuler, et nous avons hâte de vous entendre ! COMPANY DESCRIPTION Ludia is a leading Montreal-based mobile gaming studio where creativity meets play. With more than 3.5 million monthly players around the world, our portfolio combines beloved global franchises with original creations, including Jurassic World™ Alive , Jurassic World™: The Game , Dragons: Rise of Berk , Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Legends , and more. Next Gen is an initiative designed to support the next generation of talent and foster continuous learning within the mobile gaming industry. Ludia is at an exciting turning point in its history, and we are looking for passionate and ambitious talent to join us on this new adventure. INTERNSHIP DESCRIPTION As a Product Management Intern , you’ll be immersed in our production cycle from day one, learning how we balance player experience, data, and business needs to build successful games. Over the course of this full time 6-month internship, you'll move from learning and shadowing to owning and improving product changes with real impact. This is an ideal opportunity for a curious, analytical, and creative thinker eager to break into mobile game development. Familiarity with SQL or data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) is a strong asset. Strong interest in mobile games and free-to-play business models Analytical mindset with curiosity about user behavior and product strategy Advanced proficiency in Excel (e.g., pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data modeling) is highly desirable. Excellent communication and collaboration skills Bilingualism (EN/FR) is a plus, but not required RECRUITMENT PROCESS We want to keep our process simple and human while giving you the opportunity to showcase your personality and how you work. The in-person session will take place on November 3, from 2:00–4:00 PM at our Montreal studio. You’ll have the opportunity to present your work, walk us through your creative process, receive feedback, and connect with the people you could be working with. ✨ WHY LUDIA Hands-on mentorship and real impact on live projects. role: Civil Engineering Assistant - Coop Student (Development Group)

We support some of the most important infrastructure in the province and beyond. We’re looking for professionals who want to build careers and communities that last. We can’t do it without you. THE PERKS: People come first. We support you with the education, mentoring, and growth opportunities you need to build an interesting career. As an employee-owned firm, we create a clear internal growth path that can keep up with even the most ambitious professionals. Whether it’s through our Employee Resources groups like Young Professionals and RISE; our mentoring programs, Binnie Banters speech club, Movember, or book club, everyone can get involved in their own way. Let us know why you want to work at Binnie, and why you would be a fit as our next Civil Engineering Assistant. Submit your application at the above link. Binnie embraces diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome any and all qualified applicants. role: Spring 2027 Liberty and National Security Legal Internship
description: The Brennan Center for Justice at NYU School of Law is a nonpartisan law and policy institute that seeks to improve the systems of democracy and justice in the United States. We work to hold our political institutions and laws accountable to the twin American ideals of democracy and equal justice for all. The Brennan Center’s work ranges from voting rights to campaign finance reform, from ending mass incarceration to preserving constitutional protections in national security policies. Part think tank, part advocacy group, part cutting-edge communications hub, we start with rigorous research. We craft innovative policies. And we fight for them — in Congress and the states, in the courts, and in the court of public opinion. The Brennan Center’s Liberty and National Security (LNS) Program fights to preserve constitutional values in the post-9/11 world. The LNS Program focuses on reining in the abuse of emergency powers by the executive branch and preventing excessive government secrecy. We work to protect fundamental freedoms while keeping Americans safe. That means protecting citizens’ privacy, updating privacy laws to account for new technologies, working to ensure that counterterrorism authorities are narrowly targeted to the terrorist threat, and securing adequate oversight and accountability mechanisms. Note: This internship is in-person at our Washington D.C. office. We seek law students to work alongside staff in our Washington DC office on the Brennan Center’s policy advocacy, research, and litigation initiatives. role: Run Performance Graduate Internship, Run Research Team - Winter 2027
description: **Who We Are:** At Brooks, we believe movement is the key to feeling more alive. That’s why we’re driven to create gear and experiences that take people to the place that makes them feel more alive — whether it’s a headspace, a feeling, or a finish line. Everyone who works at Brooks is propelled by a company culture that sparks excitement, fuels collaboration, inspires creativity, and ignites innovation. Our brand values help bond us together and drive our success: - ***Runner First*** - *We act in the best interest of the runner* - ***Word is Bond*** - *We do what we say we’ll do* - ***Champion Heart*** - *We give our all in everything we do* - ***There is no “I” in Run*** - *We stay generous with our humanity* - ***Keep Moving*** - *We find ways to move every day, because joy is kinetic!* We welcome everyone from every walk of life looking to inspire others through the power of movement - because we’re *all* moving towards something. Let’s run there. #### Brooks Internship Program Brooks Running hosts internships at our Seattle HQ offices to provide hands-on, meaningful work experience to further enhance your education and professional aptitude. Our interns gain exposure to real work, and projects while working side by side with Brooks employees and leadership. If chosen for this role, you will embark on 6 months of learning, professional development, and exposure to the Brooks brand and culture. #### Internship Details Duration: 6 months Internship Target Start: Jan 4, Jan 11, or Jan 18. Compensation: $ 33.00/hr. Location: Seattle, HQ Schedule: 40 hours / week Please apply if you can commit to the duration, salary, and location for this opportunity. #### Your Opportunity The mission of the Brooks Run Research Lab is to create and leverage novel, scientific concepts and runner-driven product performance insights to create amazing products to help everyone run their path. Our Run Research Lab is seeking a Master's graduate intern to work at our Seattle HQ offices. As a Run Research performance Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in product research at the leading running brand – Brooks Sports, Inc. Your primary responsibilities will be to assist in biomechanical data collection and processing for Run Research that will be used to inform product design, materials, and development. The protocols will include but are not limited to motion capture, material mechanical properties, and metabolic testing. This information is critical for our multi-departmental infrastructure, including Development, Design, and Merchandising, to ensure that the performance integrity of our product meets the needs of our end consumers. You will also gain knowledge on how the human movement influences the design and development of athletic products at Brooks. #### Your Impact (Responsibilities) - Understand athletic product design features and components and how they influence human movement. - Collection and processing of human subject data using Motion Analysis 3D motion capture. - Write code to analyze mechanical and biomechanical data in Python or Visual 3D. - Perform mechanical testing on material samples and full shoes (Instron). - Write scientific reports in PowerPoint and Microsoft Word. Summarize human movement and mechanical property findings for Brooks product and competitors that are delivered to product teams for use in product improvement. - Use your graduate-level research skills to conduct human movement studies that lead to innovative testing procedures and optimization of products for all who run. - Use your advanced data analytics skills to mine data in our historical dashboards to recommend product improvements based on identified opportunities. - Develop loyal, engaging relationships with our customers and the Brooks community. - Other duties as assigned #### Project: - As a part of your experience as a graduate intern at Brooks, you will have the opportunity to complete a project under the support and supervision of your manager. Details of your project will be finalized once you arrive at Brooks based on your skills and the needs of the business. You will use your ever-growing analytical skillset as a graduate student to prepare a thoughtful and elevated project. During the course of this project, you will weave your learnings from your graduate courses into your work to challenge yourself, and benefit Brooks. You will present your work and findings to senior leadership at Brooks at the end of your internship, to hone in on your research, recommendation, and presentation skills. ### Qualifications: - Master's degree with a background in biomechanics, kinesiology, and/or exercise science or an equivalent analytical field. - Willing to commit to the intern position for six months onsite in Seattle, WA - Willingness to learn and gain hands-on experience. - Able to commit to up to 40 hours a week to be physically present at HQ. - Strong verbal and written communication skills, demonstrating effective listening through concise, clear verbal and written communication. - Hands-on experience in a biomechanics lab or a lab that involved data collection on human subjects using 3D motion capture. - Hands-on experience with materials testing and familiarity with stress/strain testing protocols. - Well-developed quantitative skills with an aptitude for report-building, data mining, and interpretation. - Hands-on experience with writing code (Python [preferred], MATLAB, etc.) and creating kinematic and kinetic models for human motion capture (Visual 3D). - Experience with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. - Strong organizational skills. - Detail-oriented with an emphasis on quality work products. Always looking to improve our products and processes while also displaying a willingness to dive into the details and help wherever necessary. - Must be able to collaborate in a team-oriented environment. - Embrace Brooks values!

# About the role Summer internships will range between the months of May and September depending on university schedules. Internship is full-time and on-site in San Jose, California. The Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) team at Muon is responsible for validating spacecraft hardware through unit acceptance testing as well as spacecraft-level integration and environmental testing. As an Environmental Test Engineering Intern, you will support the planning, setup, execution, and analysis of environmental tests used to validate spacecraft hardware against the extreme conditions of launch and space. You will work alongside experienced environmental test engineers, test engineers, and technicians to prepare hardware and test equipment, develop and execute test procedures, collect and analyze test data, and troubleshoot test issues. This is a hands-on opportunity to gain experience with spacecraft environmental testing and see your work directly contribute to the successful integration and launch of Muon spacecraft. Muon is a small and fast growing startup which offers interns the experience to get direct mentorship and have real impact on our programs. As an intern, you'll collaborate with a dynamic team in a startup environment and have the chance to learn from some of the most accomplished and experienced aerospace professionals in the industry. We're committed to offering an experience where your decisions and contributions play a pivotal role in driving Muon's success. ## Responsibilities - Assist environmental test engineers with the planning, preparation, and execution of spacecraft and subsystem environmental testing, including thermal vacuum, vibration, acoustic, and other qualification or acceptance testing. - Support test setup and instrumentation, including thermocouples, accelerometers, pressure sensors, and other test measurement equipment. - Assist with preparing spacecraft hardware, fixtures, ground support equipment, and test configurations for environmental test campaigns. - Execute functional checkouts and test procedures under engineer supervision before, during, and after environmental testing. - Monitor test operations and hardware performance, identify anomalies, and support troubleshooting and root-cause investigations. - Collect, process, and perform preliminary analysis of environmental test data to verify hardware performance and test requirements. - Support development and improvement of test procedures, test processes, checklists, and laboratory workflows. - **About Sezzle:** With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! **About the Role:** We are seeking a curious, driven, and detail-oriented **Product Operations Intern** to join our Rewards team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. Rewards is where Sezzle turns everyday shopping into value for our customers. Through the Earn experience in the Sezzle app, shoppers earn Sezzle Points by scanning receipts, completing offers, and engaging with our partners. Receipt scanning is one of our newest and fastest-growing earning features, and you'll be one of the people closest to it. You'll see how it works in the real world, find where it breaks, and help decide what gets fixed first. This is an operations role with a strong product lens. You'll work with the product manager, engineering, design, and data teams to make sure the receipt scanning experience is accurate, fair, and hard to abuse. Your work will feed directly into what the team builds next. If you like finding patterns in messy real-world data and turning them into clear recommendations, this role is for you. **What You'll Do:** **Receipt Quality & Validation Operations** - Own the day-to-day quality of receipt scanning submissions. Review submissions against validation rules, make approve/reject decisions, and apply them consistently. - Spot edge cases the current system misses, such as unusual receipt formats, retailer-specific quirks, duplicates, and signs of abuse. Document them clearly so the team can handle them at scale. **Product Feedback & Prioritization** - Turn what you see in submissions into actionable feedback for engineering: clear bug reports, reproducible examples, and suggested improvements to extraction and validation logic. - Keep a prioritized list of what needs improvement and why. Rank it by customer impact, fraud risk, and operational cost, and help the product manager bring it into planning. - Track fixes through the backlog. Follow up on status, confirm improvements work once shipped, and flag regressions. **Documentation & Process Improvement** - Write and maintain clear review guidelines, decision criteria, and escalation paths so decisions stay consistent as the program scales. - Find parts of the review workflow that can be automated, simplified, or removed. Help shape the internal tools the team uses. **What We Look For:** - Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience - A genuine interest in consumer fintech, rewards and loyalty programs, or how products run at scale behind the scenes - Strong attention to detail: you notice when something's off, and you care about getting it right every time, not just most of the time - A structured, logical mindset: you enjoy finding the pattern behind individual cases and turning it into a rule, a fix, or a recommendation - Effective written and verbal communication: you can write a bug report an engineer can act on right away, and summarize a trend clearly for a non-technical audience - Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to operations, product, fintech, data analysis, trust & safety, or startups is a plus. We hire for potential, not just pedigree. - Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. **About You:** - You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. - You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things. - You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. - You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. - You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. - You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. **What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:** At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. **Compensation**: The salary for the Product Operations Intern is $800 USD monthly as an independent contractor. #Li-remote #Full-time

## What we’re building The marine industry supports recreation, global commerce, and national defense. And yet it runs on technology that hasn't meaningfully changed in fifty years. Until now. Arc is on a mission to electrify the marine industry. We're rethinking powertrains, software, and vessel designs from first principles. And we're already executing. We started with consumers to develop and harden our core technology. We’re now scaling production of our flagship model with new models and sectors on the horizon. Now we’re extending our platform to commercial applications, starting with tugs, ferries, and defense, with years worth of signed contracts and a pipeline that spans every vessel type on the water. The technology is proven, the momentum is building, and the opportunity is enormous. The marine industry is going electric and Arc is building the platform that powers it ## Who we’re looking for We’re looking for someone who’s fired up by our mission and ready to build. You’ll thrive here if you adapt quickly, take ownership, and care about the details. You will join our Software Engineering team as a summer intern from June 14th-August 20th 2027. You will work from our headquarters in Torrance, CA. Given that we’re a startup, you will be working in a fast-moving, dynamic environment that requires adaptability. That said, here are some responsibilities and qualifications we expect to stay relatively constant for this role. ## What You'll Do - Contributing to the boat infotainment unit, mobile app, backend, or boat firmware - Owning a project end-to-end that meaningfully drives the business forward - Collaborating with members of the software team as well as other stakeholders ## Minimum Qualifications - Familiarity with at least one general purpose programming language - Strong software development fundamentals - Productive with standard software development tools (an IDE, git, the command line, etc.) - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. - Eagerness to learn and adapt in a dynamic setting. - Ability to effectively communicate progress and status of your work ## Bonus Qualifications - Current enrollment in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Computer Science, or a related field - Experience with one of: - Frontend or mobile development - Backend development using Python or Typescript and AWS - Firmware development using STM32 microcontrollers - A track record of successful internships - Comfortable pushing at a fast but sustainable pace - Enthusiasm for boating and clean energy At Arc, we encourage diversity and consider all qualified applicants equally for employment, regardless of background, identity, or status. You’re always welcome to reach out even if you don’t meet many of these qualifications. Passion and aptitude make up for a lot. ## What we offer The base pay for this role is $42 per hour. Additionally, Arc offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: - **Boat days** – Yes, we actually go out on the water. A lot. - **Retirement savings** — Traditional and Roth 401(k) access - **Safety support** — Reimbursement for PPE, ergonomic equipment, and anything that ensures we keep our crew safe - **Relocation Assistance** - **Mentorship Opportunities** - **Office perks** — Daily lunches, snacks, and good coffee while onsite ## Our values We move with urgency and build with care. We value these five things above all else: - **Ownership** over both your work and the company’s success - **Empathy** for colleagues and for customers - **Humility** in problem solving and collaboration - **Pragmatism** for navigating ambiguity quickly and sensibly - **Inclusion** of different backgrounds, opinions, cultures, and perspectives. We want people who share and embody these values. It is vital that our values align - we’d be happy to elaborate on any or all of these during the interview process. Hope to hear from you soon! The Crew at Arc

role: 2027 Internship Behavior ML Engineer, Learned Manipulation Policies
description: ## Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs. In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks. This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us. ## **About the Role & Team** Teaching a 40-ton excavator to move like an expert operator is a very different problem from teaching a car to stay in its lane. The motions are multimodal, there are many good ways to swing, dig, and dump and the consequences of getting them wrong are measured in cubic yards and bent steel. Bedrock's Behavior ML team builds the learned policies that decide what our machines actually do, and diffusion policies are a central bet: models that can represent the full distribution of expert behavior instead of averaging it into mush. As our Behavior ML intern, you'll help train those policies and build the evaluation that tells us whether they're genuinely better working alongside two hosts who sit on both the training and evaluation sides of the problem. ## **What You'll Do** - Train and iterate on diffusion flow matching, and related behavior policies using real fleet demonstration data and simulated rollouts - Run architecture, conditioning, and hyperparameter explorations, and turn the results into clear findings the team can build on - Build and improve evaluation pipelines that score behavior models on task success, smoothness, safety margins, and operator-likeness - Investigate failure modes - distribution shift, mode collapse, out-of-distribution scenes and propose fixes - Work with the simulation and eval teams to make sure offline metrics actually predict on-machine performance - Contribute to the shared training codebase with clean, reviewed, reproducible work - Share results regularly with the behavior, controls, and autonomy teams ## **What We're Looking For** ### **Required** - Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in computer science, robotics, machine learning, or a related field or bringing equivalent research or industry experience - Strong Python and hands-on experience training models in PyTorch (or equivalent) - Working understanding of generative modeling diffusion models, flow matching, VAEs, or similar and of imitation learning or behavior cloning - Experience running and interpreting real training experiments: you know how to tell a real improvement from noise - Clear communication, you can explain what you tried, what happened, and what you'd do next ### **Preferred** - Published work or substantial project experience in diffusion, flow matching, robot learning, or imitation learning - Experience training and building Vision Language Action (VLA) models - Experience training Reinforcement Learning (RL) policies for robot manipulation - Experience evaluating policies in simulation and reasoning about the sim-to-real gap - Familiarity with large-scale training infrastructure and experiment tracking tooling - Exposure to robotics, autonomous vehicles, or other physical-world control problems - Interest in construction, earthwork, or heavy equipment - no prior experience required **About This Internship** This is a **fixed-term, project-based internship** designed strictly for **students (undergraduate or graduate) seeking resume-building experience, hands-on skill development, or industry exposure** rather than a direct career launchpad. Candidates will own discrete, short-term projects that can be fully completed within the internship timeframe. Please note that while exceptional interns may occasionally be considered if business needs align, **opportunities for full-time conversion are highly limited**." **Bedrock Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer** We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. **Reasonable Accommodations** We want our hiring process to be accessible to everyone. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you.

description: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. Hourly PhD Pay $85—$85 USD

Groei mee met Strict in vitale sectoren Digitale technologie is in vitale sectoren cruciaal. Als ICT of operationele technologie (OT) uitvalt, raakt dat direct de zorg, veiligheid, mobiliteit of energievoorziening. Strict werkt voor organisaties waar continuïteit, veiligheid en digitale weerbaarheid centraal staan. Denk aan zorgorganisaties, vervoerders, energiebedrijven en organisaties binnen openbare orde en veiligheid, zoals defensie en justitie. We willen onze positie in deze markten verder uitbouwen. Daarom zoeken we een junior business developer die commercieel nieuwsgierig is, kansen leert herkennen en zich wil ontwikkelen in new business binnen complexe IT omgevingen. Dit ga je doen Als junior business developer leer je hoe je nieuwe klantrelaties opbouwt binnen vitale sectoren. Je onderzoekt waar kansen liggen, brengt potentiële klanten in kaart en legt actief nieuwe contacten. Je leert steeds beter begrijpen wat er bij organisaties speelt. Hoe toekomstbestendig is hun digitale infrastructuur? Welke keuzes maken zij rond cloud, cybersecurity en digitale autonomie? En wat betekenen ontwikkelingen zoals de Europese NIS2 richtlijn voor hun organisatie? Samen met ervaren commerciële collega’s en consultants leer je deze vraagstukken te vertalen naar commerciële kansen en passende dienstverlening. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: potentiële klanten en commerciële kansen in kaart brengen; actief contact leggen met nieuwe organisaties; klantgesprekken voorbereiden, opvolgen en steeds vaker zelf voeren; marktontwikkelingen en klantvragen signaleren; klantvragen verbinden aan de juiste expertise binnen Strict; meewerken aan voorstellen, proposities en commerciële trajecten. Naarmate je groeit, krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen klantcontact, pipeline en commerciële trajecten. Je krijgt daarbij begeleiding van de commercieel leidinggevende en ervaren collega’s. Over Strict Strict helpt organisaties bij complexe vraagstukken op het snijvlak van technologie, organisatie en verandering. We werken voor organisaties binnen vitale sectoren waar ICT en OT betrouwbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig moeten zijn. Business development en consultancy komen bij Strict samen. Je werkt nauw samen met business developers, accountmanagers, consultants en principals. Zo leer je hoe je van een eerste commerciële kans komt tot een inhoudelijk voorstel dat aansluit bij het vraagstuk van de klant. Dat doen we vanuit verschillende expertises: Enterprise Agility Verandermanagement Cloud & Security Missie en bedrijfskritische communicatietechnologie Privacy, Governance, Risk & Control Dit breng je mee Je bent commercieel nieuwsgierig, ondernemend en vindt het leuk om nieuwe mensen en organisaties te leren kennen. Je hoeft nog geen groot netwerk of jarenlange ervaring mee te brengen. Wel wil je leren hoe je kansen herkent en ontwikkelt. Daarnaast: heb je maximaal circa twee jaar relevante commerciële ervaring, bijvoorbeeld in B2B sales, business development, recruitment of accountmanagement; krijg je energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het opbouwen van relaties; ben je nieuwsgierig naar IT, digitalisering en de vraagstukken van onze klanten; communiceer je gemakkelijk met verschillende gesprekspartners en durf je initiatief te nemen; werk je graag samen en sta je open voor feedback en begeleiding. Ervaring met IT dienstverlening, consultancy of aanbestedingen is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Dit krijg je van ons Bij Strict krijg je de ruimte om business development in de praktijk te leren en jezelf snel te ontwikkelen. Je werkt samen met ervaren commerciële en inhoudelijke collega’s en krijgt steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid naarmate je groeit. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op: een vast salaris tussen €3.000 en €3.400 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring; een variabele beloning op basis van individuele- en teamdoelstellingen; een functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; hybride werken vanuit huis, ons kantoor in Utrecht en bij de klant; een leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget; een pensioenregeling en 8% vakantiegeld; een laptop en telefoon. Groei mee met Strict Wil jij je ontwikkelen in business development en werken aan commerciële vraagstukken binnen sectoren waar technologie direct maatschappelijke impact heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.
