## **Health can’t wait**. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the **new standard in prevention insurance.** Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a **global leading company, with a** [**unique culture**](https://alan.com/en/careers). We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. As we continue to build our Sales team locally, we are looking for several **‘full-stack’ Sales.** You can call it Sales, Business development... What is important for us is the **mission: help companies transition to a more personal, proactive and holistic health partner.** At Alan, Sales drive deals, **manage key customer relationships and help close strategic opportunities with prospects**. You are directly responsible for educating prospects, providing inspiring product demonstrations, and onboarding companies’ key stakeholders as you make the transition from prospect to customer. At the same time, we expect you to **understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method**. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft). We also expect you to look at the big picture and **help us grow and improve as a company.** For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base. ## ⭐ Sales Team at Alan ⭐ Since we opened our Belgium market in 2020, we have experienced great momentum and traction. We’ve onboarded 1200+ companies, and delighted 90.000+ members so far. Our local team is growing (so far we went from 0 to 70+ in just over 5 years 🚀). We now want to take the market by storm and exponentially grow the business to ultimately become the market leader by 2030 in Belgium. Our sales team is the engine that drives our B to B customer reach. We want to keep that bar very high by hiring the most exceptional Sales! Being a Sales at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate sales experts. We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems! **Do you want to get a glimpse of the team? ⬇️** Watch Titouan's video to hear his testimonial**.** ## ⭐️ Your mission ⭐️ We are looking for Business Development Representatives to help our Sales team sign more customers and help Alan become the number 1 insurer in Europe. 🚀 You will work closely with a team of Account Executives in generating new business by qualifying leads, prospecting and generating meetings with the right stakeholders of top high-growth companies ! We are already taking care of Beobank, AS Adventure, Delaware, Vandemoortele, Airbnb, Pluxee, Easi, Cowboy and +1200 other exciting customers. Many more are in pipe! Being a Business Development Representative is really the **fast-track to learning the ins and outs of sales**. Working in duo with our Account Executives is a real opportunity to learn from the best. **You will be responsible for:** - **Generating meetings with prospects to achieve our company objectives**: by putting a strong focus on prioritisation and a high level of outreach personalisation to land our weekly targets. - Develop **outbound sales leads** and respond to product inquiries, run email campaigns to generate new sales prospects & complete accurate tracking of communication with current and potential customers in our CRM. - Realise a **quick lead qualification** before allocating the leads to an Account Executive. - **Represent our company’s products:** starting with a deep and comprehensive understanding and following with consumer research to identify how our solutions meet needs. - **Understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method:** This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. Increasingly also take ownership of engaging with clients and **closing deals** ## ⭐ Your profile ⭐ **You will be a good fit to join the Sales team at Alan if you:** - You’re passionate about sales. - Having an experience already in Sales / Sales Development Representative roles, or customer-facing role (Sales, Management consulting, Customer Success) is a plus - Are fluent in **English and Dutch** - Are highly organised with exceptional follow-up skills - Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems - Are able to manage influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus building - Have strong empathy for customers and passion for revenue and growth - Deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models - A great attitude and ability to collaborate in a team. Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences and backgrounds in our team. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A1-B1 [level range](https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity). # 🙌 [Perks & Benefits](https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity) At Alan, we believe that **being in good health is a basic need,** and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are **happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time** with co-workers. **Therefore, we offer:** - **Fair rewards**. technique/graphique sera étudiée Compétences techniques & graphiques Maîtrise de la suite Adobe : Photoshop indispensable Bonnes bases en préparation de fichiers image : formats, résolution, colorimétrie, poids et export web Aisance avec les consignes de lettrage et de retouche appliqués à la bande dessinée numérique Sens du détail graphique : respect des chartes, cohérence visuelle d'une série à l'autre Outils & production éditoriale Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et collaboratifs : Excel / Google Sheets, Notion, Trello Compréhension d'une chaîne de production éditoriale et de ses calendriers de publication Capacité à traiter un volume important de fichiers avec méthode et régularité Soft Skills Rigueur et sens du détail : la qualité de ce qui est publié dépend directement de ce contrôle Organisation et gestion des priorités dans un environnement à publication quotidienne Respect des délais : les calendriers de parution ne se décalent pas Bon relationnel et esprit d'équipe : coordination avec les équipes éditoriale, technique et marketing Autonomie et proactivité dans le suivi des tâches récurrentes et l'alerte en cas d'anomalie Intérêt pour la culture webtoon, manga ou l'industrie créative numérique indispensable Langues Français courant (obligatoire) Anglais professionnel apprécié (échanges avec des partenaires internationaux) La connaissance du coréen est un plus Convention de stage nécessaire CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Une immersion au cœur d'une plateforme numérique dans l’univers entertainment/pop culture Un environnement de travail stimulant au sein du grand groupe d’édition Une expérience transversale couvrant comptabilité, gestion éditoriale et coordination internationale Accès au restaurant d’entreprise Prise en charge du titre de transport Navigo à 75% Lancée en 2023, ONO est la première plateforme française dédiée à la lecture de webtoons et de mangas en ligne, et la seule à proposer à la fois le meilleur des séries asiatiques et des créations originales françaises, au plus près des tendances et des attentes des lecteurs. Portée par le groupe Média-Participations, leader sur le marché BD/Manga en Europe et maison- mère de Dargaud, Dupuis, Le Lombard, Kana et Vega, ONO bénéficie de l'ancrage et de l'expertise d'un des plus grands groupes d'édition français. La plateforme propose un catalogue varié de plus de 550 séries coréennes, japonaises et françaises, accessibles en achat de coins et sans publicité sur mobile et web. Avec de nouveaux épisodes chaque jour, une présence en France comme en Afrique (notamment en Côte d'Ivoire et Cameroun) et des partenariats stratégiques avec des studios coréens et chinois de référence, ONO s'impose comme un acteur incontournable du marché francophone du webtoon. Équipe agile d'une quinzaine de personnes, ONO s'inscrit dans une dynamique avec l'ambition de prendre une place majeure sur ce marché. Elle recherche des talents motivés pour accompagner son développement éditorial, financier et commercial.

role: Local Rotational Security Officer - Maniilaq Clinics ($30/hr, On Call, 1 Week On/1 Week Off) - Point Hope, AK
description: Job Description The Security Officer provides security for NANA Management Services at an assigned unit or location wherein health, safety and security is the #1 priority. This assignment is at the Maniilaq Village Health Clinics and surrounding areas with corresponding levels of traffic (employees, visitors, customers, etc.). This position will be a 1 week on, 1 week off rotational position, local to the NANA Village posted or this position may require on-call work outside of normal business hours. This position requires a ten consecutive day training program that will be held in Kotzebue, AK. Lodging and transportation for this training, to and from Kotzebue, will be provided for new hires. Responsibilities Personally, monitors either visually, electronically, or audibly a variety of assigned areas, or grounds by working in a variety of assignments including but not limited to roving inside the facilities, roving in a vehicle, other locations deemed appropriate. Ensures own actions and those of others observe maximum level of safety and compliance. Will verbally de-escalate situations to ensure the safety of fellow employees, customers, and clients. Examines doors, windows, and other areas of the store to determine they are secure. Reports and records data such as property damage, unusual occurrences, etc. in accordance with company policies and procedures. Assists in setting up for events, moving furniture and displays and preparing the clinic for various functions. Warns violators of rule infractions and may apprehend or expel violators. Notifies on site individuals of visitors wishing to see them. Assists in properly responding to a variety of emergencies or disasters in order to preserve life and property, including but not limited to fire safety, active shooter protocol May perform routine input or monitoring of safety and life support computer programs. May issue and record ID badges. May check heating, lighting, sprinkling, security, ventilation, fire, etc., systems to make sure they are operational. May also be combined with other position duties. You might spend your morning analysing MHE performance data and developing visualisations to help teams monitor equipment metrics, then spend your afternoon on the warehouse floor supporting the installation and commissioning of new automation equipment. Amazon's fulfilment network relies on cutting-edge technology — from robotics and high-speed sortation to conveyance systems and robotic work cells. No matter which team you join, whether it's Project Management, Reliability Maintenance Engineering, Controls, or Infrastructure, part of your role will involve solving complex engineering challenges. Learning Sessions: Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career. Opportunities: Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. Anduril’s Manufacturing team is seeking an Industrial Engineer to join our team. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, sensors, undersea, and flight vehicles. As an Industrial Engineer, you will have responsibility for optimizing Anduril’s manufacturing operations for best-in-class quality, reliability, speed, and asset utilization, all while meeting critical customer deployment and internal development timelines. The Industrial Engineer will be instrumental in taking a data-driven approach to designing production lines and associated manufacturing processes to meet these objectives. Executing on this responsibility will entail active collaboration with other Anduril teams, including but not limited to Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, and Business Operations. The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** - Own the metrics, KPIs, and reporting associated with monitoring production line health and efficiency, such as cycle time, throughput rate, capacity, utilization, first pass yield, cycle time, and all Quality metrics - Produce and maintain tools and reports to communicate the health of manufacturing operations across products both to Manufacturing leads and across the organization - Own the design of new production lines and work station layouts, both for low rate and full-rate production, leveraging a data-driven approach using tools such as Value Stream Mapping/ Process Mapping/ Line Balancing techniques - Proactively identify imbalances and bottlenecks caused by line layout, parts shortages, staffing shortages, and other production constraints; flag constraints with the appropriate owners across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, and Quality and drive to resolution - Own the reporting and analysis of manufacturing health and ensure that stakeholders have the inputs they need to make decisions across Engineering (cut-in dates for new designs), Supply Chain (signals on what to buy), Manufacturing (signals on being clear-to-build and what to build), and Growth (supply overview to drive customer contracts) **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Must be pursuing or have recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. - Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program. - Able to start full time in 2027. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Past experience in a high-rate manufacturing environment in either a production or supply chain-type role where complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies were built with heavy data utilization - Factory design and set up - Value Stream mapping, Flow lines, continuous flow, one piece flow, workstation design - Material Flow - designing how material flow around a facility, pull systems, Kanban, Min/ max calculations, Part presentation to operator, Tote bin packaging, lineside racking. - Digital Systems - experience of using Siemens "Plant Simulation", "Process Simulation" software to model a production line and run production scenarios. - Demonstrated ability to completely own a value chain from start to finish, coordinating among multiple different internal and external parties to achieve on-time deliveries under stringent quality standards - Prior knowledge and interaction with a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for production operations - Prior knowledge of NetSuite or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system - Experience with Lean Manufacturing principles/implementation - Subject matter expert in material flow systems - Ability to demonstrate a willingness to take on substantial responsibility across manufacturing, engineering, and operations functions with a bias towards speed and accuracy - Strong technical ability to read technical documentation such as drawings and CAD data, understanding of a variety of hardware manufacturing processes for both electronics (PCBAs, sensor hardware, etc.) and structures, mechanical components, and electromechanical systems - Experience interacting with SQL databases - storage of information and building custom queries for tracking production and inventory-related metrics - Experience with production simulation software (Siemens/PlantSim/ProcessSim) US Salary Range $74,000—$99,000 USD The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Responsibilities include tracking and analyzing policy proposals and budget data, and contributing to issue briefs and other content for NTUF's website. **This role is open to remote or onsite candidates.** **Qualified candidates must submit a cover letter detailing their interest in the position and NTUF’s mission. role: Group Product Manager, On & Off Campus
description: **About StarRez** StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Strong commercial and product judgment, with experience connecting product decisions to measurable customer and business outcomes. - Experience using customer research, market insights, product analytics, and experimentation to inform product strategy and investment decisions. - Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and align cross-functional teams around complex priorities and trade-offs. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create clarity in ambiguous and evolving environments. **Preferred Qualifications** - Experience with B2B2C, marketplace, SaaS, or other multi-sided product environments. - Experience with marketplace growth, monetization, pricing, packaging, or product-led growth. - Experience working in or with higher education institutions and/or accommodation providers. - Experience leading globally distributed Product and Engineering teams. - Experience applying AI or emerging technologies to customer or product opportunities. **Reasons to join our Team:** - Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years - Full benefits including health care, paid time off, life insurance, and 401k plan with company match for eligible team members - A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities - Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions - Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement *Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!* *We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.* ***Notice to external Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies:*** *StarRez will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, headhunters, or any other third parties for this role through this website or directly to any employee. In addition, we ask that you do not reach out to any employee with regards to this position, or any other positions, now, or in the future.* US - Salary Range $144,000—$180,000 USD StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

role: Forward Deployed Agent Engineer, Early Career

You'll own projects end-to-end: from initial implementation and data onboarding, to deploying in production, to integrating feedback into our core agent platform. Your work will directly shape how our agents detect threats, triage incidents, and automate security workflows for enterprise organizations. This role is built for engineers who thrive in high-impact environments, want to see the tangible results of their work in the field, and are ready to operate with autonomy from the start. ## What You'll Do - **Design & Deploy AI Agents** - build security-focused AI agents that reason over large datasets, interact with security systems, and handle complex real-world workflows - **Own Implementations End-to-End** - lead technical delivery for customers, from data ingestion and transformation pipelines to configuration, workflow design, and feature extension - **Integrate the Latest Models at Scale** - experiment with, evaluate, and ship text, voice, and multi-modal models into production environments - **Adapt to Diverse Environments** - work directly with customer security teams to integrate our agents with their tools, processes, and data sources - **Drive Platform Evolution** - identify cross-customer trends and translate field insights into platform improvements and new capabilities - **Solve Complex Technical Problems** - debug deep in the stack, investigate edge cases, and ensure our agents meet enterprise-grade reliability and performance standards ## What We're Looking For - Graduating December 2026 or Spring 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field - Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Python, Go, TypeScript, Java, or similar) - Strong software fundamentals - you've built and shipped real projects (coursework, internships, or personal) and can debug what breaks, with or without AI tooling - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and non-technical contexts - Thrive in ambiguity, take ownership end-to-end, and prioritize customer outcomes over output ## Bonus Points - Internship or project experience in customer-facing, forward-deployed, or consulting engineering roles - Exposure to early-stage startups where scope was ambiguous and you operated across functions - Familiarity with multi-modal AI models, enterprise SaaS, security operations, or large-scale data pipelines # For California Based Applicants The standard base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $160,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time. ## **About the Role** We’re looking for a highly motivated, intellectually curious, mission-driven software engineer to join our Markets team. As an intern, you’ll work on high-impact problems critical to Base’s success and deliver solutions alongside full-time team members. ## **What You'll Do** Algorithms & Optimization: At Base, we operate distributed energy resources that trade in real-time electricity and ancillary service markets. You’ll help design and implement sequential decision algorithms that determine when and how to trade. role: Stage - Data Protection : concevoir les formations de demain
description: Contexte À l'heure où les données constituent l'un des actifs les plus stratégiques des organisations, leur protection est devenue un enjeu majeur. Multiplication des réglementations, exigences de confidentialité, classification de l'information, risques de fuite de données ou encore adoption de nouveaux usages liés à l'IA : les collaborateurs doivent être sensibilisés et accompagnés pour adopter les bons réflexes au quotidien. Dans ce contexte, Wavestone souhaite renforcer sa culture Data Protection au travers d'un parcours de formation moderne, engageant et concret, combinant apports théoriques, cas pratiques et démonstrations d'outils. Vos missions Au sein de notre équipe Cybersécurité, vous participerez à : Réaliser un état de l'art des enjeux actuels de protection des données et des bonnes pratiques du marché ; Structurer un parcours pédagogique permettant d'acculturer les collaborateurs aux enjeux de Data Protection ; Construire des contenus de formation sur les principaux concepts : confidentialité, classification des données, fuite de données, privacy, réglementations et labels ; Formaliser les convictions et retours d'expérience de Wavestone sur ces sujets ; Concevoir des ateliers interactifs, mises en situation et cas pratiques favorisant l'engagement des participants ; Valoriser les fonctionnalités des outils Microsoft contribuant à la protection de la donnée (M365, Purview, classification, protection de l'information, etc.) ; Développer des supports innovants et accessibles à différents publics ; Évaluer l'efficacité des contenus et proposer des pistes d'amélioration continue. Ce que vous allez apprendre Les enjeux stratégiques de la protection des données dans les grandes organisations ; Les principaux cadres réglementaires et standards du marché ; Les méthodes de conception pédagogique et d'acculturation des collaborateurs ; Les solutions Microsoft dédiées à la gouvernance et à la protection de l'information ; Les approches de change management appliquées aux sujets de cybersécurité et de conformité. Diplômé(e) ou futur(e) diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieurs, de commerce ou d’une université, vous disposez d’une formation solide et/ou d’un intérêt marqué pour les enjeux technologiques et de cybersécurité. Nous recherchons avant tout des profils curieux, structurés et dotés d’une forte capacité d’analyse, capables d’intervenir sur des problématiques complexes et d’échanger aussi bien avec des interlocuteurs métiers que techniques. L’intitulé et le cadrage exact du sujet de stage ou du travail à effectuer seront confirmés en début de stage. Tous nos stages de fin d'études s'inscrivent dans une logique de pré-embauche. Wavestone est un employeur inclusif qui s'engage pour l'égalité des chances. Dans le cadre de cette politique de diversité et inclusion, Wavestone accompagne les personnes en situation de handicap et/ou nécessitant un aménagement durant leur process de recrutement et lors de leur prise de poste. Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques. Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif. Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain.

## **About Base** Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time. ## **About the Role** At Base, we're building America's next-generation power company. Firmware is the layer where our software meets the hardware sitting on real homes, making millisecond-level decisions that keep the fleet stable, balance the grid, protect the hardware, and keep the lights on when things go wrong. As a firmware engineering intern, you won't just observe how these systems work. You'll help build them. You'll contribute to the low-level software running on our batteries and inverters, get hands-on experience with embedded systems, and ship code that affects real members and real power flows. This is one of the few places where the code you write moves electrons through actual hardware on the live grid. Reliability and precision aren't abstract here. They show up in whether someone's lights stay on. **What You'll Do** - **Build core firmware.** Design, implement, and test firmware in C/C++ on bare-metal, RTOS, and embedded Linux systems running across our fleet. - **Work close to the hardware.** Develop and debug device drivers, communication interfaces, and low-level system behavior. Read schematics, interpret datasheets, and learn how software interacts with real circuits, sensors, and power electronics. - **Contribute to fleet-critical systems.** Help build the pieces that keep thousands of homes running, high-rate telemetry, automated fault detection and response, reliable communications on unreliable networks, fast commissioning, and grid-balancing control loops. - **Ship under real-world constraints.** Write code that has to be reliable, deterministic, and safe. Timing matters. Failures have physical consequences. Simplicity is usually the right answer. - **Work across domains.** Collaborate with hardware, power electronics, and platform software engineers to solve integration problems and deliver robust end-to-end behavior. **What You'll Bring** - Solid understanding of C/C++, embedded systems concepts, and basic computer architecture. - Experience from coursework, side projects, or prior internships involving microcontrollers, RTOS, sensor integration, robotics, power electronics, or other embedded systems. - Interest in how real systems behave. Timing diagrams, interrupts, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debugging actual hardware. - Clear, concise communicator who thrives in fast-paced, collaborative environments. - Builder's mindset. Curious, self-directed, and drawn to problems that actually matter. **Why Base?** Interns at Base work in the same codebases as full-time engineers. No toy projects. You'll learn from a team that's built and scaled complex systems across energy, aerospace, and hardware industries. Your code will go live, run on real batteries in real homes, and shape how Base enters new markets. This isn't a typical internship. It's a chance to help rebuild the most important system in America. **Come build with us.** **About the Team** America's power grid is failing—electricity costs have risen even as generation gets cheaper, and blackouts are becoming more common. We're building the software that fixes it. Our team owns the entire stack: firmware that controls batteries in thousands of homes, trading algorithms that buy and sell power in real-time markets, distributed commanding systems that orchestrate a growing fleet as a single grid asset, factory software for our Austin manufacturing line, and the product experience that makes it all invisible to homeowners. If you want to write code that physically moves electrons, ships hardware, and reshapes critical infrastructure, this is the job. *Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.* ## **Our Values** - **First Principles Thinking:** Question assumptions. Principles > rules. - **Operate at Base Pace:** Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing. - **Give & Get Feedback:** Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset. - **Everyone’s an Owner:** Follow through on commitments and own results. - **Strong Opinions, Loosely Held:** Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information. - **Committed to the Mission:** Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in. - **Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit:** Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things. ## **Do the best work of your life at Base.**

# ABOUT CYVL The best infrastructure is invisible. You only notice it when it fails. For decades, the people responsible for our roads, bridges and sidewalks have been asked to manage the physical world with tools that can't see it. Cyvl is the Physical AI company changing that. We build purpose-built sensors, computer vision and AI that turn every drive into current data: what exists, where it is and what condition it's in. 500+ cities and towns use our Infrastructure Intelligence Platform to direct the work and fix problems before they fail. 1 in 30 Americans drive on roads managed with Cyvl data. Real streets. Your name on it.** - **Hard problems in the real world.** You build end-to-end: our own hardware, software and AI, with work that shows up on the street in the real world. - **Ownership that compounds.** You own outcomes, not tasks. role: 2027 Summer Intern, PhD, Safety Research, Human Behavior Analytics
description: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states. The Human Behavior Analytics (HBA) team, part of the Waymo Safety team, conducts research and development on computational road user behavior models and other methods and tools used for evaluating the behavior and safety of the Waymo Driver. This work typically exists at the intersection between AI/ML and cognitive science and is done in close collaboration with other Waymo teams, in particular SW Research, Systems Engineering, Simulation and Data Science. The HBA team also engages extensively in research with external academic partners. Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship! **You will:** - Survey the state-of-the-art in digital neuroscience / cognitive science and mechanistic interpretability - Develop models able to represent some select aspects of human driving behavior not typically accounted for by existing data-driven ML models (e.g., collision avoidance, road user interaction or visual behavior) - Explore and demonstrate different ways in which the internal mechanisms of these models can be interpreted and explained **You have:** - A strong research background and expertise in cognitive science and / or neuroscience - Expertise in contemporary AI and machine learning - Strong documented computational skills (math and coding) - This role is specifically designed for current PhD candidates; applicants must be actively enrolled in a PhD program **We prefer:** - Specific experience from research on mechanistic interpretability **General Perks:** - Help solve challenging problems with a direct impact on the company - Competitive compensation packages with a housing/relocation bonus (if applicable) - Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Fun intern events and networking opportunities **Onsite Perks:** - Free breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks - Free access to Google shuttles - Onsite gym Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in. At Waymo, we don’t just accept differences - we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Hourly PhD Pay $85—$85 USD

role: 2027 Internship Hardware Engineer, Machine Integration & Test
description: ## Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs. In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system - *Obsess over the End User* - The customer and end user are often not the same. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. ## **About Base** Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time. ## **About the Role** Base is building a vertically-integrated residential energy company — hardware, software, and field operations all under one roof. As a Supply Chain Tooling & Optimization Intern, you'll work directly with the teams standing up our internally built TMS, WMS, and MRP and scaling deployments across Texas. This is not a shadowing internship: you'll own real problems at the intersection of manufacturing, logistics, and software, building the tools and the intelligent layers on top of them that help us install batteries faster and more reliably. ## **What You’ll Do** - Build internal tools, dashboards, and trackers that increase visibility across the supply chain. - Contribute to our internally built TMS, WMS, and MRP — wiring up data pipelines, integrations, and the models behind them. - Analyze operational data from ERP, supplier portals, and shipping systems to surface bottlenecks, blocked orders, and disruptions. - Prototype inventory and network optimization — multi-site / multi-warehouse stock optimization, warehouse slotting, and staffing/labor planning. - Build first-pass forecasting models for material demand (to feed MRP planning parameters) and for the reliability of supplier commitments — how likely a supplier is to actually hit committed dates and quantities. - Ship these *inside* the tools planners already use, not as notebooks on a shelf — and reach for the simplest method that works. - Partner directly with planners, buyers, and ops managers to scope small MVPs, deploy frequently, and iterate on real feedback. ## **What You’ll Bring** - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Industrial/Systems Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Data Science, or similar. - Comfort writing Python and SQL, and a genuine interest in building tools — not just analyzing data. - Some exposure to at least one of: optimization / operations research or basic ML / anomaly detection (coursework, projects, or prior internships all count). - Familiarity with data analysis and dashboarding; bonus for experience with pipelines, APIs, or ERP systems. - Strong written and verbal communication — able to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Builder mindset — enjoys ambiguity, takes ownership, and is excited to make things *work better*, not just measure them. - Experience in a tech-enabled operations environment is a plus— energy, logistics, or manufacturing. ## **About the Team** Our Supply Chain team tackles the challenge of sourcing battery cells, assembling high-capacity packs, and forging vendor partnerships to produce and deliver the industry's lowest-cost, highest-quality home battery systems at unprecedented scale. By optimizing landed costs through strategic global sourcing, domestic manufacturing ramp-up, and durable supplier relationships, your work directly powers Base Power's mission of advancing human prosperity through energy abundance - delivering reliable whole-home backup and below-market electricity rates to tens of thousands of households. These efforts drive uniquely massive impact by fueling one of America's fastest-growing distributed virtual power plants, already exceeding 200 MWh deployed and aggregating flexible storage to bolster the grid against surging demands from AI, electrification, and extreme weather. Exceptional candidates will seize the chance to build the supply foundation for a company raising billions to manufacture in-house and expand nationally, achieving grid-scale resilience at speeds and costs no traditional player can replicate. *Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.* ## **Our Values** - **First Principles Thinking:** Question assumptions. Principles > rules. - **Operate at Base Pace:** Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing. - **Give & Get Feedback:** Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset. - **Everyone’s an Owner:** Follow through on commitments and own results. - **Strong Opinions, Loosely Held:** Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information. - **Committed to the Mission:** Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in. - **Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit:** Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things. ## **Do the best work of your life at Base.**

Enjoy taking ownership of technical problems while learning from experienced engineers. ## **Bonus Points For** - Coursework, projects, or internship experience involving **cloud security, Kubernetes, or Infrastructure-as-Code**. - SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. **NEW GRADUATE ENGINEER, SECURITY SOFTWARE - '26/'27 (STARSHIELD)** Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. The Starshield team is building highly reliable in-space mesh networks, designing secure systems to guarantee access to space, designing next-gen communication and sensing software, and more. As a Security Software Engineer you will influence the security of software across our product lines. We are looking for people with a track record of shipping reliable software and who have a broad understanding of the security design of today’s Internet, including the cryptographic primitives involved. You see the big picture, prioritize accordingly, and are comfortable with working at different levels of abstraction. Ideally, you have notable skills in one or more of the following: - Software engineering - Applied cryptography - Network security - Operating system security - Secure/authenticated boot - Incident response and adversary detection - Vulnerability research Being flexible, communicating clearly, and establishing and maintaining productive working relationships with other engineering teams are paramount to success. If you are passionate about building quality products, love the challenges of outsmarting adversaries, and want to make an impact on an inter-planetary scale, then you will fit right in. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** - Design and build security infrastructure for Starshield, including cryptographic services and other security-critical services - Develop security features for Starshield systems, including our router, dish, gateways, and satellites - Design security into factory processes and provide network services in support of this - Maintain existing production systems and improve security posture via both direct implementation and recommendations to other teams - Build prototypes and help identify, design, and test security improvements **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** - Bachelor's degree in computer science or another STEM discipline - Experience with one or more software development languages (i.e. Python, C++, Golang) - Experience designing and implementing security solutions for operating systems, distributed systems, or other enterprise/large-scale infrastructure - Graduating in the class of 2026 or 2027 **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** - Experience contributing security improvements to complex systems - Experience working with special purpose security hardware such as trusted platform modules (TPMs) and hardware security modules (HSMs) - Fundamental understanding of network protocols; including the TCP/IP stack as well as UDP based protocols - Experienced in navigating large, complex, interactive systems - Flexibility, communicating clearly, and establishing and maintaining productive working relationships with other engineering teams - Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal - Ability to work both independently and in a team - Demonstrated ability to deal with ambiguity and to learn new technologies quickly - Advanced degree in a technical or engineering discipline - Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** - Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed - This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, SpaceX reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with operational needs. **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** Pay Range: Level 1: $130,000.00 - $160,000.00 Level 2: $150,000.00 - $195,000.00 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law. Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program. **ITAR REQUIREMENTS:** - To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR [here](https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987). description: **About NewsBreak** **Local life runs on local information.** What happened down the street? Who can fix this? Where should we go tonight? NewsBreak started in 2015 to answer these questions, and today more than 40 million people a month rely on us to follow what’s going on in their zip code. **Three platforms with one vision: powering local life.** Led by founder and CEO Jeff Zheng, NewsBreak is our local life and news platform; Nearby AI connects people with local businesses; and NDot AI helps publishers and creators grow and earn. **Building for the long term.** A $115 million Series C made us a unicorn in 2021, and we keep investing in our people. We’re Great Place to Work® certified and named to *Fast Company*’s Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025) and *Fortune*’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™ (2026). **Everyone makes an impact.** Whether you write code, shape products, tell our story, or run the business, we want people who own projects end to end, stay curious, and speak up. Join us. Learn more at: NewsBreak, Nearby AI, NDot AI ## About Nearby AI Nearby AI is a new company from NewsBreak building a trust-first marketplace for local home services. We help homeowners understand a problem, what it should reasonably cost, and whether to hire at all before they are connected to a provider, and we help service providers win work on fit and outcomes rather than on speed of contact. Our mission: give people clarity and control from the first sign of a problem to a job done right, and give good contractors work they are equipped to win. We are a small founding team. We work from evidence, keep a written record of decisions, and hold a short set of product principles we do not trade for revenue: no pay-for-rank, no sharing of customer contact information beyond what the customer approved, and no quality claims we cannot substantiate. ## The role Help build the personalized provider-recommendation pipeline end to end: user understanding with LLMs, provider retrieval and ranking, backstage agent workflows, multi-source knowledge integration, and evaluation, working with engineers and product managers from design through launch. - User understanding and personalization: use LLMs to extract service requirements, preferences, and constraints from conversations, profiles, and context - Provider retrieval and ranking: combine semantic search, recommendation algorithms, and provider features (capabilities, coverage, transaction-backed reputation, user fit) to improve relevance and coverage - Agent workflows: build backstage pipelines connecting intent understanding, retrieval, provider comparison, and recommendation decisions, with explanations a user can check - Multi-source data and knowledge integration: entity matching across business information, reviews, credentials, and service coverage - Evaluation and delivery: build evaluation datasets, analyze failure cases and user feedback, improve quality, reliability, and latency; ship and iterate ## Qualifications **Minimum:** - Pursuing a bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, AI, or a related field. - Proficient in Python or Java with solid data structures and algorithms. - Hands-on experience developing LLM applications or agents (RAG, agent workflows, evaluation harnesses). - Understanding of search, recommendation, or ML fundamentals. - Strong problem-solving and communication; initiative to own results. **Preferred:** - Embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, learning to rank, or personalized matching. - Elasticsearch, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, vector databases, or data pipelines. - Shipped products, open-source contributions, or independent projects showing individual impact. - Research and personal projects count; GitHub links and demos welcome. ## About [](http://Overview.ai) [](http://Overview.ai) brings the cutting edge of AI computer vision to manufacturing, solving inspection problems that traditional machine vision could not handle. We build GPU-powered smart cameras, deploy them on production lines around the world, and operate the platform that keeps those fleets running. Our customers love the product because it works: high accuracy, fast deployment, and an operator-friendly experience that makes real factory rollouts possible (not just pilots). ## The Role As a Junior IIoT Engineer, you will help bring our systems live at customer sites: connecting smart cameras to line PLCs, building the logic that runs the inspections, and making sure everything runs reliably on the factory floor. You will be mentored and grow into someone who can own an entire deployment. We provide structured training in Node-RED, camera inspection-recipe building, and English. We do not expect you to master these tools on day one, but we do expect you to already have a solid industrial-field foundation (see Requirements), which we build on to make you a fully capable engineer. ## Key Responsibilities ### Deployment and Commissioning - Deploy and commission [](http://Overview.ai) vision-inspection systems on customer production lines, on-site. - Create and tune camera inspection recipes for each product (regions of interest, models, pass/fail criteria). - Set up and troubleshoot on-site: cameras, industrial networking and switches, and connectivity issues, using our existing internal diagnostic tools. ### Integration - Build and maintain integration logic in Node-RED (data flow between cameras, PLCs, HMIs, and dashboards). - Integrate cameras with factory PLCs over I/O, EtherNet/IP, and Profinet: triggering, handshake signals, and result reporting. ### Customer Support and Teamwork - Support customers on-site: basic training, issue resolution, and clear written and photo documentation of each deployment. - Work closely with the team, escalating complex problems while steadily taking on more independence. ## Requirements - A diploma or degree in Electrical, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related industrial field. A Computer Science or software background is also fine if paired with hands-on factory experience. - A working foundation in industrial fundamentals, which we expect you to have on day one: - Basic concepts of PLCs and industrial automation (signals, I/O, trigger and handshake logic). - A basic understanding of common manufacturing processes. - The ability to read and clarify on-site requirements, turning customer needs into actionable inspection and integration specs. - Solid troubleshooting instincts: systematically pinpointing what went wrong and why. - A strong hands-on drive and problem-solving mindset: you like to dig into why something is not working and fix it. - Basic English reading and writing, with a genuine willingness to improve. - Able and willing to travel frequently across China and Southeast Asia, with a valid passport. - Reliable, communicative, and comfortable working directly in a live factory environment. ## Nice to Have (not required, we will train you) - Hands-on experience with specific PLC brands or industrial protocols (Keyence, EtherNet/IP, MQTT, or similar). - Any scripting or programming experience (JavaScript, Python), or low-code tools such as Node-RED. - Familiarity with machine vision, industrial cameras, or industrial networking. - Basic SQL or dashboard tools. ## What We Offer - A clear training path: Node-RED and camera-recipe building training, plus English training by an external instructor (two-year program). - On-the-job training and mentorship: you learn by doing on real projects. - Fast, real ownership: you will be commissioning live systems at major manufacturers. - A growth track from Junior IIoT Engineer to IIoT Engineer to Senior IIoT Engineer.

Arcadis is dé wereldwijde partner die vooraan staat bij de meest impactvolle projecten van onze tijd. We helpen onze klanten duurzame keuzes te maken via de combinatie van digitale innovatie, expertise en toekomstgerichte vaardigheden in onder meer milieu, energie, water, gebouwen, transport en infrastructuur. Wij zetten die extra stap om onze klanten op maat gemaakte oplossingen te bieden voor ontwerp, engineering en advies. Door data-gedreven inzichten in te zetten geven we de natuurlijke en gebouwde omgeving samen vorm. Met meer dan 34.000 mensen bundelen we wereldwijde expertise en pakken we samen uitdagingen als klimaat, betaalbare energie en leefbare steden aan. We verbeteren de levenskwaliteit door onze aanwezigheid in meer dan 30 landen. **Rolbeschrijving:** De komende jaren investeert ProRail fors in het spoor. Nieuwe stations, ERTMS, spooruitbreidingen, energievraagstukken en vervangingsopgaven vragen om een betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige ondergrondse infrastructuur. Kabelsystemen voor treinbeveiliging, energievoorziening, telecom en andere spoorgebonden installaties vormen daarbij een essentieel onderdeel van het spoorwegnet. Als Junior Engineer Ondergrondse Infra Rail werk je aan het ontwerp, de coördinatie en de verdere ontwikkeling van deze infrastructuur. Je bent betrokken bij projecten vanaf de planstudiefase tot en met realisatie en werkt samen met specialisten uit disciplines zoals treinbeveiliging, spoorontwerp, energievoorziening, bovenleiding en systems engineering. Deze integrale samenwerking sluit aan bij de werkwijze binnen onze railprojecten. Wat deze functie bijzonder maakt, is dat het vakgebied volop in ontwikkeling is. Waar engineering vroeger voornamelijk draaide om het produceren van tekeningen en ontwerpen, verschuift de focus steeds meer naar het slim inzetten van data, digitale modellen en assetinformatie. Daarom investeren wij actief in digitalisering, model-based engineering, BIM, GIS en Systems Engineering. Maar dat doen we nog steeds met als basis de specialistische kennis van de techniek. Je ontwikkelt je hierdoor tot engineer, maar ook steeds meer tot een adviseur die opdrachtgevers helpt onderbouwde keuzes te maken op basis van betrouwbare informatie, data-analyses en integrale afwegingen. De engineer van de toekomst ontwerpt niet alleen, maar adviseert ook over de volledige levenscyclus van railassets en verbindt daarbij verschillende technische disciplines. **Rol verantwoordelijkheden:** Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: - Opstellen en uitwerken van ontwerpen voor ondergrondse railinfrastructuur; - Verzamelen, analyseren en beheren van kabel- en assetgegevens; - Meewerken aan integrale spoorontwerpen samen met disciplines zoals treinbeveiliging, energievoorziening, spoor en bovenleiding; - Toepassen van BIM, GIS en Systems Engineering binnen projecten; - Coördineren van technische informatie tussen verschillende stakeholders; - Ondersteunen bij technische studies, ontwerpafwegingen en risicoanalyses; - Bijdragen aan de verdere digitalisering van ontwerp- en engineeringsprocessen; - Opstellen van technische documentatie en contractstukken; - Meedenken over innovatieve manieren om assetinformatie en digitale modellen beter te benutten binnen spoorprojecten. **Business Unit Rail Signaling:** Je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair railteam waarin specialisten op het gebied van treinbeveiliging en ondergrondse infrastructuur nauw samenwerken, maar werkt ook met specialisten vanuit andere technische disciplines. Juist op de raakvlakken tussen kabelinfrastructuur, spoorontwerp, energievoorziening en treinbeveiliging ontstaan de meest interessante technische uitdagingen. Binnen onze projecten combineren we klassieke techniekgerichte engineering met innovatieve digitale oplossingen. Hierdoor krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de volgende generatie railprojecten, waarin data, digital twins, assetmanagement en model-based engineering steeds belangrijker worden. Daarnaast werken wij steeds vaker samen met internationale Arcadis-teams. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities biedt dit mogelijkheden om ook ervaring op te doen binnen internationale railprojecten. **Kwalificaties & Ervaring:** Wij zoeken een enthousiaste engineer met affiniteit voor techniek, infrastructuur en digitalisering. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende profiel: - Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Elektrotechniek, Civiele Techniek, Energietechniek, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting; - Je hebt 0 tot circa 2 jaar werkervaring; - Je hebt interesse in de techniek van railinfrastructuur en ondergrondse kabelsystemen; - Je hebt affiniteit met BIM, GIS, 3D-modellering en digitalisering; - Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en leergierig; - Je werkt graag samen in multidisciplinaire teams; - Je beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden; - Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed en kunt je ook in het Engels verstaanbaar maken; - Je wilt jezelf ontwikkelen richting specialist, lead engineer of adviseur. **Waarom Arcadis?** We bereiken onze doelen door iedereen in staat te stellen het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Wij geloven dat ieders bijdrage ertoe doet. Daarom pionieren we met een aanpak gebaseerd op jouw vaardigheden en bouwen we aan een ‘Skills Powered Organisation’. Met jouw unieke ervaring en expertise stippel je zo je eigen carrièrepad uit. Samen maximaliseren we de impact! Jouw werk maakt het verschil. Welke rol je ook speelt, je helpt duurzame oplossingen te bieden voor een gezondere planeet. Druk jouw stempel op je carrière, je collega's, klanten, je leven en de wereld om je heen. Op onze website kun je de blogs van Arcadianen lezen om erachter te komen hoe wij dit doen. Arcadis biedt jou een functie met veel vrijheid om je werk zelfstandig in te vullen in een ambitieus en gedreven team. Naast een fijne werkcultuur hebben we ook prima arbeidsvoorwaarden opgenomen, waaronder: - 30 verlofdagen bij fulltime dienstverband met mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen of te verkopen. - Medewerkers mogen privé gratis gebruik maken van de NS businesskaart. - Aanvullende regelingen ten aanzien van geboorteverlof voor de partner en betaald ouderschapsverlof. - Mogelijkheid tot hybride werken, gefaciliteerd door passende thuiswerkvergoeding en een professioneel ingerichte werkplek thuis. - Goede pensioenregeling bij het Nederlandse Pensioenfonds (HNPF) waarbij Arcadis het grootste deel van de premie betaalt. - Mogelijkheden voor het volgen van cursussen en opleidingen, toegang tot ons uitgebreide Arcadis Learning Experience Platform (LXP). Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy. **Interesse?** Solliciteer direct via [](https://careers.arcadis.com/) of neem contact op met Elisa Bega ( Campus Recruiter) via [elisa.bega@arcadis.com](mailto:%20voornaam.achternaam@arcadis.com). Onze inzet voor gelijkheid, diversiteit, inclusie en erbij horen: We willen dat je elke dag je beste zelf kunt zijn. Gelijkheid en inclusie nemen we heel serieus en we houden onszelf verantwoordelijk voor onze acties. We willen een voorkeurswerkgever zijn en bieden iedereen een geweldige werkplek. Uitzend-, detacherings- en W&S-bureaus hoeven niet te reageren, acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. #LI- #LI-Hybrid Een assessment en/of pre-employment screening kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure.

description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As a Summer Intern, you'll participate in a comprehensive onboarding experience led by our University Relations team to set you up for success from day one. **Turn enablement into durable assets:** support development of practical real-time and self-guided enablement learning and convert into durable assets such as **checklists, templates, quick-start guides, and role-based playbook content** HR practitioners can reuse. - **Measure what matters:** help track adoption signals and basic impact metrics using **Excel** and dashboards (e.g., usage, enablement engagement, pilot progress). - **Capture requirements clearly:** partner with HR practitioners across functions to ask smart questions, document needs, and translate them into structured next steps. - Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to simplify complex ideas for different audiences. - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail (you keep docs, tasks, and follow-ups clean) - Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel (basic formulas, tables, simple charts). - Able to evaluate AI outputs, spot issues, and iterate quickly toward better results. - Collaborative and comfortable working with stakeholders across HR functions and time zones. **Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Haves)** - As a Summer Intern at TTP, your work over 10 weeks will see you working alongside consultants from a range of academic backgrounds, from engineers and computer scientists to physicists and biologists – experiencing technology consulting first hand. Over the course of your placement, you will contribute directly to live client and internal projects, applying your own knowledge to solve problems, build prototypes in the lab, and explore new areas of technology. You’ll combine using your engineering skillset to support multi-disciplinary project teams inventing new products and technologies, with learning more about the commercial acumen that drives projects forward. You’ll demonstrate leadership, build collaborative relationships with stakeholders and ultimately work towards understanding the industries and disciplines we work across. We believe growth happens best in a collaborative environment where knowledge is shared freely and curiosity is encouraged – our non-hierarchical culture gives you the freedom to explore projects that reflect your own interest. You'll receive mentorship and guidance when needed, but also the space and encouragement to take ownership of your work. By the end of the internship, you will have first-hand experience of how engineering and science are applied in a commercial context, as well as a clear sense of what it’s like to work in a fast-paced, innovative environment like ours. Our internships are also a great pathway into a career, as we consider all our interns for graduate roles. Deep intellectual curiosity and inventiveness, with a desire to understand how things work at a fundamental level. You should have an academic record that reflects your capacity for rigorous, first-principles thinking - being on track for a minimum 2:1 in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a closely related discipline, with strong accompanying A-Levels (or equivalent, i.e. IB qualifications). Commercially aware and entrepreneurial, excited by the opportunity to turn breakthrough technologies into real-world products, ventures, and impact. Proactive and self-starting, with a strong sense of personal responsibility and a drive to make things happen. Collaborative and emotionally intelligent, able to build trust, influence stakeholders, energise those around you, and communicate complex technical ideas with clarity, empathy, and precision, regardless of your audience's background. Strategic and systems-minded, able to see the bigger picture, anticipate challenges and opportunities while considering the commercial aspects of technology product development, and navigate ambiguity while keeping priorities sharp and focused. We're looking for candidates who want to impact the industry both commercially and technically; those who don't just solve problems - but who seek them out, thrive on them, and elevate those around them while doing so. We recruit on a rolling basis, so although there is no application deadline, the advert will close once all spaces have been filled. We recommend applying early for the best chance. You must have completed at least 2 years of your degree when your internship begins, so students at the beginning of second year are welcome to apply. The length of this internship can be flexible, but we ask for minimum commitment of 8 weeks and recommend 10, starting in July 2027. TTP operates from an award-winning campus in green surroundings, just south of Cambridge. This is a paid internship with generous benefits, including free accommodation in Cambridge (subject to availability) and free lunch, as well as a wide range of clubs to join covering sports and social activities. # **Chart Your Journey at Secretariat** From a collaborative culture to teammates who will always be by your side, find a career that will grow with you. Deliver your impact at Secretariat. **ABOUT THE FIRM** Secretariat is a consulting firm that helps companies, law firms, and organizations solve complex business problems—often when there is a dispute, investigation, major project challenge, or high-stakes decision involved. At Secretariat, you’ll work on some of the most important legal, risk, and regulatory challenges facing businesses around the world. From your first day, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team of smart, curious, and driven people who enjoy solving complex problems. You’ll learn by working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to projects for leading law firms, global companies, and major institutions. Our teams collaborate across offices and disciplines, bringing energy, fresh thinking, and commitment to every client challenge. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, mentorship, professional development, recognition, and a culture that values diverse perspectives. Start your career where your work matters. Make your impact at Secretariat. **ABOUT OUR ENGINEERING SCIENCES TEAM** As part of our growing Global Engineering Sciences team, you’ll apply what you’re learning in the classroom to real-world engineering challenges across industries such as energy, chemicals, machinery, automotive, consumer products, electronics, medical devices, and the built environment. You may help investigate why products, systems, or structures fail, support testing and analysis, and contribute to projects involving buildings, bridges, industrial facilities, and other structures that shape the world around us. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, scientists, and consultants to learn how engineering is used to solve complex questions related to performance, safety, reliability, and design. This is a great fit for students who are curious, analytical, and excited to build practical technical and consulting skills. Secretariat is a fast-growing international expert services firm with more than 500 professionals in 20+ cities worldwide. For students and early-career professionals, we offer meaningful work from day one, mentorship from leading experts, and the chance to build valuable technical, consulting, and problem-solving skills. Please note - this role will be tied to Chicago but performed in Peoria. **RESPONSIBILITIES** In this role, you’ll build practical engineering, analytical, and consulting skills by supporting real client projects from investigation through reporting. You’ll work with experienced professionals who will help you learn how to break down complex technical questions, analyze information, and communicate your findings clearly. - Support hands-on failure investigations and learn how engineers evaluate what happened, why it happened, and how it can be explained clearly. - Compare real-world conditions with original designs, drawings, specifications, and project documents. - Assist with field inspections, site visits, laboratory testing, and other investigative activities. - Perform engineering calculations, research technical issues, and analyze data to help solve complex problems. - Review, organize, and summarize project documents, technical records, photos, test results, and other relevant information. - Help draft clear, well-supported report sections that explain technical findings in a way clients can understand. - Contribute to visuals, exhibits, and demonstratives that help tell the story of a technical issue or investigation. - Analyze technical reports prepared by others and help develop supporting, concurring, or rebuttal perspectives. - Participate in team and client communications, gaining exposure to consulting work across different industries and time zones. - Build strong working relationships with colleagues, peers, and clients while contributing to a collaborative team environment. - Use curiosity, attention to detail, and strong analytical thinking to help the team meet project milestones and deliver high-quality work. **QUALIFICATIONS** - Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Building Science/Architectural Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field;
